title: Lead Generation Specialist / Cold Caller ($500/week – Identify Opportunities)
description:
Job Description:



We are looking for a sharp, conversational Cold Caller / Lead Generation Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will not be setting hard appointments. Instead, your main goal is to identify potential business opportunities by calling prospects, asking qualification questions, and discovering if they have a need for our services.

We provide the complete list of leads and guidelines—you just need to bring your great communication skills, curiosity, and positive attitude.



Key Responsibilities:



Make outbound cold calls to our provided lead lists.

Engage prospects in natural, fluid conversations to understand their current situation.

Ask strategic questions to uncover pain points and identify genuine business opportunities.

Pass qualified, high-potential leads over to our internal team for follow-up.

Accurately log detailed call notes, prospect needs, and outcomes in our CRM.



Requirements:



Exceptional English communication skills (clear pronunciation, neutral or American accent, and strong listening skills).

Proven experience in cold calling, lead generation, or telemarketing.

Active listening skills—you know how to listen for clues and read between the lines rather than just reading a script.

A quiet home office environment with a reliable computer, fast internet connection, and a noise-canceling headset.



Compensation & Schedule:



Pay: $500 per week.

Type: Remote / Work from home.



How to Apply:



To be considered for this position, you must follow these instructions carefully:

Record a short introduction of yourself (say your name, your past calling experience, and why you are great at uncovering prospect needs) using Vocaroo.

Include the Vocaroo link at the very top of your application message.

Put the secret code "OPPORTUNITY-FOUND" in your application subject line so we know you read the full description.

title: Cold Caller
description:
About the Opportunity



We are looking for a motivated, persuasive, and highly energetic Cold Caller to take ownership of our top-of-funnel sales prospecting efforts.

This is a fast-paced opportunity for someone who genuinely enjoys starting conversations, creating interest, overcoming objections, and turning cold prospects into qualified opportunities.

You’ll be the first voice many prospective clients hear, making your ability to communicate clearly, build rapport quickly, and identify genuine buying interest critical to your success.

If you thrive on the phone, are energized by hitting targets, and can confidently turn an initial “no” into a meaningful conversation, this role could be an excellent fit.



Key Responsibilities



Outbound Prospecting

- Execute high-volume daily outbound calls to targeted prospective clients.

- Follow structured scripts while adapting your approach naturally to each conversation.

- Introduce our value proposition clearly and create interest within the first moments of the call.

- Maintain consistent call volume and activity while working toward established performance goals.



Discovery & Lead Qualification

- Conduct concise, high-value discovery conversations to understand prospect needs and pain points.

- Identify decision-makers and key stakeholders.

- Evaluate prospect fit, needs, timing, and budget.

- Identify buying signals and determine when a prospect is ready for the next step.

- Convert qualified interest into booked discovery calls and product demonstrations.



Objection Handling & Engagement

- Confidently navigate gatekeepers and initial resistance.

- Handle objections using active listening, empathy, and strategic questioning.

- Adapt your approach when prospects go off-script.

- Turn passive interest into active engagement and meaningful sales conversations.

- Maintain professionalism and confidence throughout every interaction.



CRM & Activity Tracking

- Accurately record calls, prospect responses, notes, outcomes, and follow-up schedules in the CRM.

- Keep prospect information current and organized.

- Ensure qualified leads are properly transitioned to account executives.

- Follow up consistently with prospects according to established schedules.



What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is confident, resilient, articulate, competitive, and genuinely enjoys sales conversations.

Ideal candidates will have:

- Previous experience in high-volume outbound telemarketing, appointment setting, cold calling, or inside sales.

- An exceptionally clear, engaging, and professional English-speaking voice.

- Strong conversational skills and the ability to build rapport quickly.

- Excellent active listening and objection-handling abilities.

- The ability to identify subtle buying signals during fast-paced conversations.

- High emotional stamina and the ability to remain positive through frequent rejection.

- Strong focus and consistency when performing repetitive outbound activities.

- Experience using auto-dialers, CRM platforms, or sales engagement tools.

- Strong organizational skills and accurate documentation habits.

- A results-oriented mindset and desire to continuously improve.

- Spanish-speaking ability is a plus.



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means consistently creating qualified sales opportunities from cold conversations.

You’ll be expected to:

- Maintain strong daily calling activity.

- Generate meaningful conversations with prospective clients.

- Qualify prospects accurately.

- Book high-quality discovery calls and demos.

- Maintain strong prospect show-up rates.

- Handle objections without losing momentum.

- Keep CRM records accurate and up to date.

- Consistently improve your approach based on call results and feedback.



How to Apply

If you thrive on phone sales, enjoy hunting for new opportunities, and know how to capture a decision-maker’s attention quickly, we’d love to hear from you.



Please submit your resume along with a brief 1–2 minute audio recording demonstrating:

Your telephone voice and communication style.



A short introduction or sales pitch.

How you would respond to an initial objection during a cold call.

title: CFO
description:
Position Summary



Grace Integrated is seeking an experienced and strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to oversee the financial health and long-term financial strategy of our growing behavioral health practice.



The CFO will be responsible for financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, financial reporting, payroll calculation, revenue cycle performance and profitability analysis. This individual will work closely with ownership and senior leadership to ensure that financial decisions support the continued growth and stability of the organization.



The ideal candidate combines strong financial and accounting expertise with an understanding of the unique financial challenges of healthcare and behavioral health organizations, including insurance reimbursement, clinician compensation, revenue cycle management, and multi-location operations.



Qualifications



Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field required



Master’s degree, MBA, CPA, CMA, or other advanced financial certification strongly preferred



Minimum of 5 years of progressive financial leadership experience



Healthcare, behavioral health, medical practice, or other healthcare services experience strongly preferred



Experience overseeing multi-million-dollar organizational budgets and financial operations



Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, financial statements, and profitability analysis



Experience with healthcare revenue cycle management and insurance reimbursement preferred



Experience with payroll, employee compensation models, and benefits-related financial planning



Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities



Advanced proficiency with Excel and/or Google Sheets and financial reporting systems



Ability to translate complex financial information into clear recommendations for ownership and leadership



Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills



Must be fluent in spoken and written English



Ability to maintain strict confidentiality regarding financial, employee, and organizational information



Primary Responsibilities



Oversee the overall financial operations and financial health of Grace Integrated



Develop and maintain annual budgets, financial forecasts, and long-term financial plans



Monitor organizational revenue, expenses, profitability, and cash flow



Prepare and present monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports to ownership and senior leadership



Analyze financial performance across individual locations, departments, programs, and service lines



Develop and monitor key financial performance indicators and management dashboards



Evaluate clinician productivity, compensation, reimbursement, and profitability



Monitor payer reimbursement trends and their impact on organizational revenue



Collaborate with billing and claims leadership to evaluate accounts receivable, denials, collections, and revenue cycle performance



Oversee payroll-related financial processes and ensure appropriate financial controls



Review employee compensation structures, bonuses, benefits, and other labor-related expenses



Establish and maintain appropriate accounting procedures and internal financial controls



Coordinate with outside accountants, tax professionals, banking partners, insurance professionals, and other financial advisors



Evaluate capital expenditures, leases, property investments, and major organizational purchases



Perform financial analysis for new locations, service expansions, hiring initiatives, and other growth opportunities



Develop financial projections and feasibility analyses for potential business opportunities



Identify financial risks and recommend strategies to protect the organization



Support strategic planning, expansion, and long-term organizational growth



Ensure leadership has timely and accurate financial information necessary for decision-making



Leadership Responsibilities



The CFO will serve as a key member of the senior leadership team and will work closely with ownership and operational leadership.



The CFO is expected to provide leadership with a clear understanding of not only what the financial numbers are, but why they are changing and what actions may need to be considered.



The CFO should be capable of identifying financial trends early, challenging assumptions when appropriate, and helping leadership evaluate the financial consequences of major business decisions.



Ideal Candidate



Grace Integrated is looking for a CFO who is analytical, organized, strategic, accountable, and comfortable working in a growing organization.



The successful candidate should be able to move between high-level financial strategy and detailed financial analysis. This individual should understand that the financial performance of a behavioral health organization depends heavily on clinician productivity, staffing costs, payer reimbursement, claims performance, utilization, and responsible growth.



Experience working with a multi-location behavioral health, mental health, medical, or other healthcare organization is highly desirable.

title: Sales Admin Specialist
description:
About the Opportunity



Are you the organized, detail-oriented person who keeps everything moving behind the scenes?

We are looking for a proactive and highly organized Sales Administrative Specialist to support our sales team and help keep our growth pipeline running smoothly.

In this role, you'll sit at the intersection of sales, administration, and operations. You'll help manage prospect information, coordinate communications, keep our CRM accurate, prepare sales documentation, and ensure our sales representatives have everything they need to move opportunities forward.

Your work will directly support our sales team's ability to spend less time on administrative tasks and more time building relationships and closing deals.

If you're someone who enjoys creating order, keeping track of details, following up on outstanding items, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks, this could be a great fit.



Key Responsibilities



CRM & Sales Data Management

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date prospect and customer information in the CRM.

- Log prospect communications, activities, follow-ups, and deal updates.

- Track contract stages, sales activity, and key pipeline information.

- Perform accurate data entry and regularly identify and correct incomplete or inconsistent records.



Lead Coordination

- Review incoming sales inquiries and ensure prospect information is complete and accurate.

- Assist with initial lead qualification and route opportunities to the appropriate sales representative.

- Coordinate discovery calls, demos, meetings, and other sales activities.

- Ensure leads receive timely follow-up and are properly documented throughout the sales process.



Sales Documentation

- Prepare, review, and distribute standard sales quotes, proposals, agreements, and related documentation.

- Verify pricing, terms, required information, and internal approvals before documents are sent.

- Track outstanding signatures, forms, and supporting documentation.

- Maintain organized records of sales documents throughout the deal lifecycle.



Sales Team Support

- Serve as a reliable administrative partner to sales representatives.

- Coordinate communication between prospects, clients, and internal sales team members.

- Follow up with prospective clients regarding missing information, signatures, documents, or onboarding requirements.

- Help sales representatives stay organized and focused on high-value activities.



Reporting & Sales Operations

- Compile weekly sales activity reports and performance metrics.

- Monitor team activity and progress toward revenue targets.

- Identify delays, recurring administrative issues, and operational bottlenecks.

- Provide sales leadership with accurate information that can help improve pipeline management and team efficiency.



What We’re Looking For

We're looking for someone who is organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced sales environment.

Ideal candidates will have:

- Previous experience as a Sales Administrator, Sales Operations Assistant, Sales Coordinator, or similar role supporting a sales team.

- Hands-on experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar systems.

- Strong proficiency with modern office productivity and communication tools.

- Exceptional organizational and time-management skills.

- Ability to prioritize multiple time-sensitive tasks without losing attention to detail.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with contracts, pricing, numbers, and client information.

- Strong follow-up skills and the ability to keep multiple deals moving simultaneously.

- Ability to work independently and take ownership of routine reporting and administrative responsibilities.

- A reliable, results-focused approach and a willingness to proactively identify problems before they become obstacles.

- Spanish-speaking ability is a plus.

- What Success Looks Like

- In this role, you'll help ensure that:

- Sales data stays accurate and current.

- Leads are properly assigned and followed up with.

- Sales representatives have the information and documents they need.

- Proposals, agreements, and contracts move efficiently through the process.

- Outstanding documents and signatures don't fall through the cracks.

- Sales leadership has reliable pipeline and performance information.

- Administrative bottlenecks are identified and resolved quickly.



Why This Role Matters

Great sales teams need more than great salespeople—they need great operations behind them.

Your organization, follow-through, and attention to detail will help our sales team operate more efficiently, improve the prospect experience, and keep opportunities moving from initial inquiry to closed deal.



How to Apply

If you excel at keeping sales teams organized, maintaining accurate systems, coordinating details, and keeping deal pipelines moving, we'd love to hear from you.



Please submit your resume in English along with a brief statement highlighting your experience supporting sales operations and managing CRM systems.

Agency is looking for an experienced, motivated Sales & Quoting Virtual Assistant to join our growing insurance agency.



We are looking for someone who is comfortable speaking with customers, making outbound calls, gathering information, preparing insurance quotes, following up with prospects, and helping move qualified customers toward completing a purchase.

s

title: Collections Specialist
description:
About the Opportunity



We are looking for a proactive, confident, and client-focused Collections Specialist to join our team and play a critical role in maintaining healthy client accounts and supporting revenue recovery.

This is more than simply following up on unpaid balances. You’ll work directly with clients to understand billing concerns, resolve account discrepancies, overcome payment obstacles, and find practical solutions that work for both the client and the organization.

The ideal candidate is comfortable having financial conversations, stays composed when handling objections, and takes pride in following through until an issue is fully resolved.



Key Responsibilities



Collections & Revenue Recovery

- Make outbound calls and work assigned collection queues to address unpaid balances and failed payments.

- Prioritize accounts effectively to meet established collection and recovery goals.

- Follow up consistently on outstanding balances and payment commitments.

- Use active listening, professionalism, and persuasive communication to address financial objections.

- Secure appropriate payment commitments and document agreed-upon next steps.



Billing & Account Resolution

- Handle incoming client calls regarding billing questions and invoice disputes.

- Clearly explain charges, invoices, billing cycles, and account balances.

- Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate appropriate resolutions.

- Respond promptly to missed calls, messages, and client inquiries.

- Ensure billing concerns are followed through to complete resolution.



Payment Solutions

- Guide clients through customized payment plans and available payment options.

- Assist clients with setting up automatic payments.

- Explain and facilitate available third-party financing solutions.

- Help identify practical payment solutions while maintaining established policies and procedures.



Documentation & CRM Management

- Accurately document client calls,
s, payment commitments, disputes, and follow-up activities.

- Maintain complete and up-to-date account records within assigned CRM and billing systems.

- Track outstanding issues and follow-up requirements to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

- Maintain a complete record of client interactions and account resolutions.



What We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate will be organized, persistent, confident on the phone, and comfortable discussing financial matters with clients.

Qualifications include:

- Proven experience in collections, accounts receivable, legal billing, or a related financial role.

- Strong telephone presence and excellent verbal communication skills.

- Excellent active listening and conflict-resolution abilities.

- Ability to handle financial objections and difficult conversations professionally.

- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

- High technical aptitude and the ability to quickly learn new systems.

- Hands-on experience with legal billing software or CRM systems is highly preferred.

- Ability to independently manage repetitive, detail-oriented workflows.

- Strong follow-through and accountability.

- Ability to work effectively in a fully remote environment.

- A quiet, dedicated home-office setup suitable for handling client calls.

- Spanish-speaking ability is a plus.



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means consistently moving accounts toward resolution while ensuring clients receive clear, respectful, - and professional communication.

You'll be expected to:

- Stay on top of assigned collection queues.

- Follow through consistently on outstanding accounts.

- Resolve billing questions and disputes efficiently.

- Secure and document payment commitments.

- Keep CRM and billing records accurate and complete.

- Ensure clients understand their payment options.

- Close the loop on every outstanding issue.



Schedule

Monday–Friday | 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST

Fully Remote



How to Apply

If you have experience in collections, billing, accounts receivable, or legal billing and are confident in communicating with clients about financial matters, we'd love to hear from you.



Please submit your updated resume highlighting your collections, billing, or accounts receivable experience.

title: Operations Manager
description:
# Operations Manager 



We’re looking for an organized, proactive Operations Coordinator to turn client conversations into completed work. You’ll review recordings of client calls, capture decisions and next steps, create clear tasks, and assign them to the right team members.



Starting pay is $8.50 an hour with a possible pay raise after 90 days. Please do not apply if you cannot handle the role. 



## What you’ll do



• Review client call recordings and notes promptly after each meeting  

• Identify decisions, deliverables, deadlines, questions, and follow ups  

• Create tasks with enough context for team members to act without guessing  

• Assign tasks based on each person’s responsibilities and workload  

• Track progress, follow up on overdue work, and flag anything that needs a decision  

• Keep project boards and client records accurate and up to date  

• Protect client confidentiality



## You’re a good fit if you



• Have experience coordinating projects or operations for a service business  

• Can distinguish a commitment from an idea discussed on a call  

• Write clear, concise task instructions  

• Follow through without needing constant reminders  

• Feel comfortable asking for clarification when ownership or deadlines are unclear  

• Can work across multiple clients and priorities



To show us you read the full posting, include the word **compass** in your application.



## To apply



Send a brief introduction, your relevant experience, your availability, and an example of how you would turn a client call into assigned tasks. Hours are 9-3pm CST time. 25 hours a week with possibility for full time in Jan 2027

title: Professional Trading Academy with Team Placement Opportunity.
description:
Build the Skills. Earn Your Seat. Trade With Professionals.



We are not looking for experienced traders.



We are looking for highly motivated individuals who are willing to learn, train, and prove themselves.



Our firm has developed an intensive training and evaluation program designed to transform driven individuals into specialized market professionals.



Whether your background is in finance, economics, engineering, mathematics, data analysis, gaming, psychology, business, or something completely different, you may be a fit if you possess strong analytical thinking, discipline, and a commitment to continuous improvement.



What You'll Be Training For



Successful candidates will complete a structured development program and be assessed for placement into one of our specialized trading team roles:



Order Flow & Volume Profile Specialist

Market Structure & Price Action Analyst

Macro & Fundamental Strategist

Quantitative Analyst (Quant)

Risk Manager & Trade Validator



Throughout the program, you will learn how professional traders and analysts evaluate markets, manage risk, identify opportunities, and contribute to a high-performance trading operation.



What To Expect



This is not a passive course.



You will be expected to:



Complete assigned training modules

Study market behavior daily

Participate in practical exercises and assessments

Submit market analysis and trade reviews

Develop professional-level research and reporting skills

Demonstrate discipline, consistency, and accountability

Meet performance standards at each stage of the program



The program is designed to identify individuals who combine intelligence, work ethic, emotional control, and coachability.



Not everyone will successfully complete the program.

Those who do will get a certificate of completion.



Who We're Looking For



You may be a strong candidate if you:



Enjoy solving complex problems

Have strong attention to detail

Are comfortable working with data, analysis, and decision-making

Learn quickly and independently

Are self-motivated and disciplined

Can receive feedback and apply it

Have a long-term mindset focused on mastery rather than shortcuts



Previous trading experience is not required.



A growth mindset and willingness to work hard are required.



Career Opportunity Upon Successful Completion



Candidates who successfully complete the program and meet our performance standards will be offered a position on the trading team.



Team members are compensated through a performance-based structure that includes:



✅ 25% commission on winning trades



✅ Direct participation in trading operations



✅ Ongoing mentorship and development



✅ Unlimited income potential based on performance



✅ Opportunity to grow into senior analytical and trading roles



Your earning potential is directly tied to the value you create and the results you help generate.



Important



This opportunity is not designed for individuals seeking a traditional hourly job.



It is designed for individuals who want to develop elite market skills, earn their place on a professional trading team, and be rewarded based on performance.



If you are ambitious, disciplined, and willing to put in the work, we invite you to apply and begin the journey.



Apply today and prove what you're capable of.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
About the Opportunity



Do you genuinely enjoy helping people and making sure they feel heard, supported, and valued?

We are looking for a friendly, empathetic, highly organized Customer Service Representative to join our team and play an important role in delivering an exceptional client experience.

As a Customer Service Representative, you'll be more than a point of contact—you'll be a trusted resource for our clients. You'll answer questions, resolve concerns, coordinate with internal teams, and make sure clients receive timely and professional support throughout their experience with us.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong communication skills with genuine empathy, patience, organization, and follow-through.

If you take pride in turning a frustrating situation into a positive experience and enjoy building meaningful relationships with the people you serve, we'd love to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities



Client Communication & Relationship Management

- Communicate proactively with existing clients by phone,
, and live chat.

- Build professional, trusting relationships with clients through consistent communication and follow-through.

- Respond to questions and requests promptly and professionally.

- Keep clients informed about the status of their requests and outstanding issues.



Issue Resolution & Client Advocacy

- Listen carefully to client concerns and identify the best path toward resolution.

- Handle sensitive or difficult conversations with patience, professionalism, and empathy.

- De-escalate challenging situations while maintaining a calm and solutions-focused approach.

- Advocate for client needs and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams to resolve issues.



Documentation & CRM Management

- Accurately document client interactions, concerns, feedback, and action items in the CRM or database.

- Maintain complete and up-to-date client records.

- Track open requests and follow-up items to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

- Maintain accurate documentation of resolutions and client communications.



Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with internal departments to ensure client requests are addressed quickly and accurately.

- Coordinate information between clients and internal team members.

- Escalate issues appropriately when additional support or decision-making is required.

- Help identify recurring client concerns and opportunities to improve internal processes.



Client Experience & Reporting

- Monitor open service requests and follow-up activities.

- Provide timely updates to management regarding significant client concerns and service trends.

- Help identify opportunities to improve the overall customer journey.

- Contribute ideas and feedback that can improve client satisfaction and retention.



Privacy & Confidentiality

- Handle private client information with discretion and professionalism.

- Follow established privacy, confidentiality, and security procedures at all times.

- Maintain a high level of professionalism when working with sensitive client information.



What We’re Looking For

We're looking for someone who is empathetic, dependable, proactive, and genuinely enjoys helping people.

Ideal candidates will have:

- Previous experience in customer service, customer support, account management, client relations, or another high-touch service environment.

- Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

- Strong active listening and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to remain calm and professional during difficult or emotional conversations.

- Proven ability to de-escalate concerns and identify practical solutions.

- Exceptional follow-through and attention to detail.

- Strong organizational and task-prioritization skills.

- Experience working with CRM systems, customer databases, or ticketing platforms preferred.

- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a remote team.

- A proactive mindset and willingness to identify opportunities to improve the client experience.

- Spanish-speaking ability is a plus.



What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means making sure clients never feel ignored, forgotten, or unsure about what happens next.

You'll help ensure that:

- Clients receive timely and professional communication.

- Questions and concerns are handled with empathy and urgency.

- Follow-ups happen when promised.

- Client records remain accurate and complete.

- Internal teams have the information they need to resolve issues.

- Potential problems are identified before they become larger concerns.

- Every interaction contributes to a positive overall client experience.



How to Apply

If you enjoy helping people, solving problems, building meaningful relationships, and delivering exceptional customer experiences, we'd love to hear from you.



Please submit your RESUME along with a short one-minute video introduction.

In your video, briefly tell us about your background in customer support or client relations and why you believe you'd be a great fit for our team.

description:
Full job description

Purchasing & Logistics Coordinator



McGuire Roofing Products Full-Time, In-Office 



About McGuire Roofing Products



McGuire Roofing Products is a roofing manufacturer committed to delivering high-quality products to our customers, distributors, and private label partners. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a detail-oriented teammate to keep our purchase orders, partner relationships, and shipments moving smoothly. Learn more at 
.



Position Summary



The Purchasing & Logistics Coordinator owns the day-to-day flow of purchase orders for both our own production needs and our private label partners. You'll be the connective tissue between our partners, suppliers, production floor, and freight carriers — making sure every order is placed correctly, produced on time, shipped on schedule, and tracked from start to finish.



Key Responsibilities



Purchase Orders: Create, process, and manage purchase orders for raw materials, finished goods, and private label production runs.

Private Label Partners: Serve as the primary point of contact for our private label partners — managing order intake, confirming specs, providing status updates, and resolving issues.

Logistics & Shipping: Coordinate inbound and outbound freight, schedule pickups, prepare shipping documentation (BOLs, packing lists), and work with carriers on rates and transit times.

Tracking & Reporting: Maintain accurate records of every order from PO creation through delivery; proactively track shipments and flag delays before they become problems.

Inventory Coordination: Work with production and warehouse teams to align order timing with material availability and finished goods inventory.

Supplier Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and carriers; negotiate lead times and resolve discrepancies on invoices, shortages, or damaged goods.

Documentation: Keep all order, shipping, and partner records organized and audit-ready.

Continuous Improvement: Identify ways to streamline ordering, tracking, and logistics processes as we grow.

What We're Looking For



Strong organizational skills and an obsession with details — you don't let things fall through the cracks.

Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable being the main point of contact for outside partners.

Comfort with spreadsheets,
, and ERP/inventory software (we'll train on our specific systems).

Calm under pressure — able to juggle multiple orders, partners, and shipping deadlines at once.

Problem-solver who follows through; when something goes wrong with a shipment or order, you own it until it's resolved.

Prior experience in purchasing, logistics, supply chain, customer service, or manufacturing is a plus, but not required — we're open to candidates at any experience level who bring the right attitude and aptitude.

Roofing, building products, or manufacturing industry experience is a bonus.

Why Join McGuire Roofing Products

title: Customer Service and Shopify Order Support VA (US Family Ranch)
description:
About Us

Beauty and the Beef is a small family cattle ranch in Montana, USA. We raise our own cattle and ship beef straight to families' doors. There's no grocery store and no middleman. Our customers know us by name, and that's the whole point. This role is the voice our customers hear and read every day.



About the Role

We're looking for a warm, organized Customer Service and Shopify Order Support VA. You'll answer customers, keep orders moving, and work closely with our ranch, which packs and ships every order. You're the last set of eyes before a perishable product ships to someone's door, so details matter here.



You won't be starting from scratch. You'll have step-by-step SOPs and an AI help desk trained on the owner's own answers, so you can look up how we handle almost any question.



Pay



$9 to $10 USD per hour, based on experience

Paid weekly in USD

A raise after a successful 30 day trial



Schedule



Part-time, about 10 hours per week

Monday to Friday, 9 to 11 AM US Mountain Time (currently 11 PM to 1 AM Philippine time, and midnight to 2 AM after November 1)

More hours during our busy season in November and December, including some Saturday mornings

This role may start seasonal, with the chance to become long-term



What You'll Do



Answer customer
s, texts and Shopify chat in a friendly, natural way

Explain bulk beef to people who've never bought it before: how deposits work, how much freezer space they'll need, and when it ships

Follow up with customers before and after their orders ship

Organize Shopify orders so the ranch knows exactly what to pack

Prepare shipping labels

Keep order tracking spreadsheets up to date

Remind deposit customers about balances and coordinate shipping dates

Order the free chest freezers that come with half and whole beef shares with Amazon Business account

Suggest add-ons and upgrades in a helpful, never pushy way

Log new customer questions so our help desk keeps getting smarter

On occasion you'll be speaking with our customers so having great speaking skills is essential for this role. 



Our Customer Contact Rule

Texts and
s to customers only go out between 8 AM and 8 PM in the customer's time zone. If you're working outside those hours, you schedule the message instead of sending it. Our customers should never get a text in the middle of the night.



Tools You'll Use

Shopify, Shopify Inbox, Gmail, a business texting app, Google Sheets, Amazon Business, and ClickUp. You'll be trained on all of them but ideally you already are familiar. Priority for this job will be given to those who are experts in Shopify.



Skills You Need



Shopify experience (required): you've managed orders, customers or products in Shopify before

Customer service experience: you've answered real customers by
, chat or text, and can tell us for whom

Excellent spoken and written English: our customers are American, so you should sound warm, natural and confident, not scripted

Clear, confident texting: you can deliver bad news, like a delayed ship date, in a few friendly sentences without over-apologizing

Explaining the unfamiliar: you're comfortable walking someone through a product they've never bought before

Spreadsheets: you're comfortable in Google Sheets or Excel, and you've built or kept up a tracker someone else relied on

Shipping: you've prepared shipping labels or worked in a shipping platform (ShipStation, Shopify Shipping, etc.)

Organization under volume: you can keep 40+ orders straight and have a system for it with Shopify customer exports, turning them into spread sheets. 

Eye for detail: you're the kind of person who catches someone else's mistake before it goes out

Independence: you can manage your own hours without someone checking in

Gentle upselling: you can suggest an add-on or upgrade without being pushy. You will be provided a list of what you can upsell. 



Nice to Have but not essential

title: Outbound Call Center Agent
description:
About Us

We are one of the largest Hand & Stone Massage and Facial Spa franchise groups in the United States — 16+ spa locations across the country, and still opening more. Hand & Stone is one of America’s leading spa brands, helping hundreds of thousands of clients every year feel better through professional massage, facial, and wellness services.

Behind those spas is a remote outbound team that keeps our appointment books full — and we treat that team like true employees, not freelancers. Many of our agents have been with us for years. We invest in training, celebrate wins loudly, run contests constantly, and promote from within as we grow. When you join us, you’re joining a stable, growing American company that considers you part of the family.

Why You’ll Love This Job

• Guaranteed monthly salary — 42,000–55,000/month depending on experience, paid reliably, on time, every time. No waiting on clients or chasing invoices.

• Uncapped commissions — you earn on every appointment you book. Our top performers take home 85,000–115,000+ per month all-in.

• Warm leads only — every person you call has already asked about our services. No cold calling, no hostile hang-ups — just friendly conversations with people who want to book.

• Permanent work from home — a long-term, full-time career, not a short gig. Skip the commute and build your future from home.

• Contests, bonuses & recognition — regular contests and incentives that keep the work fun and put extra money in your pocket.

• Real career growth — we promote from within. Agents grow into team lead, training, and operations roles as we open new locations.

• Paid training & real support — proven scripts, ongoing coaching, and leadership that wants you to win.

What You’ll Do

• Call and text warm leads who requested information about massages, facials, and spa services — and book them into appointments at our spas

• Follow up with interested prospects until they book, with professionalism, confidence, and empathy

• Educate clients on our services, memberships, and current promotions to build excitement

• Hit daily and weekly booking goals with full support and coaching from leadership

• Log every call outcome accurately in our booking system

What We’re Looking For

• Excellent spoken and written English with a clear, friendly phone voice

• A confident, positive, coachable personality and the drive to meet goals

• Availability to work 40 hours/week during US business hours (night shift, Philippine time)

• Reliable high-speed internet, a quality headset, and a quiet workspace

• Sales, appointment setting, or call center experience is a plus — but attitude matters more



How to Apply

Start your application with the word SERENITY so we know you read this far. Then send us:

• Your resume

• A short note on why you’re a great fit

• A 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself (a link is fine — Vocaroo works great)

• A screenshot of your internet speed test from Speedtest.net

We review every complete application and respond quickly. We can’t wait to meet you!

title: Weekend After-Hours Staffing Coordinator — Senior Care Part-time · Remote (Philippines) · Pacific Time weekend coverage
description:
Weekend After-Hours Staffing Coordinator — Senior Care

Part-time · Remote (Philippines) · Pacific Time weekend coverage

Heritage Senior Care (Carlsbad, California)



About us

Heritage Senior Care is a California-licensed non-medical home care agency. We help families keep seniors safe and supported at home. We are looking for a dependable weekend after-hours staffing coordinator.



Schedule and expected active hours

• One continuous on-call block: Friday 3:45 PM – Monday 8:15 AM Pacific Time (PT)

• Paid 15-minute live handoffs with the weekday office:

  – Friday 3:45–4:00 PM PT (takeover)

  – Monday 8:00–8:15 AM PT (handback)

• Plan on active work roughly:

  – Friday evening: about 3–4 hours

  – Saturday: about 5–6 hours

  – Sunday: about 5–6 hours

  – Monday morning: about 1–2 hours

• Philippines local equivalent (verify around daylight-saving changes): roughly Saturday morning through Monday late evening

• You must be reachable by phone and text for the full window. Some stretches are quieter; when something comes up, speed and clear judgment matter.

• Context only: Saturday call volume is typically busiest about 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM PT; late-night hours are often quieter.



Workload (typical)

• About 1–3 i
 per weekend day, usually about 15–45 minutes of active work each (varies)

• Individual calls are usually short, but an i
 often needs multiple calls (caregivers, office escalate-to, follow-ups)

• Weekend work also includes staffing upcoming open shifts and light administrative tasks (for example
ing/texting caregivers reminders)

• This is on-call coverage with meaningful active blocks, not a continuously staffed call-center desk



What you will do

• Join the Friday 3:45 PM PT handoff and note open issues the office is leaving

• Return calls (and reply to texts) within 10–15 minutes of the initial contact

• Answer / forward calls; take clear, complete messages (who called, callback number, reason, urgency)

• Keep and provide a detailed log of every call and i
 for the weekend (who, when, what happened, what you did, what still needs follow-up)

• Triage caregiver call-outs, uncovered shifts, and client/family concerns; escalate per playbook when needed

• Staff upcoming open shifts over the weekend (find coverage, confirm, document)

• Update schedules in AxisCare

• Handle light admin:
/text caregiver reminders and similar follow-ups

• Use the log/template we provide so Monday handback is complete and easy to review

• Stay calm, professional, and discreet with last-minute staffing issues

• Join the Monday 8:00–8:15 AM PT handback with a clear update: what came in, what was filled/escalated, what still needs office follow-up



Training before solo weekends

• Before you cover a weekend on your own, you complete 1–2 weeks of Monday–Friday training and shadowing with our California office team

• You learn the playbook, AxisCare schedule workflow, escalation tree, call/i
 logging, and how we talk to caregivers and families



What you will NOT do (important)

• No access to client protected health information (PHI) beyond what access controls allow for this role (schedule/staffing tools only; not care plans or clinical records)

• No clinical advice

• Not a fully manned Friday-evening call-center desk; not weekday overnight coverage beyond the weekend window above (weekday training/shadowing is separate and happens Mon–Fri before solo weekends)



Requirements

• Clear, professional phone English with little accent — easy for U.S. caregivers and families to understand (voice screen is part of the interview process)

• Prior phone support, call handling/escalation, dispatch, staffing coordination, BPO CSR, or similar experience (required)

• Comfortable covering U.S. Pacific Time weekends (overnight/early-morning stretches included)

• Quiet dedicated workspace, quality headset, stable internet, and a reliable phone line for the full on-call window

• Strong organization, judgment, and ability to follow a written playbook and escalation tree

• Disciplined about the 5-10 minute return-call standard and detailed i
 logging

• Discreet and professional with family/caregiver conversations

• Able to complete 1–2 weeks of Mon–Fri training/shadowing before solo weekend coverage



Nice to have

• Experience supporting U.S. clients or home-care / senior-services / healthcare-adjacent phone work

• Familiarity with scheduling software, VoIP / softphone / CRM, or simple ticketing logs



Pay

In your application, tell us your asking rate for covering this full weekend block (Friday 3:45 PM – Monday 8:15 AM PT), including the two paid 15-minute handoffs and the expected active hours above. Final pay is set at offer based on experience. A paid trial weekend may be used before ongoing coverage.



How to apply

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph on this job post (preferred). You may also
 
 with subject: Weekend After-Hours Intake.



Applications missing the video link below will not be considered.



Please include in your application message:

(1) Brief intro + relevant phone/BPO experience

(2) Confirmation you can cover Fri 3:45 PM – Mon 8:15 AM PT every weekend (or note conflicts)

(3) Your asking rate for this weekend block

(4) Confirmation you can do 1–2 weeks Mon–Fri training/shadowing before solo weekends

Summary

We're a recruitment partner hiring for an established Australian company that runs large-scale public food and lifestyle events. Each event runs across multiple days with 20–25+ vendors, a full marketing campaign, and a long list of suppliers to book and confirm. They run on a repeating monthly cycle, which means there is always one event in delivery and another in build.



We need a remote Event Operations Coordinator to own the moving parts from the moment an event is confirmed through to post-event close-out.



This is a coordination and execution role, not a creative or strategy role. You won't be d

What you'll be doing

- Running the master event tracker — setting each event up, calculating task due dates from the event date, assigning tasks, checking daily, chasing what's overdue

- Sending a structured end-of-day report so management can see an event's status without opening the tracker

- Vendor administration across 20–25+ vendors per event: contracts, signatures, food safety certificates, public liability insurance, stall size, power requirements, commission arrangements, contact and social media records

- Vendor communication: welcome packs, marketing requirements, bump-in details, final briefings, one-week-out reminders, and answering routine questions from approved information

- Tracking vendor marketing compliance — required posts, countdown banners, event shares — and chasing before every posting deadline

- Coordinating content creators and influencers: briefs, shoot dates, attendance, deliverables, chasing content and saving links

- Running influencer night logistics, voucher printing and distribution, and food send-outs

-
 (Klaviyo or similar) and SMS campaigns: briefing design, testing links, scheduling, recording open and click performance

- Updating the event website in WordPress/Elementor each cycle — dates, venue, map, parking, FAQs, vendor lineup, competition, images — and testing every link on desktop and mobile

-
 Event setup, social bios and pinned flyers across Instagram and TikTok

- Local outreach: community businesses, universities and TAFEs, flyer and banner distribution, local media and council invitations

- QR code and lead capture campaigns: landing page, signage, onsite testing, tagging leads by event

- Supplier and infrastructure bookings: power, cool rooms, equipment hire, barriers and lighting, cleaning and waste, security — booking, confirming, and following up delivery and collection

- Building the multi-day event run sheet and confirming every arrival time, shift and delivery against it

- Vendor commissions, reconciliation, and the final post-event report



What we're looking for

- Experience coordinating events, projects or operations remotely. Events experience is a strong bonus, but disciplined project coordination in any industry is highly regarded

- You are relentless about following up. A large part of this role is chasing people who haven't replied — politely, repeatedly, without being asked to

title: Legal Intake Specialist (Sales)
description:
ABOUT US

All 50 Law is a US-based, rapidly expanding personal injury law firm dedicated to helping individuals who have recently suffered an injury secure the legal support they need. We are quickly growing to become one of the largest marketing and referral-based law firms in the country. Behind our fast-paced, highly automated marketing machine is a powerhouse team: our founder is a Harvard Law School graduate, and our technical infrastructure is driven by a specialized team of product engineers holding Master’s degrees and PhDs in Computer Science. 



THE ROLE

This is not a traditional administrative legal role; it is a high-performance sales position designed for a natural closer. We are seeking an individual who is assertive and competitive, yet highly people-oriented and relationship-focused. You must operate with a strong sense of urgency and adaptability, requiring a candidate who possesses balanced independence and procedural discipline. In this role, the specialist sells via phone or digital channels. You will be someone who expertly manages a pipeline and drives revenue without face-to-face interaction. Your primary objective is to build rapid trust, skillfully overcome hesitations, and guide prospects to retain our partner law firms.



A DAY IN THE LIFE

When you log in to your dedicated workspace, you will immediately dive into our custom GoHighLevel CRM. Your day will be heavily phone-based and fast-paced. You will constantly monitor incoming pipelines and jump on fresh, warm leads the 
nt our marketing engine generates them.



You will spend your hours speaking directly with individuals who have recently experienced an injury, requiring you to balance empathy with strong conversational control. You will ask targeted qualifying questions, navigate objections, and firmly guide eligible prospects toward signing a representation agreement. Between calls, you will aggressively manage your sales pipeline, send follow-up text messages, emails, and update client records with meticulous accuracy. You are the vital first point of contact, operating at a high frequency to turn inbound inquiries into closed deals.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

*Jump on Fresh Leads: Act with speed to engage immediately with individuals who have suffered injuries. Because these are warm leads expecting your call, your "speed to lead" is critical in capturing their interest while they are actively exploring their legal options.



*Qualify & Convert: Actively listen and assess each caller's case eligibility based on strict, provided criteria. You will ask targeted questions to uncover key details, seamlessly transitioning from qualification to the close.



*Control the Conversation: Use persuasive, confident communication to "sell" the advantages of working with our legal network. You must expertly navigate objections, instill trust, and motivate prospective clients to take the next step of signing their agreements.



*Manage Multiple Channels: Juggle prospect communication across phone calls, SMS text messages, emails, and social media direct messages to ensure systematic follow-up.



*Accurate Execution: Maintain impeccable detail orientation while logging notes and updating statuses. Your procedural discipline ensures our automated systems fire correctly and client data is preserved.



WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT

*The "Hunter" Mentality: You are highly motivated, thrive on hitting targets, and get energized by closing deals. 



*Extroverted & Outgoing Personality: You are naturally comfortable asserting yourself and taking control of a conversation. You build rapport instantly and can handle emotionally charged situations with professional confidence.



*Phone Presence: You are comfortable spending the majority of your shift on the phone. You maintain a high level of enthusiasm, empathy, and energy from your first dial to your last.



*Communication Mastery: You possess fluent English with very little or no detectable accent, ensuring crystal-clear communication and immediate trust-building with our clientele.



*Technical Proficiency: You have hands-on experience navigating the GoHighLevel CRM (or similar advanced sales platforms) and can quickly adapt to our proprietary technological tools.



*Remote Work Ready: You have a dedicated and distraction-free home workspace, supported by a reliable, high-speed internet connection.



WHAT WE OFFER

*Competitive Base + Uncapped Commission: Start with a $10/hr base rate, augmented by a lucrative commission structure. High performers have the clear opportunity to push $40k+/yr in total compensation through uncapped commissions and performance incentives.



*Cutting-Edge Tech Stack: Work within a custom-built instance of GoHighLevel, supercharged by proprietary tools and automation developed in-house by our software engineering team.



*Warm, High-Intent Leads: 100% of the leads you engage with have actively requested our help and are expecting to hear from you.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include a link to a voice recording saying: "Hi Timothy, my name is [your name] with All 50 Law. I'm following up on the form you submitted to us through
 seeking legal representation. Please call me back at your earliest convenience." Applications without this recording will not be considered.

title: AI / Quant Trading Systems Developer – Python, AI Agents & Swing Trading
description:
## About the Project



I am looking for a highly capable Python / AI developer to help architect and build a private AI-powered investment research, swing-trading, event-detection, portfolio-management, backtesting, and risk-management platform.



This is NOT a virtual assistant position.



This is NOT simply an OpenAI/ChatGPT prompt-engineering position.



And I am NOT looking for someone to build a generic “AI trading bot” that immediately trades real money.



I am looking for a real developer who understands software engineering, APIs, financial-market data, AI/LLM integration, databases, automation, backtesting, and ideally algorithmic or systematic trading.



The initial project will focus on research, scanning, backtesting, paper trading, risk management, and decision support.



Live trading would only be considered much later and would require human approval and strict risk controls.



---



## WHAT WE WANT TO BUILD



The long-term goal is a private **AI Investment & Trading Command Center** containing several specialized systems.



### 1. Swing Trading Scanner



Continuously scan a defined universe of stocks for high-quality swing-trading setups based on measurable criteria such as:



- Price and volume

- Relative volume

- VWAP

- Moving averages

- Relative strength

- Breakouts/retests

- Support/resistance

- Volatility

- Liquidity

- Market regime

- Upcoming catalysts

- Risk/reward



The system should rank opportunities rather than simply produce hundreds of alerts.



---



### 2. Event / Catalyst Detection Engine



We want a specialized Event Radar capable of detecting potentially market-moving developments including:



- Breaking company news

- SEC filings

- Earnings and guidance

- FDA decisions

- Clinical-trial results

- Biotech catalysts

- M&A activity

- Major partnerships

- Government contracts

- Regulatory decisions

- Litigation developments

- Analyst changes

- Other events capable of materially repricing a security



The system should evaluate not only whether news sounds positive or negative, but:



- How significant the event is

- Whether the information is actually new

- Source reliability

- What the market expected beforehand

- Price/volume reaction after the event

- Whether the opportunity remains tradable or is already excessively extended



Primary-source information should be prioritized whenever possible.



---



## 3. AI Research Agent



Use LLMs to help interpret information rather than relying on AI for raw calculations.



The research system should be capable of:



- Reading SEC filings

- Reading company announcements

- Summarizing earnings

- Interpreting catalysts

- Comparing new information with previous disclosures

- Identifying bull and bear arguments

- Detecting contradictory information

- Identifying important risks

- Citing the underlying evidence/source



The system should distinguish confirmed information from rumors or low-confidence information.



AI should NOT invent market data or calculate important risk values itself.



Prices, volume, indicators, portfolio exposure, position sizing, P&L and similar calculations should be performed deterministically in Python from trusted data sources.



---



## 4. Trade Scoring System



Potential opportunities should receive transparent component scores rather than an unexplained AI recommendation.



Possible components include:



- Catalyst score

- Technical score

- Price/volume confirmation

- Liquidity

- Market regime

- Options/institutional confirmation

- Risk

- Overall setup quality



Every calculation and weighting should be auditable.



We eventually want to test whether each scoring component actually improves trading performance.



---



## 5. HARD RISK MANAGEMENT ENGINE



This is one of the most important parts of the project.



Risk management should be deterministic software — NOT controlled by the language model.



The system should eventually be capable of enforcing rules involving:



- Maximum risk per trade

- Position sizing

- Maximum daily/weekly losses

- Maximum drawdown

- Portfolio concentration

- Sector exposure

- Correlated positions

- Maximum number of simultaneous positions

- Liquidity requirements

- Maximum bid/ask spreads

- Minimum risk/reward

- Stale-data protection

- Kill switches



The risk engine must be capable of rejecting a trade even if the AI believes the opportunity is attractive.



---



## 6. Portfolio Management



Build a Master Portfolio dashboard capable of monitoring:



- Holdings

- Cost basis

- Market value

- Allocation

- Cash

- Gains/losses

- Dividend income

- Portfolio concentration

- Risk exposure

- Open swing trades

- Watchlists

- Upcoming portfolio catalysts



Initial portfolio data may be entered manually or imported.



Brokerage integration may be added later using secure official APIs.



No developer will receive brokerage usernames/passwords.



---



## 7. Trade Pipeline



Potential trades should progress through a structured workflow such as:



RESEARCH  

→ WATCHLIST  

→ SETUP  

→ READY  

→ ACTIVE  

→ CLOSED



Each opportunity should store:



- Ticker

- Timestamp

- Original price

- Catalyst

- Thesis

- Bull case

- Bear case

- Entry

- Stop/invalidation

- Target

- Risk/reward

- Position size

- Scores

- Sources

- Notes

- Outcome



---



## 8. Backtesting & Historical Replay



We want serious testing — not backtests designed to produce attractive screenshots.



The system should account for issues such as:



- Look-ahead bias

- Survivorship bias

- Delisted securities

- Corporate actions

- Historical point-in-time information

- Bid/ask spreads

- Slippage

- Transaction costs

- Realistic fills



A future capability should allow historical market days/events to be replayed chronologically without allowing the strategy to see future information.



---



## 9. Paper Trading / Shadow Mode



Before real capital is involved, the system should:



1. Generate signals live without trading

2. Record what would have happened

3. Paper trade qualifying strategies

4. Track results

5. Evaluate performance statistically



We want to measure metrics including:



- Expectancy

- Win rate

- Average winner

- Average loser

- Profit factor

- Maximum drawdown

- Risk-adjusted returns

- Performance by strategy

- Performance by catalyst type

- Performance by market regime

- Slippage

- False positives



---



## 10. Trading Journal & Learning Database



Every signal should be recorded — including trades we reject or choose not to take.



Over time we want to answer questions such as:



- Which setups produce the highest expectancy?

- Which catalyst types perform best?

- Does unusual options activity improve outcomes?

- Does waiting for VWAP confirmation improve performance?

- Which market environments hurt the strategy?

- Which scoring components actually add value?

- Does human intervention improve or hurt performance?



This database will become one of the most valuable parts of the system.



---



## 11. Daily Investment Brief



Eventually the platform should automatically generate a daily report containing:



- Portfolio status

- Important developments affecting holdings

- Overnight news

- Market environment

- Upcoming catalysts

- Watchlist changes

- Top swing-trade candidates

- High-impact event alerts

- Existing position updates

- Portfolio risk alerts

- Trades requiring review



It should also be perfectly capable of reporting:



**NO QUALIFYING SETUPS TODAY**



The system should never manufacture trades just because the user expects recommendations.



---



# EXPECTED TECHNOLOGY



Strong experience with several of the following is important:



- Python

- Pandas / NumPy

- FastAPI

- REST APIs

- WebSockets

- PostgreSQL

- Financial-market APIs

- Market-data APIs

- AI / LLM APIs

- OpenAI / Claude / similar models

- AI agents

- Git / GitHub

- Cloud deployment

- Secure API credential management

- Background workers / scheduled jobs

- Backtesting systems

- Data pipelines



Experience with any of the following is particularly valuable:



- Algorithmic trading

- Quantitative trading

- Systematic trading

- Stock-market data

- Options data

- Brokerage APIs

- SEC/EDGAR data

- TradingView

- Alpaca

- Interactive Brokers

- Schwab APIs

- Polygon/Massive

- Benzinga

- Financial news APIs



---



# SECURITY & DEVELOPMENT PRINCIPLES



The developer must understand that financial software requires significantly stronger controls than a normal automation project.



We expect:



- Clean source control

- Documentation

- Testing

- Logging

- Error handling

- Database backups

- Secrets management

- Least-privilege API permissions

- Development/test/production separation

- Auditable calculations

- Reproducible deployments



The developer will work inside infrastructure/accounts controlled by the project owner.



Credentials should not be hard-coded into source code.



---



# PHASE 1



We are NOT attempting to build everything above immediately.



The initial goal is to design the correct architecture and build an MVP.



Phase 1 will likely include:



- Market-data ingestion

- Portfolio/watchlist database

- Initial swing scanner

- Initial catalyst/news ingestion

- AI research workflow

- Transparent scoring system

- Deterministic risk calculations

- Trade pipeline

- Paper/shadow trading

- Performance database

- Basic private dashboard



If Phase 1 is successful, there is substantial opportunity for ongoing development.



---



# WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate is:



- An actual software developer

- Strong with Python

- Comfortable with APIs and databases

- Able to architect systems rather than simply follow tutorials

- Familiar with financial markets

- Familiar with systematic or algorithmic trading concepts

- Familiar with LLM/AI integration

- Comfortable explaining technical decisions to a non-developer

- Security conscious

- Careful with data

- Interested in testing assumptions rather than promising guaranteed returns



I value demonstrated ability more than degrees or certifications.



I would rather hire someone who tells me an idea is technically or statistically flawed than someone who simply agrees with everything I suggest.



---



# IMPORTANT



I am NOT looking for anyone promising guaranteed returns.



I am NOT looking for a black-box trading strategy.



I am NOT asking someone to immediately connect an AI model to a brokerage account and trade real money.



The objective is to build a measurable, auditable and progressively tested investment/trading research platform.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the exact words:



**EVENT ENGINE**



Then answer the following:



1. Describe the most sophisticated Python system you personally built.



2. Have you built an algorithmic trading, quantitative, backtesting, financial-market or brokerage-related application? Describe exactly what you built.



3. Which market-data or brokerage APIs have you personally integrated?



4. Explain one common mistake that can make a trading backtest appear profitable when the strategy would not actually have performed that way live.



5. If breaking Phase 3 clinical-trial results caused a stock to move dramatically in premarket trading, how would you architect a system to detect, verify, analyze and monitor the event?



6. How would you prevent an LLM from hallucinating a price, position size or other financially important calculation?



7. How would you securely store API/broker credentials?



8. Provide links to your GitHub, code samples, portfolio, or previous relevant work.



9. Provide your requested hourly rate and weekly availability.



Please answer the questions directly.



Generic AI-generated applications without specific examples of your own work will not be considered.



Strong applicants may be invited to complete a small PAID technical evaluation before being selected.

title: Cold Email + LinkedIn Infrastructure Lead | Microsoft Azure, Instantly, sbl.so | 10M Email
description:
We are a capital advisory firm. We help companies raise equity and debt, and we have a 25+ person team across several countries. Cold
 and LinkedIn are the entire top of our funnel. If outbound stops, the firm stops.



We are hiring ONE person to own that machine end to end. Not just campaigns. Not just copy. The infrastructure, the replies, the numbers. All of it.



OUR SETUP TODAY

-
: Microsoft inboxes on our own Azure tenants, around 100 inboxes per domain

- Volume: around 10,000,000
s a month, and it only goes up from here

- Sequencer: Instantly

- LinkedIn: sbl.so, 500 accounts

- Tracking is OFF. No open pixels, no link tracking, ever



If 10 million a month sounds normal to you, keep reading. If it sounds scary, this isn't your role.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



 infrastructure

- Domains bought in bulk, DNS, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, MX, across hundreds of domains

- Microsoft Azure / Entra ID / M365 tenants: setting them up, licensing, keeping each tenant's reputation clean, and knowing exactly what gets a tenant banned

- Warmup, ramp schedules, daily caps, and splitting volume across inboxes, domains and tenants without burning any of them

- Deliverability every single day: placement tests, seed lists, blacklist monitoring and delisting (Spamhaus, SURBL, UCEPROTECT), bounces, complaints, and bringing a domain or tenant back when it goes bad

- Suppression and opt-outs kept clean. That is deliverability too



Instantly

- Every campaign, sequence, sending account, schedule and setting

- Every inbox connected, healthy and actually sending



LinkedIn on sbl.so

- All 500 accounts logged in, inside safe limits, and not restricted

- Campaign and sequence setup

- You know how LinkedIn spots automation and spam, and you keep our accounts clear of it



Replies

- You handle every reply on
 and LinkedIn. Read it, answer it, send the good ones to our setters. A reply that waits a day is a dead lead.



Numbers

- Sends, bounces, replies, positive replies, meetings booked. Per campaign, per domain, per inbox, per tenant, per LinkedIn account. You report what matters, skip what doesn't, and act on it.



Data

- Lead sourcing, dedupe, enrichment, and a verification stack that keeps bounces low.



WHO WE WANT

Someone who runs this like it's their own business. Not like a job.



- You take ownership. Nobody will hand you a daily task list. You find the bottleneck, fix it, then tell us what you changed and what it did to the numbers.

- You don't ask a question every hour. You work it out, make the call, and bring us the result. Save questions for things that really need us, like spending money or something big breaking.

- You learn fast. New tool on Monday, running it properly by Friday.

- You're a GTM engineer, not just an operator. APIs, scripts, webhooks, your own dashboards when the tool falls short. If something repeats, you automate it.

- You're careful. One wrong DNS record or one dirty list can burn a domain. You check your work.

- You're reachable. Our prospects are in the US, Europe and the Middle East, so replies land 24 hours a day. You keep an eye on it around the clock, nights and weekends too, and you answer fast.



This seat grows. Infrastructure first, then the full outbound motion, then a team under you. We want someone who stays for years and grows into owning GTM for the firm.



WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY

- Your cold
 experience is a few hundred sends from one Gmail account

- You've never set up a Microsoft tenant or bought domains in bulk

- You need step-by-step instructions to get moving

- You want to run this alongside other clients. This is full-time and dedicated

- You can only be reachable during a fixed 8-hour shift



COMPENSATION

- $1,000 - $1,500 USD per month, depending on what you actually know. Show us the top of that range and we'll pay it

- Full-time, long term. We're hiring for years, not for a project

- You work directly with the founder



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word TENANT so we know you read this. Then answer these, short and specific:



1. The largest sending operation you've personally run:
s per day, inboxes, domains, tenants, and reply rate.

2. We run about 100 inboxes per domain on Azure tenants. What do you think of that ratio, and how would you split 10 million
s a month across tenants, domains and inboxes?

3. We need 1,000 new Microsoft inboxes live this month. Walk us through it: tenants, domains, DNS, warmup, and the ramp you'd use.

4. A sending domain just hit SURBL and placement dropped overnight. What are your first three moves?

5. 30 of our 500 LinkedIn accounts got restricted this week. What do you check first, and what do you change?

6. What's your
 verification stack, and what bounce rate do you hold?

7. Which tools have you actually run? (Instantly, sbl.so, Smartlead,
Bison, HeyReach, Aimfox, Apollo, Clay, etc.) Which APIs have you written scripts against?



Answer in your own words. Pasted AI answers are obvious and get deleted. A short Loom walking through infrastructure you've built is a big plus. Applications that ignore these instructions are deleted unread.

title: Social Media Video Editor and Community Manager (Part-Time, 25 hrs/week, US Electrical Contractor)
description:
About us

Atomic Electric Service is a residential electrical contractor in East Tennessee, USA. Our crews do panel upgrades, wiring, lighting, generators, and repairs for homeowners. We are building a social media program that shows our real work and our real people. We need one reliable person to edit our videos, design our graphics, schedule our posts, and answer our comments and messages.



What you will do

• Edit short vertical videos (under 60 seconds) from raw footage our crew films on jobs, using our CapCut template.

• Design graphics in Canva from our brand templates. These include tips carousels, review cards, crew spotlights, before and after photos, and hiring posts.

• Write captions for each platform from the content brief we give you each week.

• Schedule posts for
, Instagram, Google Business Profile, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. Post to Nextdoor directly.

• Reply to comments, messages, and reviews in a friendly, professional tone, and send customer leads to our office.

• Keep our shared Google Drive folders organized and on schedule.

• Send a short weekly report with our posting and response numbers.



Schedule

Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM US Eastern Time. That is 9:00 PM to 2:00 AM Philippine time from November to early March, and 8:00 PM to 1:00 AM from March to early November. No weekend work. You must be online and responsive during these hours, because this is when our customers message us. Any extra hours must be approved in advance.



Pay and terms

• $8 to $11 USD per hour, paid for the hours you log.

• Your starting rate is set by your score on a paid test task.

• We do a written review at 90 days. If your posting and response targets are met, your rate goes to $11 per hour.

• There is a 13th-month bonus each December, prorated in your first year.

• This is an independent contractor role.

• Start date: November 2, 2026.



Required skills

• Vertical video editing for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts: tight cuts, on-screen captions, clean audio, and pacing that holds attention. You must know CapCut.

• Canva design: you can work inside a brand template and keep fonts, colors, and spacing consistent.

• Strong written English. Our customers are American homeowners, so your captions and replies must sound natural to them.

• Experience with Meta Business Suite and at least one scheduling tool.

• Reliable internet and backup power (UPS, generator, or mobile data backup).



Nice to have

• Experience with Google Business Profile, LinkedIn company pages, or Nextdoor.

• Experience working for a home service business (electrical, HVAC, plumbing, roofing).



How to apply

Send the following. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed.

1. Put "SHIFT" in your subject line so we know you read the full post.

2. Links to 3 vertical videos you edited, and 1 sentence each on what you did.

3. Links or images of 3 Canva designs you made for a business.

4. A screenshot of your internet speed test, and a sentence on your backup power.

5. Confirmation that you can work 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM US Eastern, Monday to Friday, starting November 2.

6. Short answers to these two questions:
