title: Calling All Organised Asset Management Assistants! Join Our UK Property Team — with 13th Month Bonus
description:
Hi, thanks for checking out our job posting!



If you're an organised, proactive and detail-focused person who takes pride in getting things done properly, we'd love to hear from you. At London Executive, we're building a different kind of property agency — one where homes are managed with purpose, clients are cared for, and no detail is left to chance. When you join us, you'll be part of a team that values Family, Health, Contribution, Stepping Up and Owning It, while giving you the support, coaching and development opportunities to grow. This is a long-term, fully remote role working UK hours, with paid vacation and sick leave, a 13th-month bonus, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how we operate and grow.



WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING WITH US…



You'll be joining a company that's deliberately building a different kind of agency — focused on purpose, care, professionalism and high standards. You'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our operations and help improve the way we work. 



We believe growth should be part of everyday work, with coaching, regular 1:1s, feedback, development reviews, team huddles and opportunities to share learning. You'll be trusted to take ownership, contribute ideas and help make our systems, processes and client experience better. 



You'll work with a team that genuinely cares about both what we achieve and how we achieve it.



This is a long-term opportunity, not a short-term contract.

You'll have paid vacation and sick leave, plus an end-of-year 13th-month bonus.

You'll work remotely while collaborating with a team focused on delivering a high standard of service.





THE ROLE WE ARE HIRING FOR



Asset Management Assistant

As our Asset Management Assistant, you'll provide reliable, proactive administrative and operational support to the Asset Manager.



You'll help keep the moving parts of property management organised and progressing — from maintenance and repairs through to compliance, inspections, tenancy support, deposit processing and property records. This role is about more than simply completing admin tasks. We need someone who takes ownership of the details, follows things through, communicates clearly and notices when something needs attention.



Key Responsibilities:

-Support the Asset Manager with day-to-day property management administration and maintenance coordination.

-Coordinate maintenance requests, including emergencies, and communicate with tenants, landlords and contractors.

-Schedule repairs and follow up with contractors and relevant parties to ensure outstanding work progresses.

-Ensure completed repair works have been satisfactorily addressed and property records are updated.

-Support tenant and landlord queries throughout the tenancy lifecycle.

-Arrange pre-tenancy works and provide new tenants with relevant property information.

-Process and coordinate tenant deposits for release, including organising deduction lists and supporting evidence.

-Ensure eligible tenant deposits are processed and released within the required legal timeframe.

-Maintain accurate property compliance records in our CRM, including gas safety certificates, EPCs, electrical inspection certificates and other required documentation.

-Identify missing, incomplete, approaching or expired compliance documentation and escalate appropriately.

-Run property inspection due reports and coordinate inspection appointments with tenants.

-Prepare inspection templates, highlight areas requiring attention and finalise reports following Asset Manager feedback.

-Send completed inspection reports to landlords and maintain accurate inspection schedules.

-Keep taskboards, project boards and relevant operational systems up to date.

-Log support tickets, manage handovers and complete other accountability requirements.

-Help update Standard Operating Procedures and suggest improvements to processes and systems.

-Assist the Asset Manager during Property Management meetings, including taking notes.

-Answer incoming office calls, reserve keys for contractors, pass messages to the Lettings team and manage the Repairs mailbox.

-Complete required training and participate actively in weekly Script Practice, 1:1s and Monthly Development Reviews.

-Keep developing your knowledge of systems, automation and AI tools that can improve efficiency, accuracy and service delivery.





Personality Traits that best suit this role:

-Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities.

-Proactive — you notice what needs doing and take action.

-Detail-oriented and accurate.

-Reliable and strong on follow-through.

-Calm and professional under pressure.

-Caring and service-minded.

-Confident enough to speak up and step outside your comfort zone.

-A natural problem solver who looks for solutions rather than excuses.

-Curious and genuinely willing to learn.

-Collaborative and supportive of others.

-Comfortable taking responsibility and owning outcomes.

-Adaptable and open to new systems, technology, automation and AI.

-Trustworthy and discreet when handling confidential information.





Required Skills & Experience:

-Strong organisation and time-management skills.

-Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

-Clear and professional written and verbal communication.

-Ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines and follow-ups.

-Strong problem-solving and initiative.

-A customer-service mindset and genuine care for tenants and landlords.

-Ability to manage property-management administration across maintenance, inspections, compliance and tenancy support.

-Confidence using operational software and systems, with the ability to learn new tools quickly.

-Strong teamwork and collaboration.

-Demonstrated ownership, accountability and reliability.

-Willingness to learn and adopt appropriate AI and automation tools.

-Professional discretion and confidentiality.





Preferred Qualifications:

-Previous property management or property administration experience.

-Experience working with UK residential property.

-Experience coordinating contractors, maintenance or property inspections.

-Experience with tenancy administration or deposit processing.

-Familiarity with property-management software and digital task-management systems.

*Note: These are preferred rather than mandatory qualifications.





THE IMPORTANCE OF THIS ROLE



This role helps turn London Executive's promise of clarity, care, confidence and professional property management into the day-to-day experience of landlords and tenants.



You're the person helping ensure that the details don't fall through the cracks. Maintenance gets followed through. Compliance records stay current. Inspections happen on time. Deposits are processed accurately. Queries are progressed. Information remains organised. You'll own the coordination and follow-through, while the Asset Manager retains responsibility for higher-level judgement and decisions. 



Done well, your work gives the Asset Manager the support needed to focus on asset management while helping London Executive deliver the reliable, responsive and professional service our clients and tenants expect.





OUR STORY

London Executive was established in 1992 by the founders' parents and has grown around a focus on selling and letting some of the best homes in Central London.



The company has developed a distinctive approach to marketing and is committed to providing world-class customer service.

Today, London Executive describes itself as a different kind of agency. We aim to guide clients with confidence, protect their interests, and provide a concierge-style experience where properties are in expert hands.



We recognise that property decisions often happen during periods of change, pressure, hope or uncertainty. That's why clarity, calm, care, professionalism, empathy and creativity are central to the experience we want to create.



OUR MISSION

To redefine what it means to sell, let, and manage homes by doing things differently with purpose, creativity, and care.





WHY WE’RE A GREAT PLACE TO WORK



We believe culture is one of our greatest advantages.



We're building a high-performance team based on trust, accountability, open communication, high standards and a genuine commitment to helping one another succeed.



High performance is part of how we work. We set high standards, prepare well, embrace feedback, take initiative and focus on meaningful outcomes rather than appearances. We believe you can care deeply about people while also expecting great work — and that the two should go hand in hand.



Development isn't something that only happens during a formal review. Coaching is part of how we work. You'll have regular 1:1s, feedback, development reviews, team huddles and opportunities to share what you're learning.

title: Local SEO Specialist - Google Business Profile Management
description:
To apply:
 
 with the subject line LOCAL SEO SPECIALIST. The application steps are at the end of this post.



About the role

We're Blue Crocus Solutions, a Canadian SEO and web development agency. We work only with local home service businesses in the United States and Canada. Most of our clients run junk removal and dumpster rental companies. The rest are plumbers, painters, pest control companies and similar trades.



We're hiring a Local SEO Specialist to own how our clients show up on Google Maps, Bing and Apple Maps. The role covers more than 100 Google Business Profiles across about 35 clients, plus each client's Bing Places and Apple Maps listings.



This is hands-on work. You'll audit listings, fix what's broken, chase verifications to the finish and keep every profile accurate month after month. When something goes wrong, you tell your team lead the same day. Then you write down how you fixed it so that the next person can do it too.



What you'll do

- Google Business Profile. Audit and optimize every listing: primary and secondary categories, services with real descriptions, accurate hours, attributes, photos and weekly posts. Check that the page each profile links to matches what the profile says.

- Fixes and recoveries. Handle suspensions and reinstatement requests, video verifications, wrong map pins, duplicate listings, and ownership and access transfers. You see each one through until the listing is live and correct.

- Bing Places and Apple Maps. Claim, verify and manage every client's listing on Bing Places for Business and Apple Business (formerly Apple Business Connect). Keep each one matching the Google profile.

Reviews. Respond to every review within 48 hours in the client's voice. Help clients keep a steady flow of new written reviews within Google's rules. Flag missing or fake reviews early.

- Spam and competitors. Watch the local map results for fake listings and keyword-stuffed business names, and report them to Google through the proper channels.

- Consistency across the web. Work with our citation specialist so that the business name, address and phone number match on every platform, from Yelp and
 to the home service directories.

- Tracking and reporting. Run local rank grids and read each profile's calls, website clicks and direction requests every month. Explain what moved and why in plain language.

- Documentation. Keep our local SEO SOPs current in Waybook, our company playbook, as you learn and improve the process.



How we measure this role

Calls, website clicks and direction requests across our clients' Business Profiles, read every month. The goal is steady growth month over month.



Your first 90 days

Month 1. Learn our 2026 Business Profile checklist and audit every listing against it.

Month 2. Every client claimed, verified and matching on Bing Places and Apple Maps.

Month 3. Monthly reporting running for every client, with the next fixes listed per account.



This role is a great fit if you

- Have managed Google Business Profiles for local service businesses, for clients and at volume

- Have gotten a suspended profile reinstated and can explain what caused the suspension

- Know when a service area business should hide its address and when it should show it

- Follow a checklist as carefully on the 80th listing as on the first

- Tell your lead about a problem the day you find it, without being asked

- Write clear, friendly English that a busy business owner understands at a glance

- Write down how you did something so that someone else can repeat it



This role is not a fit if you

- Think local SEO means buying hundreds of directory listings

- Would stuff keywords into a business name or show fake 24/7 hours to rank higher

- Need reminders to follow up

- Count a task as done when it's submitted, before it's live and verified

- Go quiet when something breaks



Requirements

- At least 2 years of hands-on Google Business Profile work for multiple businesses, ideally at an agency

- Working knowledge of Bing Places for Business and Apple Maps listings

- A solid grasp of Google's Business Profile guidelines and what gets a listing suspended

- Fluent written and spoken English

- Comfortable on a call with a US or Canadian business owner when a verification needs them

- Available to overlap with US Eastern business hours (we'll discuss the schedule)

- Reliable internet and a quiet place to work



Bonus points

- BrightLocal, or a rank grid tool such as Local Falcon

- Yelp for Business,
 business pages and home service directories

- Experience with junk removal, dumpster rental or other trades clients

- Google Search Console and Google Analytics basics

- Using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT to work faster, and checking what they produce



What we offer

- A long-term, full-time role with a growing agency

- Clear SOPs and an up-to-date 2026 Business Profile checklist, so that you know what good looks like

- Regular check-ins with a team lead who knows local SEO

- Room to grow as our local program grows



How to apply

- Follow these steps exactly. We won't review applications that skip any answer.

- Start your application with this sentence: "Every pin in the right place."

- Record a 3 to 5 minute video on Loom or similar. Pick any junk removal company in a US city of your choice and open its Google Business Profile. Walk us through the first fixes you would make and why.

- A client's Business Profile was suspended yesterday. What do you do in the first 48 hours? Be specific about the steps, what you check and what you tell the client.

- A new client has no Bing Places or Apple Maps listing. How do you get each one live and verified, and what do you need from the client?

- A junk removal owner runs the business from home and serves a 30 mile area. Should the Business Profile show the address? Explain your reasoning.

- Tell us about a time a listing or project went wrong on your watch. What happened, who did you tell and when?

- If you were an animal, what animal would you be and why?

- What does this quote mean to you personally? "Work is love made visible." (Khalil Gibran)

- Find a random fact about our founder, Lewis Vandervalk, and cite your source.

- Attach your resume to the
.



Blue Crocus Solutions is a remote-first agency. We value reliable, self-directed people who own their work and see it through. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: HubSpot CRM & Client Operations Specialist
description:
Remote — Philippines | Full-time after a paid two-week trial | Monday–Friday, U.S. Eastern Time



BUILD HUBSPOT. THEN OWN THE FOLLOW-THROUGH.



MajestIQ is hiring one person who can set up HubSpot properly and keep our prospect and client communication organized every day.



Your first priority will be HubSpot: understand our process, assess what is already in the account, organize the data, configure the pipeline, and make follow-up reliable. You will then maintain and improve HubSpot while handling routine prospect and client communication, onboarding coordination, scheduling, and administrative work. Both parts are ongoing responsibilities.



You need hands-on implementation experience. You should be able to explain a HubSpot setup you personally built, why you made particular choices, what problems you solved, and how you verified the result. Using a CRM someone else configured is not enough for this role.



ABOUT MAJESTIQ



MajestIQ supports established Amazon sellers by collecting and preparing evidence concerning policy-violating and inauthentic review content and providing it to the appropriate teams at Amazon. Amazon makes every final decision.



You will work directly with the founders in a small team. We need someone who takes ownership, writes clearly, notices missing steps, and follows through without repeated reminders.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



HubSpot setup and maintenance:

• Audit the existing account and turn our sales and onboarding process into a usable CRM workflow. The account is currently on HubSpot Free; work within approved features and identify any upgrade dependency before implementation.

• Organize contacts, companies, deals, associations, pipeline stages, properties, and imports; prevent duplicates and resolve them while preserving useful data and activity history.

• Establish dated next actions, follow-up queues, useful views, and reporting available within the approved subscription.

• Configure and troubleshoot supported native or no-code integrations for
, calendars, agreements, and related workflows.

• Recognize subscription limitations and explain practical alternatives before recommending an upgrade.

• Test each configured workflow, verify the saved records and follow-up tasks, and document unresolved dependencies.

• Document the setup and teach the team how to use it. Our technical team handles custom dashboard development.



Client coordination and administration:

• Reply to routine prospect and client questions using approved information. Check the facts before answering; escalate commercial exceptions, sensitive disputes, and unresolved questions outside the documented process to Joe or Kristen.

• Send product-selection links, coordinate calls, track replies, and keep follow-ups moving.

• Coordinate agreements and onboarding steps, keeping HubSpot current as work happens, with a clear owner and dated next action.

• Handle calendar management, document coordination, invoice-follow-up administration, and other routine tasks between client conversations.

• Use HubSpot, Gmail, Slack, Calendly, PandaDoc, and our dashboard confidently.



WHAT YOU BRING



• A HubSpot implementation or substantial rebuild you personally completed, with specific examples you can discuss.

• Strong professional written and spoken English.

• Sound judgment, careful data handling, and reliable follow-through.

• Ability to understand an unfamiliar business process, identify gaps, and turn it into a usable HubSpot workflow.

• Comfort explaining technical choices in plain language.

• A reliable work setup and availability for the required Philippines evening/overnight schedule.



Amazon or e-commerce experience is preferred, not required. HubSpot certifications are welcome, but we assess what you can actually do.



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



• Paid trial: two weeks, Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–noon U.S. Eastern Time. Four hours per day, 40 scheduled hours total, paid at $11/hour ($440 for the full trial).

• After the trial: Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time, 40 hours per week. No weekend requirement.

• Pay: $11/hour initially, $12/hour after 90 days, and $13/hour after six months.

• Benefits: paid Philippine holidays.



The Eastern schedule follows New York daylight-saving changes, so the corresponding Philippine time shifts by one hour during the year.



HIRING PROCESS



1. Complete the 10–15 minute application below, including a HubSpot build example and two short work scenarios.

2. We review your experience, writing, availability, and any details needing clarification.

3. Shortlisted applicants complete a paid 45–60 minute live HubSpot exercise using fictional data. Payment is $25 for completing the exercise, regardless of the result. With your consent, we record the screen-share for the hiring review.

4. The strongest candidates meet with the founder, followed by consent-based reference checks and written trial terms.

5. The selected candidate begins the paid two-week trial, with a full-time engagement for the right fit.



You may use documentation and disclosed AI assistance during the skills exercise, but must perform and explain your own work. Never share another employer's confidential information.



APPLY HERE: 



Please use the application form so we can review the same information for every applicant. A generic platform message or cover letter does not replace the application.



If you can build a CRM that people actually use and take responsibility for the work moving through it, we would like to hear from you.

title: Paralegal
description:
About the job



About Rosenbaum & Segall, P.C.



Rosenbaum & Segall, P.C. is a New York–based law firm founded by CJ Rosenbaum, with Rob Segall as Managing Partner, built around a simple mission: help people and companies navigate problems on Amazon and other online marketplaces. We work both sides of the marketplace. Through our Amazon Sellers Lawyer practice, we represent sellers, brands, and current and former Amazon employees facing account suspensions, intellectual property disputes, arbitration, and other issues that put their livelihoods at risk on the platform. Through our Brand Protection Amazon practice, we help rights holders enforce their intellectual property — trademarks, copyrights, and patents — and remove unauthorized sellers and counterfeit listings across Amazon, Walmart, Alibaba, and other major marketplaces worldwide.



Our attorneys and paralegals handle the legal work directly, and our team's insight into how these marketplaces actually operate has made us a go-to resource in the space — we've been featured in Bloomberg, CNBC, Forbes, Fox Business, and The Wall Street Journal. Across both practices, we've recovered more than $100 million for clients, protected tens of thousands of product listings from counterfeiters, and built lasting relationships with thousands of clients around the world. Every client relationship is protected by attorney-client privilege, and nobody on our team is permitted to sell on Amazon themselves.



Many of the sellers and brand owners who come to us have already tried somewhere else first — expensive courses, self-proclaimed "gurus," or firms that overpromise and under-deliver, sometimes leaving people worse off than when they started. By the time a matter reaches litigation, someone's business is genuinely on the line, and the quality of the support behind our attorneys shows up directly in the outcome.



We're growing our paralegal team in the Philippines and looking for people who want to build a real career in a fast-moving, high-stakes niche of legal services.



This Role



You'll be a virtual paralegal in our litigation department, working directly alongside our attorneys, who are licensed and based in New York and Florida. The work runs from onboarding a new matter through to supporting it in active litigation or arbitration.



You'll own the organizational backbone of the department — calendar,
, tasks, and deadlines — and you'll run our case management system, converting new matters from Clio Grow into Clio Manage and building out the file from there. Alongside that, you'll assist in drafting the documents our attorneys review and file: complaints, motions, discovery requests and responses, responses to cease and desist letters, and demands for arbitration. All legal advice and final work product comes from the supervising attorney; your job is to make sure they always have what they need, when they need it, in good shape.



This is a fully remote role for candidates based in the Philippines, working U.S. Eastern-time hours alongside our clients and legal team.



What You'll Do



Case Management & Organization



Run calendar,
, task management, and overall department organization so deadlines and follow-ups never slip Schedule client appointments and coordinate attorney availability Handle file creation and matter conversion from Clio Grow to Clio Manage, and keep matter records accurate and current in Clio Maintain document organization across active litigation files for fast retrieval



Drafting & Litigation Support- Assist senior attorney in general.







Administrative & Data



Support billing and transaction entry, keeping time and expenses recorded accurately Handle data entry and data gathering — including pulling listing, seller, and public-record information needed to build out a matter Escalate promptly to the supervising attorney whenever a matter calls for legal judgment Work Eastern-time hours (9 AM–6 PM ET) in step with our clients and legal team



Who We Have in Mind



Must-Haves



Based in the Philippines and legally able to work as an independent contractor Prior paralegal experience supporting litigation — drafting, discovery, exhibit preparation, and case management  with hands-on experience in both Clio Grow and Clio Manage Strong written English. Your drafts go to an attorney for review and then out the door, so precision, grammar, clear structure matter and confidence. Genuine organization and deadline discipline — you're holding the calendar for a litigation department, and much of this work is unforgiving of small errors and sound judgment about confidentiality. 



Ability to work Eastern-time hours (9 AM–6 PM ET) consistently — that's roughly 9 PM–6 AM Philippine time, shifting by an hour with U.S. daylight saving, so you should be genuinely set up for a night shift A genuinely quiet home workspace, your own high-speed internet connection and computer, with the ability to use our VoIP phone system and join video calls. A Wise/Paypal account, as monthly salary is paid via Wise/Paypal at the end of each month





This Role Might Not Be For You If



You can't hold a night-shift schedule aligned to U.S. Eastern time on a consistent basis. 

You haven't worked in a case management system before and would rather not own one 

You'd rather work independently with minimal check-ins — this role runs on close, daily coordination with our attorneys 

You'd rather focus on one matter at a time than carry a full litigation docket with competing deadlines



Before applying, take a few minutes to look us up — search CJ Rosenbaum, check out our YouTube channel, find us on TikTok 
 look at our
, X, and Instagram 
 or visit 
 — so you have a real sense of what we do for clients on both sides of the marketplace.



Compensation & Benefits



Monthly salary paid via Wise/Paypal,

13th month bonus, paid in two installments (half in June, half in December) 

10 paid days off per year (combined sick and holiday), 

available after 6 months with the firm — usable up to 5 consecutive days at a time

HMO after 6 months with the firm



How to Apply



Submit your resume along with a short note on your litigation paralegal background and your experience with Clio or similar platform.

For faster process,
 your application letter and resume to: 







Screening Questions



Are you based in the Philippines?

Have you worked in both Clio Grow and Clio Manage? 

Do you have, or can you set up, a wise/paypal account for monthly salary payment?

title: Real Estate Sales Manager (100% Commission Uncapped)
description:
Position Overview

Apollo & Rose Capital Inc. (“ARC”) is seeking an experienced, highly motivated Real Estate Sales Broker Manager to lead, develop, and drive production within ARC’s Real Estate Financing Division. This is a full-time, remote, 100% commission-based position designed for a proven sales professional who understands U.S. real estate investment financing and possesses the leadership ability to convert opportunities into funded transactions while developing a high-performing sales organization.

The successful candidate must possess substantive working knowledge of U.S. real estate investment financing, including Fix & Flip Loans, Debt Service Coverage Ratio (“DSCR”) Loans, Ground-Up Construction Loans, and Bridge Loans. This position requires considerably more than general sales experience. ARC is seeking an individual who understands real estate investors, can evaluate and discuss investment transactions intelligently, can identify the appropriate financing product based upon a borrower’s objectives and transaction structure, and can effectively manage sales representatives through the entire financing pipeline.

Compensation & Earning Potential

This position is 100% commission-based with no cap on commissions or earning potential. Compensation is directly tied to production and funded transactions in accordance with ARC’s applicable commission plan.

ARC’s current sales representatives earn approximately $4,850 to $8,000 per month in commissions, depending upon individual production and successfully completed transactions. This range reflects current representative earnings and is not a guarantee of future compensation. A Sales Broker Manager with strong personal production, effective pipeline management, repeat investor relationships, and a productive sales team has the opportunity to exceed this range because commissions and earnings are uncapped.

Essential Responsibilities

The Real Estate Sales Broker Manager will be responsible for both sales leadership and revenue production. The Manager will oversee real estate financing opportunities from initial prospect contact through qualification, application, lender/program matching, transaction progression, and closing while ensuring accurate and timely CRM documentation.

Primary responsibilities include developing and managing a pipeline of real estate investors, developers, builders, landlords, brokers, wholesalers, and other qualified prospects; conducting financing discovery calls; evaluating borrower objectives and transaction characteristics; explaining appropriate financing solutions; maintaining disciplined follow-up; and working collaboratively with ARC Operations and lending partners to advance qualified transactions toward funding.

The Manager will also be expected to lead and develop ARC’s Real Estate Sales Representatives, establish performance expectations, review pipelines, monitor follow-up activity, coach representatives on sales execution and product knowledge, identify stalled opportunities, conduct regular accountability meetings, and drive measurable production throughout the division.

Required Real Estate Financing Knowledge

Candidates MUST possess demonstrable knowledge and practical understanding of the following four core financing products:

1. Fix & Flip Loans — Candidates must understand acquisition and rehabilitation financing for investment properties, including purchase price, rehabilitation budget, after-repair value (“ARV”), loan-to-cost (“LTC”), loan-to-value/after-repair-value considerations, borrower experience, liquidity, exit strategy, and short-term investment financing structures.

2. DSCR Loans — Candidates must understand rental-property financing based primarily upon property cash flow and debt-service coverage, including the DSCR calculation, rental income, PITIA/debt-service considerations, LTV, property type, purchase versus refinance transactions, and common investor qualification considerations.

3. Ground-Up Construction Loans — Candidates must understand financing for new residential investment construction, including land acquisition or ownership, construction budgets, project costs, completed value, borrower/developer experience, draw structures, construction timelines, liquidity, and exit strategies.

4. Bridge Loans — Candidates must understand short-term real estate financing used to bridge acquisitions, refinances, property stabilization, liquidity events, and other time-sensitive investment transactions, including collateral, leverage, term, repayment strategy, and exit planning.

Candidates unable to confidently discuss these products with experienced real estate investors should not apply.

Sales Leadership & Management

The Real Estate Sales Broker Manager will establish and maintain a performance-driven sales culture built upon responsiveness, professionalism, accountability, accurate product knowledge, disciplined follow-up, and measurable results.

The Manager will be expected to monitor representative activity and performance across critical metrics, including:

Lead Contact → Discovery → Pre-Qualification → Application → Documentation → Program/Lender Match → Submission → Term Structure → Closing → Funded Transaction → Repeat Business/Referral

The Manager must ensure that sales representatives understand that the objective is not merely to generate activity, but to create qualified opportunities and funded transactions.

Investor & Referral Relationship Development

The Manager will actively develop relationships with real estate investors, developers, builders, landlords, real estate brokers and agents, wholesalers, property managers, contractors, investor organizations, and other appropriate referral sources.

ARC places significant emphasis on developing repeat borrowers. Accordingly, the Manager should be capable of turning an initial transaction into a long-term financing relationship by understanding the investor’s acquisition strategy, portfolio objectives, future projects, and anticipated financing requirements.

CRM & Pipeline Accountability

The successful candidate must be comfortable operating within a structured CRM environment and will be responsible for ensuring that all leads, communications, appointments, applications, documents, follow-ups, transaction stages, and material developments are accurately recorded within ARC’s designated systems.

The Manager will work closely with Operations to maintain an orderly Sales-to-Operations handoff and ensure that qualified transactions contain the information necessary for efficient processing.

Professional & Compliance Standards

The Real Estate Sales Broker Manager must maintain professional, accurate, and compliant communications with prospective borrowers, clients, referral partners, lenders, and ARC personnel.

Representatives must never guarantee loan approval, interest rates, leverage, appraisal values, loan amounts, closing dates, funding, construction draws, or other lender decisions. Financing terms are subject to applicable underwriting, lender requirements, transaction characteristics, documentation, and applicable law.

The Manager is responsible for reinforcing these standards throughout the Real Estate Sales Team.

Required Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience in real estate investment lending, private lending, hard-money lending, commercial mortgage brokerage, real estate finance, or a closely related field, together with a proven record of sales production and leadership.

Candidates should possess excellent communication and negotiation skills; strong knowledge of investment-property transactions; experience managing pipelines and sales personnel; the ability to communicate confidently with sophisticated investors and developers; proficiency with CRM systems; strong organizational discipline; and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Experience developing referral relationships and repeat-investor business is strongly preferred.

Work Schedule & Remote Expectations

This is a full-time remote position requiring a 40-hour weekly work schedule. The successful candidate must maintain reliable availability during established ARC business hours, participate in required company and departmental meetings, maintain professional video-call standards, respond promptly to assigned opportunities, and consistently satisfy established sales and management expectations.

Remote work does not reduce the position’s accountability, responsiveness, productivity, or performance requirements.

The Opportunity

ARC is building a scalable real estate financing platform designed around investor relationships, disciplined sales execution, repeat transactions, and access to multiple financing solutions.

This position is suited for an experienced real estate finance professional who wants compensation tied directly to performance rather than constrained by a traditional salary structure.

100% Commission. Uncapped Earnings. Full-Time Opportunity.

Current ARC sales representatives earn approximately $4,850–$8,000 per month, based upon individual production. There is no contractual earnings ceiling; actual compensation depends upon performance, funded transactions, commission terms, and other applicable requirements.

About Apollo & Rose Capital Inc.

title: Product Manager
description:
Full-Time | Remote | No Graveyard Hours



BUILD PRODUCTS. SOLVE PROBLEMS. GROW INTO PRODUCT MANAGEMENT.



We are a growing UK-based e-commerce company selling physical products across the USA, UK and other international markets, with a focus on children's products and elderly care products.



We are looking for a highly organised, curious and analytical person to join our team as a Product Research & Development Coordinator.



This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build a long-term career in product research, product development and product management.



You will help us identify what products we should develop, how existing products can be improved, and coordinate the process of turning ideas into real products.



THE ROLE



You will work closely with our China-based Sourcing & Product Development Specialist, who manages supplier communication, sourcing and development on the ground in China.



Your focus will be on the research, product requirements, development coordination and project management side.



You will help take products through the process:



Research → Product Idea → Product Brief → Samples → Improvements → Final Product → Launch



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



Product Research & Innovation



• Research new product opportunities, competitors, customer needs and market trends.

• Analyse customer reviews and feedback to identify problems and opportunities.

• Research products we already sell and identify ways to improve them.

• Develop ideas for new features, designs, materials and functionality.

• Maintain a pipeline of potential new products.



Product Development



• Create clear product briefs, specifications and requirements.

• Communicate product requirements to our China-based specialist.

• Coordinate samples, revisions, packaging, dimensions and product details.

• Work with designers, engineers, testing laboratories and other professionals when required.

• Track product development projects and ensure deadlines and actions are followed through.



Product Management & Coordination



• Keep product information, specifications and documentation organised.

• Coordinate multiple product development projects.

• Identify problems or delays early and propose solutions.

• Research product compliance and testing requirements.

• Support patent/IP research and competitor monitoring.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who genuinely wants a career in product research, development and product management.



You should be:



• Highly organised and detail-oriented.

• Naturally curious about products and customers.

• Strong at research, analysis and problem-solving.

• Able to manage multiple projects independently.

• Proactive — you identify problems rather than wait for instructions.

• An excellent written communicator.

• Comfortable using AI tools and learning new technology.

• Interested in understanding why a product succeeds or fails, not simply completing tasks.



Experience in product research, product development, product management, e-commerce, Amazon, manufacturing, sourcing, operations or project coordination is an advantage.



THE MOST IMPORTANT THING



If you want to eventually be the person who can say:



“I have researched this opportunity, identified what customers need, developed the product requirements and coordinated the team to bring it to market.”



We want you to apply.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



Please answer these questions in detail. We are interested in how you think, not just your CV.



1. Product Research



Tell us about a physical product you have researched, developed, improved or managed. What did you actually do?



2. Finding Opportunities



Give us an example of how customer reviews, feedback or competitor research led you to identify a product improvement or new opportunity. What did you recommend?



3. Coordination



Tell us about a project where you had to coordinate several people or moving parts. How did you keep everything organised and moving forward?



4. Problem Solving



Tell us about a problem you identified before other people noticed it. What did you do?



5. Product Thinking



If a children's product receives hundreds of reviews and customers repeatedly complain that one part breaks after several months, how would you investigate the problem and d
 what should be changed?



6. Career



Why are you interested in product research, development and product management, and where would you like your career to be in 5 years?

title: Website & GHL Developer / SEO Virtual Assistant — Chiropractic Practice (WordPress, GoHighLevel, SEO/AI Search)
description:
Job Title: Website & GHL Developer / SEO Virtual Assistant — Chiropractic Practice (WordPress, GoHighLevel, SEO/AI Search)

About Us:

Innervate Chiropractic is a growing chiropractic practice in Oklahoma City, OK. We're rebuilding our website and digital presence in-house after ending a relationship with an outside marketing platform, and we need a skilled VA to lead this project.

Scope:

This starts as a defined project (site rebuild/migration, SEO setup, and GHL buildout) with a clear scope and timeline. Based on fit and results, there's strong potential for ongoing monthly work — content updates, blog posts, and continued campaign support — for the right person.

What You'll Do:

• Rebuild/redesign our existing website (or migrate content to a new site we control) using WordPress, Squarespace, or a similar platform

• Optimize the site for Google search (on-page SEO: meta titles/descriptions, keyword targeting for local search terms like "chiropractor Oklahoma City," alt text, site speed, mobile responsiveness)

• Set up a blog structured for search visibility — this also feeds AI search tools (ChatGPT, Google AI Overview, Gemini) that increasingly pull answers from ranked web content, so our practice shows up when people ask AI tools for a chiropractor near them

• Review, correct, and complete our existing GoHighLevel (GHL) setup — we have an initial structure in place but need the full buildout

• Build landing pages in GHL to support our Meta/Instagram ad campaigns (VSL page, application form, or DM/ManyChat funnel — whichever fits the offer), each connected to the correct pipeline and follow-up automation

• Confirm tracking pixels are firing correctly on every landing page and thank-you/confirmation page so ad results are measured accurately

• Connect and maintain our Google Business Profile in coordination with the website

• Monitor basic performance (Google Search Console, Analytics, GHL reporting) and report on progress

• Handle updates as needed post-launch: content changes, new pages, photos, promotions, provider bios

Must-Have Skills:

• Proven experience building/managing WordPress (or similar) websites — please share 2-3 portfolio links

• Proven experience building funnels and landing pages inside GoHighLevel, including pipelines, automations, and pixel/tracking setup

• Working knowledge of on-page SEO fundamentals (keywords, metadata, backlinks, page speed)

• Basic understanding of local SEO for service-based businesses

• Strong written English

• Comfortable taking direction and working independently with US time zone overlap

Nice to Have:

• Experience with healthcare or chiropractic websites/campaigns

• Experience connecting GHL to Meta/Instagram ad campaigns specifically

• Basic graphic design (Canva) for site and landing page images

• Familiarity with AI/LLM search optimization ("AEO") — structuring content so AI tools surface it in answers

To Apply:

Reply with the subject line "Innervate Web/GHL VA" and answer: What's one landing page or funnel you've built in GHL that performed well, and what made it work? Include 2-3 links or screenshots of sites/funnels you've personally built or managed.

Compensation: Paid test project ($40-50 flat, based on 2-3 hours of work). Full website rebuild, SEO setup, and GHL buildout is a flat project fee of $320. Once the site is live, there's potential for an ongoing flat monthly retainer for continued updates and support.

title: Crypto BD Team Lead: $1,500-2,500/mo Base Pace + Uncapped Deal Bonuses (Remote)
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS.

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
We’re looking for a full-time Social Media Manager to take ownership of our social channels across a fast-growing group of brands.



This is a hands-on role. We want one person who can manage the day-to-day social presence, engage with our audience, coordinate external UGC creators, and ideally edit short-form video content themselves.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



- Managing our social media accounts across Instagram, TikTok,

- Posting organic content consistently across each brand

- Writing captions and adapting content for each platform

- Replying to comments and engaging with followers

- Monitoring comments on paid ads and responding appropriately

- Identifying negative, spam or inappropriate comments and managing them quickly

- Helping build a consistent brand voice across all social channels

- Planning and maintaining a content calendar

- Repurposing existing content into new organic posts

- Finding content opportunities based on trends, competitors and audience conversations



UGC CREATOR MANAGEMENT



A major part of the role will be managing external creators.



You’ll:



- Find and recruit UGC creators through platforms such as Sideshift

- Send creators briefs and examples

- Manage deadlines and follow-ups

- Review submitted content

- Request revisions where needed

- Organise completed UGC into our internal content library

- Keep track of which creators perform well so we can work with them repeatedly

- Help us scale the amount of creator content we produce each month



You should be comfortable chasing people, keeping projects organised and making sure content actually gets delivered.



VIDEO EDITING



Ideally, you’ll also be comfortable editing short-form videos.



This could include:



- TikTok, Reels and Shorts editing

- Adding captions and subtitles

- Hooks and text overlays

- Cutting UGC footage into multiple variations

- Adding B-roll

- Basic motion graphics

- Turning raw creator footage into polished ads or organic posts

- Creating multiple versions of the same video for testing



Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar is a big advantage.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You’ll probably be a good fit if you:



- Understand TikTok, Instagram and short-form content

- Have managed social media accounts professionally before

- Are comfortable communicating with creators

- Have strong written English

- Can work independently without needing constant instructions

- Are highly organised

- Understand what makes people stop scrolling

- Can spot good content and bad content quickly

- Are proactive and regularly bring us ideas rather than waiting to be told what to post

- Understand the difference between content designed for engagement and content designed to generate customers



Experience with lead generation, finance, business, SaaS or performance marketing brands would be useful but isn’t essential.



THE ROLE



This is intended to become a long-term, full-time position.



We are growing quickly and there will be significant opportunity to take more ownership of our content operation over time.



We value people who are fast, reliable, proactive and comfortable figuring things out.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Examples of social media accounts you have managed

3. Examples of videos you have edited

4. Any examples of UGC campaigns or creators you have managed

5. Which editing software you use

6. Your expected monthly salary

7. A 1–2 minute video introduction explaining why you think you’d be a good fit



Please start your application with the words SOCIAL READY so we know you have read the full job description.

title: Video Editor - Event Highlights + Photo Editing (Travel/Festival, Deadline-Driven)
description:
We're covering a multi-day festival in the Philippines (Oct 16-25) as the official media partner and need an editor who can turn raw event footage into a same-day recap and process a large batch of event photos fast, without hand-holding.



This is client-facing work under real time pressure. If you've never worked a live event, conference, or festival turnaround before, say so honestly in your application, we may still consider you for the standby bench but not for this specific slot.



WHAT THE WORK ACTUALLY LOOKS LIKE:

- Event highlight reels and recap videos, cut fast, sometimes same-day

- Speaker interview and testimonial cuts

- 300+ event photos edited and delivered same-day at event close (color, crop, basic retouch, batch-consistent look)

- Working from footage/photos handed to you mid-event, not a clean pre-organized folder



WHAT WE PAY (per-deliverable, no exceptions):

- Long-form/recap video: $25 (+$5 bonus if delivered inside 72 working hours)

- Short-form: $8 per published short

- Photo batch editing: rate confirmed per batch size before work starts, in writing, never after

- No base pay, no hourly, no monthly guarantee



HARD REQUIREMENTS TO APPLY:

1. Link ONE direct sample of event/highlight-reel style editing (wedding, conference, festival, live show, something with a real deadline behind it, not scripted content)

2. Link ONE direct sample of photo editing/batch culling work (before/after on a real shoot, not a single portfolio image)

3. State whether you have handled a same-day turnaround deliverable before, and describe the actual deadline pressure you worked under

title: Graphic Designer Needed for Product Annotation Images,
description:
We are looking for a graphic designer to create clean, professional product annotation images for an ecommerce website.



Products include:



- Saunas

- Hyperbaric chambers

- Sauna heaters

- Pilates equipment

- Fitness equipment

- Recovery equipment

- Wellness products



Your main task will be taking manufacturer product images, specification sheets, manuals, and dimensions and turning them into clear annotated product graphics.



Typical annotation images may include:



- Overall product dimensions

- Interior dimensions

- Bench or seating dimensions

- Door dimensions

- Product footprint

- Installation clearances

- Heater placement

- Electrical requirements

- Control panel location

- Component labels

- Key product features

- Top-view or side-view layouts



We do not need highly artistic designs.



We need accurate, clean, easy-to-understand graphics that help customers understand product size, layout, specifications, and installation requirements.



Each product will usually require 2–3 annotation graphics.



Examples:



For a sauna:

- Exterior dimensions

- Interior layout

- Installation or heater-related specifications



For a hyperbaric chamber:

- Overall dimensions

- Entry dimensions

- Interior dimensions

- Major component labels



For fitness equipment:

- Length, width, and height

- User area

- Adjustment points

- Space requirements



What we are looking for:



- Strong graphic design skills

- Experience with product annotation or technical graphics

- Excellent attention to detail

- Comfortable working from manuals and specification sheets

- Able to understand inches, feet, millimeters, and centimeters

- Good typography and layout skills

- Ability to keep designs consistent across many products

- Ability to follow an established brand style



Preferred tools:



- Adobe Illustrator

- Adobe Photoshop

- Figma

- Canva, if you can produce professional technical graphics



Experience with ecommerce product images, technical drawings, architectural annotations, furniture dimensions, equipment specifications, or Amazon listing graphics would be a strong advantage.



Accuracy matters.



You must never guess technical specifications.



If information is unclear or missing, flag it before creating the graphic.



Current Project



We currently have approximately 50 products requiring annotation graphics.



Budget:

$10 per completed product.



Total project value:

Approximately $500 for 50 products.



Each product will normally include 2–3 annotation graphics.



One reasonable revision round per product is included.



We will begin with a paid test batch of 5 products.



Paid test:

5 products × $10 = $50.



If quality, accuracy, communication, and consistency meet our requirements, we will assign the remaining products.



This can become ongoing work because we regularly add new products to our website.



To Apply



Start your application with the word:



BLUEPRINT



Applications that do not start with BLUEPRINT will not be reviewed.



Then include:



1. Your portfolio

2. Examples of product annotation, technical, or ecommerce graphics

3. Tools you use

4. Your experience working with specification sheets or manuals

5. How many products you believe you can complete per day

6. Explain how you would turn a sauna product image and manufacturer specification sheet into three useful annotation graphics for an ecommerce product page.

title: Home Care Recruiter
description:
Job Title: Caregiver Recruiter 

Shift: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET (daylight saving changes applies). Open to 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET depending on candidate availability. 

 

Position Summary 



The Recruiter is responsible for sourcing, attracting, and hiring qualified healthcare professionals to support a growing home care agency serving seniors and adults requiring in?home assistance. This role requires a strong understanding of non?medical home care roles such as HHA, CNA, PCA, and companion caregivers, compliance and credentialing requirements, and the ability to maintain productive relationships with candidates and internal stakeholders. The recruiter ensures a steady pipeline of caregivers to support new client cases while maintaining high hiring standards and an excellent candidate experience. 



Key Responsibilities 



Recruitment & Candidate Management 



• Source, identify, and attract qualified caregivers (HHA, CNA, PCA, companions) using job boards, social media, community groups, referrals, and internal databases. 



• Conduct structured phone and video interviews to evaluate experience, reliability, communication skills, transportation, and alignment with client needs. 



• Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and ensure smooth communication throughout the hiring process. 



• Send offer letters, collect required hiring documentation, and coordinate compliance items including CORI background checks, licenses/certifications, references, and work authorization. 



• Assist in onboarding and training activities for new hires. 



• Maintain a positive and engaging candidate experience at all times. 



• Maintain an active pipeline of caregivers ready for placement to support urgent client starts. 



• Verify caregiver eligibility requirements such as driver’s license, car insurance, and reliable transportation when applicable. 



• Track applicants and recruiting metrics in systems such as Apploi and internal tracking tools. 



• Proactively re?engage past candidates and inactive caregivers to fill open shifts. 



Client & Stakeholder Communication 



• Answer calls and inquiries in a professional and upbeat manner. 



• Serve as a liaison between caregivers, candidates, internal teams, and the Office Manager. 



• Provide timely updates to stakeholders and ensure clarity in all communications. Respond promptly and courteously to clients, caregivers, and prospective candidates. 



Administrative & Operational Support 



• Assist with caregiver scheduling coordination and availability tracking to support open client shifts. 



• Assist with timesheet verification, shift confirmation, and documentation accuracy in WellSky when needed. 



• Maintain accurate and compliant personnel records in internal systems. 



• Support recruiting marketing efforts including job postings, outreach campaigns, and referral programs. 



Decision-Making & Problem-Solving 



• Demonstrate sound judgment in a fast?paced environment. 

• Resolve issues involving caregivers, candidates, and scheduling conflicts calmly and professionally. 

• Maintain strong organization, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple open roles simultaneously. 

 



Skills & Qualifications 



Required 



• 2–3 years of full-cycle recruiting experience preferred (Candidates with less recruiting experience may be considered if they demonstrate strong familiarity with the home care industry and systems such as WellSky and Apploi 



• At least 1 year of experience in home care or healthcare recruiting caregivers, CNAs, HHAs, PCAs, or other healthcare workers 



• Experience recruiting for the U.S. workforce – required 



• Experience with high-volume recruiting and managing multiple open positions simultaneously. Comfortable conducting 15–20 candidate screenings per week in a high-volume recruiting environment 



• Strong sourcing and screening capabilities using job boards, databases, and proactive outreach 



• Excellent interviewing and candidate evaluation skills 



• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with urgent hiring needs 



• Strong written and verbal communication skills (phone, text, and
) 



• Highly organized and detail-oriented 



• Experience verifying caregiver documentation such as certifications, background checks, driver’s license, and insurance 



• Fluent English 



Preferred 



• Experience with WellSky, Apploi, or similar healthcare recruiting systems

A detailed CV (résumé) highlighting relevant experience.

Opportunity to grow and develop within an established healthcare company.
