description:
We are a growing U.S.-based digital marketing agency looking for a full-time Web Developer to build, maintain, and optimize websites for our clients.



You will work across a live portfolio of 30+ client sites in home services, healthcare, med spas, hospitality, professional services, and e-commerce catalogs ranging from a handful of products to several thousand SKUs. On any given week you might be building a new Elementor landing page for a PPC campaign, fixing a broken checkout on a WooCommerce store, migrating a site to a new host, or cutting a page's load time in half.



WORK SCHEDULE



- 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST (U.S. Eastern Time)

- 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippines Time

- 40 hours per week

- Monday to Friday



HOW WE WORK (PLEASE READ THIS PART)



Tasks come to you detailed and specified, not as one-line requests. A typical ticket includes the target URL, a reference design or comp, the exact copy, the assets, the acceptance criteria, and which staging or live environment to work in. We do this on purpose. You should not have to guess what "make the hero better" means. In exchange, we expect the work to come back matching the spec, tested on mobile and desktop, published to the correct environment, and reported back with a live link, not left sitting in an editor.



We are also an AI-assisted shop. Our team uses Claude (Anthropic's AI) daily as part of real production work: generating and reviewing code, scripting bulk content and product updates, driving WordPress and Shopify through their APIs, auditing pages, and automating the repetitive parts of site maintenance. You are not expected to arrive as an expert in this. You are expected to be genuinely interested in it and willing to learn, because it is how we move fast across this many client sites. If you already use Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or similar tools in your development workflow, tell us how in your application.



To be clear on the other side of that: AI helps you write and check the work, it does not excuse it. You own what you publish. We would rather you slow down and verify on the live URL than ship something that "should" work.



TOOLS WE USE



- Microsoft Teams for daily communication and standups

- ClickUp / Trello / Asana for task and project management

- Google Drive for documentation, assets, and tracking

- WordPress / Elementor (heaviest) / Divi / Gutenberg

- Shopify (themes, Liquid, admin, apps)

- WooCommerce

- Claude and AI tooling for development and automation

- Google Search Console and Google Analytics (GA4)

- Ahrefs / SEMrush / Screaming Frog

- PageSpeed Insights / GTmetrix

- cPanel, SiteGround, Hostinger, Cloudflare, and similar hosting stacks

- Canva or similar for light graphics



RESPONSIBILITIES



Build and maintain



- Build, edit, and maintain WordPress websites across multiple client accounts at the same time

- Build pages in Elementor to match a provided design comp or reference site, accurately, including spacing, typography, color tokens, and mobile breakpoints

- Build and maintain Shopify stores: product pages, collections, theme sections, navigation, and front-end adjustments in HTML, CSS, and Liquid

- Create and update landing pages, service pages, location pages, blog pages, and site sections from written specs

- Customize WordPress themes, child themes, and page builder templates, including light PHP work where needed

- Manage WooCommerce catalogs: products, variations, categories, pricing, and bulk imports and updates

- Handle site migrations, staging-to-live pushes, DNS changes, and hosting moves



Fix and optimize



- Troubleshoot plugin conflicts, broken layouts, mobile responsiveness issues, form failures, SMTP and
 delivery problems, and general site errors independently, and document what you found

- Improve site speed and Core Web Vitals: caching, image optimization and WebP conversion, script and CSS cleanup, render-blocking fixes

- Keep sites secure and current with backups, plugin and theme updates, cleanup of abandoned plugins, and basic hardening



SEO and tracking



- Execute on-page and basic technical SEO: title tags, meta descriptions, heading structure, image alt text, internal linking, redirects, schema where specified, sitemap and indexing checks

- Publish and format blog posts with correct headings, images, links, and SEO fields

- Implement on-page updates handed down from our SEO team's strategy

- Set up and verify Google Search Console, GA4, conversion tracking, and pixels when needed



Work with the team



- Collaborate with our SEO, PPC, social, and design staff to support live campaigns, often on a deadline tied to an ad launch

- Provide clear daily written updates: what you completed, what is blocked, and the live links to verify

- Flag problems early. A task that turns out to be twice the size it looked is fine. Finding that out on the due date is not.



REQUIREMENTS



- 2 to 3+ years hands-on, professional experience building and managing WordPress sites

- Strong Elementor skills specifically. You can rebuild a design comp in Elementor without it falling apart on mobile

- Experience with Shopify: themes, product pages, collections, and store updates

- Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals. Basic PHP is a strong plus

- Basic Shopify Liquid knowledge preferred

- Working knowledge of WooCommerce

- Strong grasp of on-page and basic technical SEO

- Proven experience improving page speed, mobile responsiveness, and user experience

- Comfortable in Search Console, GA4, PageSpeed Insights, and standard SEO tools

- Able to troubleshoot independently. You research, test, and solve before escalating

- Genuine attention to detail on layouts, links, images, and SEO fields. You check your own work on the live URL before calling it done

- Able to juggle multiple client sites and deadlines without dropping tasks

- Strong written English, since most of our communication is written

- Self-motivated and reliable on the U.S. night shift

- Reliable internet connection and your own computer or laptop

- Interest in AI-assisted development (Claude or similar). Prior experience is a bonus, not a requirement



NICE TO HAVE



- Agency experience

- Site migrations, DNS, cPanel, Cloudflare, and hosting administration

- Git and version control

- Working with REST APIs (WordPress REST API, Shopify Admin API)

- Experience with large product catalogs or bulk data imports

- Custom plugin or theme development



TO APPLY



- Write the word "Web" at the top of your application

- Include links to websites you have built, managed, or optimized: WordPress sites, Shopify stores, and landing pages

- For each link, write a short description of your specific role: design, development, maintenance, speed optimization, SEO, or troubleshooting. Tell us what you actually did, not what the agency did

- Describe one website problem you diagnosed and fixed yourself, and how you found it

- If you use AI tools in your development work, tell us which ones and what you use them for



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

title: Commercial Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
# Commercial Sales Development Representative (SDR)

**Remote – Philippines | Full-Time**



Fitness Machine Technicians is looking for a confident, highly motivated **Commercial Sales Development Representative** to help grow our commercial customer base in Florida and other U.S. markets.



This is primarily an **outbound sales role**. Your responsibility will be to identify businesses and communities with fitness equipment, contact decision-makers, introduce our services, qualify opportunities, and schedule appointments for our team.



We are looking for someone who is comfortable making a high volume of phone calls, handling rejection, following up consistently, and building relationships with potential commercial customers.



## What You Will Sell



Our company provides:



- Preventive maintenance programs for commercial fitness equipment

- Fitness equipment repair and service

- Equipment inspections and maintenance

- Parts and equipment repair

- Ongoing commercial service relationships



Our goal is to develop long-term relationships with commercial facilities rather than simply make one-time sales.



## Target Customers



You will prospect organizations such as:



- HOA and condominium communities

- Apartment complexes

- Property management companies

- Hotels and resorts

- Commercial gyms and fitness centers

- Corporate fitness centers

- Schools and universities

- Physical therapy and rehabilitation facilities

- Senior living communities

- Municipal and government facilities

- Country clubs

- Recreation centers



## Primary Responsibilities



### Prospecting

Research potential commercial customers within assigned territories and identify the appropriate decision-makers.



### Outbound Calling

Make consistent outbound calls to potential commercial customers and introduce our company and services.



### Qualification

Determine:



- Whether the facility has commercial fitness equipment

- Approximate size of the fitness facility

- Who manages equipment maintenance

- Whether they currently have a preventive maintenance provider

- When their current agreement expires

- Whether they have equipment currently needing service

- Whether they are interested in receiving information or a proposal



### Appointment Setting

Schedule qualified meetings, inspections, or follow-up calls for our sales/management team.



### Follow-Up

Follow up consistently with prospects who are interested but not ready to purchase immediately.



Many commercial customers will require multiple calls and
s before becoming customers.



### CRM Management

Maintain accurate records of:



- Calls

- Contacts

- Decision-makers

-
s

- Follow-up dates

- Opportunities

- Quotes/proposals

- Outcomes



Every prospect should have a clearly documented next step.



## Performance Expectations



You will be measured primarily on sales outcomes, including:



- Outbound sales activity

- Decision-maker conversations

- Qualified opportunities created

- Qualified appointments scheduled

- Proposals generated

- New commercial customers acquired

- New preventive maintenance contract revenue

- Follow-up completion

- CRM accuracy



Call volume matters, but **creating qualified sales opportunities and revenue is the ultimate goal.**



## Schedule



Full-time position working primarily during **U.S. Eastern Time business hours**.



Applicants must have:



- Reliable high-speed internet

- Reliable computer

- Quiet professional work environment

- Quality headset

- Backup internet/power plan preferred



## Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who:



- Has previous B2B outbound sales or appointment-setting experience

- Is extremely comfortable making cold calls

- Speaks clear and professional English

- Is confident speaking with property managers, facility managers and business owners

- Does not become discouraged by rejection

- Is persistent without being aggressive

- Is highly organized with follow-ups

- Understands that sales often requires multiple touches

- Can work independently

- Takes ownership of results

- Is coachable and willing to improve scripts and sales techniques

- Has experience using a CRM



Experience selling commercial services, maintenance agreements, property services, HVAC, plumbing, janitorial services, landscaping, security, facilities services, SaaS, or similar B2B services is especially valuable.



## Compensation



Competitive hourly/base compensation plus a **performance-based commission and bonus program.**



High performers will have the opportunity to earn significantly more through commissions as they generate new commercial customers and recurring preventive maintenance contracts.



## How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your resume.

2. A short description of your B2B outbound sales experience.

3. How many outbound calls you typically made per day in your previous role.

4. An example of a product or service you successfully sold by phone.

5. A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be successful in this position.

6. Your expected hourly rate.



Please begin your application with the words **“Commercial Growth”** so we know you read the entire posting.

title: Remote Customer Service Specialist | E-Commerce Helpdesk (Enterprise Hardware)
description:
Company: Server Part Deals (Server Tech Solutions, Inc.)

Work Setup: Full-time, Remote

Schedule: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time (US)



ABOUT US

Server Part Deals is one of the largest online sellers of enterprise storage — refurbished enterprise hard drives, SSDs, and server components. We ship thousands of orders a month through multiple storefronts including eBay, Amazon, Walmart, Newegg, Shopify, and our own site, serving customers ranging from homelab builders to data centers, across the US and internationally. Our customer service reputation is a core business asset, and this role helps protect it.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll join a small, high-performing remote CS team resolving customer tickets across all our marketplaces through our helpdesk platform (eDesk). This is a high-volume, writing-intensive role — our current specialists resolve 50–70 tickets per day with fast handling times and a high first-contact resolution rate, and that's the bar. You'll be trained thoroughly on our products, policies, and tools, with a documented knowledge base and direct support from our CS Manager, plus a clear path to expanded authority (refund approvals, exception handling) as you demonstrate accuracy.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Resolve customer inquiries across all storefronts: order status, tracking, product/compatibility questions, returns, warranty claims, and shipping issues

Initiate and process RMAs within our returns system, following documented policy

Follow marketplace-specific messaging rules and policies (eBay, Amazon, Walmart, Newegg) — accuracy here directly affects our seller account health

Screen orders for red flags: suspicious shipping addresses, potential fraud, pricing or listing errors — and flag them before they ship

Use, maintain, and suggest improvements to response templates and macros

Escalate complex cases to the CS Manager with clear, complete internal notes

Participate in a weekly quality-review process and apply feedback quickly



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

2+ years of e-commerce customer service experience, ideally including eBay and/or Amazon marketplace support

Proven ability to sustain high ticket volume (50+ tickets/day) without sacrificing accuracy or tone

Excellent written English — clear, professional, and warm; most of this job is writing

Experience with a helpdesk platform (eDesk, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Gorgias, or similar)

Strong attention to detail — you notice when something about an order looks wrong

Self-directed and reliable in a remote setting: quiet workspace, dependable high-speed internet, consistent schedule

Comfortable learning technical products — you don't need to be a hardware expert on day one, but you need to want to become one



BONUS POINTS FOR

Knowledge of PC/server hardware (hard drives, SSDs, RAID, servers) or experience selling refurbished electronics

Experience with Amazon Seller Central or eBay Seller Hub case handling

Shopify admin experience



SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION



Full-time, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time

Paid training on our products, systems, and policies

title: Ecommerce Video Editor — Direct Response, AI Animation, VSLs
description:
We're a fast-growing pet brand and we run paid social at volume. We're hiring a full-time video editor who lives in AI tooling and can turn a brief plus a reference ad into a finished, scroll-stopping video.



This is a real editing job, not a "learn AI on the job" job. You'll be handed a script, a reference ad, and product references, and you're expected to come back with a clean ad that holds attention from the beginning and have great scene selection/generation to match our script.



Every AI tool is provided and paid for by us. You never pay for a credit.



What you'll do



- Ship the weekly video quotas, working from scripts and briefs we give you. Lengths vary, but almost all are VSLs running 1 minutes plus. Some could be 3 minutes plus.

- Generate assets with AI tools: UGC avatars, vet narrators, voiceover, b-roll, 3D animation

- Replicate references. When we send a reference ad plus a brief, you match its pacing, structure, and ensure it's as good as the reference

- Cut for retention: strong first 2 seconds, tight pacing, no dead air, a visual change every few seconds

- Build hooks that stop the scroll — both the visual and the on-screen text

- Iterate fast on feedback



The formats we run



You should be strong across all of these:



Standard direct performance ads

AI UGC ads — realistic AI creators delivering personal-story and testimonial scripts

AI expert narration — authority-led educational edits, often paired with 3D medical animation and clinical b-roll

VSLs — longer-form, structured direct-response edits that sell





You're a good fit if



- You have extensive experience with AI creative tools

- You've worked for DTC brands before

- You understand pacing, hooks, visual storytelling, and direct-response editing

- You can take a reference and recreate the format without needing your hand held

- You have great taste in selecting scene and edit that allows audience to visualize the script better





Requirements



- 2 to 3 years minimum of professional video editing experience (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or equivalent)

- Hands-on experience with AI video tools

Experian, LexisNexis.

Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

- Minimum 2 years of experience in a similar role

- Able to fill out and file disputes through CFPB and Consumer Finance

- Able to navigate bureau and institution portals (TransUnion, Equifax, Experian, LexisNexis, ChexSystems, Innovus, DataX, EWS, Clarity)

Compensation

title: Designer - Frontend Engineer (AI-Forward)
description:
Who We Are



We are a focused development team. We build and improve a set of internal and customer-facing applications. This includes web admin tools, signage systems, and smart TV applications. Our work includes building new products and improving tools that are already in use.



This is not a short-term or single-project contract. We have consistent, ongoing work. We are looking for someone who can grow into a long-term role with the team.



The Role



We are looking for someone with strong design skills, solid web fundamentals, and real skill using AI tools to turn requirements into finished, working products. This role is not about being an expert in one specific framework. It is more about your ability to design good interfaces, understand how the web works, and use AI effectively to build and ship work.



You will design and build dashboards, admin interfaces, and marketing-style websites. You should understand usability well enough to make interfaces that are easy to use, not just functional. You should know enough HTML, CSS, and modern tools (such as Tailwind) to build real interfaces and to communicate clearly with AI coding tools about what you want to build.



The most important skill for this role is AI-assisted development. This means:



- You are given a PRD or BRD (a document that describes what needs to be built, including requirements).

- You use AI tools to turn those requirements into a finished, working product.

- You guide, review, and correct the AI's output. You do not simply accept what the AI gives you.

- You use good judgment about assumptions, constraints, APIs, and how to implement things along the way.



You should also be strong at critical thinking and QA. This means comparing finished work against the original requirements, catching missing pieces, and noticing when AI-generated output has gone off track.



This role is a contract-to-hire position. This means it starts as a contract, with a clear path to becoming a full-time position for the right person.



Key Responsibilities



- Design and build dashboards, admin interfaces, and marketing-style websites.

- Apply strong visual design skills: attention to detail, alignment, spacing, and consistency.

- Design interfaces that are easy to use and easy to understand.

- Take a PRD or BRD and use AI tools to turn requirements into a finished, working product.

- Guide, review, and correct AI-generated output rather than accepting it as-is.

- Use good judgment about assumptions, constraints, APIs, and implementation choices.

- Compare finished work against requirements and catch anything missing or incorrect.

- Check your own work carefully before it is considered done (QA).

- Review other developers' work for quality and correctness.

- Improve and update existing applications that are already live.

- Work with other developers to plan and deliver features together.

- Join a short daily stand-up meeting, with some overlap during U.S. working hours.



What You Bring



Design (Main Focus)

- Strong graphic and visual design skills.

- Strong attention to detail: alignment, spacing, and consistency.

- Ability to design clear and easy-to-use dashboards and web interfaces.

- Understanding of usability and how to organize information clearly.



Web Fundamentals

- Experience building marketing-style websites and web admin interfaces.

- Working knowledge of HTML and CSS.

- Familiarity with tools and frameworks such as Tailwind.

Enough technical vocabulary to communicate clearly with AI coding tools.



AI-Assisted Development (Required)

- Real experience using AI coding tools (for example: Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to turn requirements into a finished, - working product.

- Ability to guide, review, and correct AI-generated output rather than simply accepting it.

- Good judgment about assumptions, constraints, APIs, and implementation choices when working with AI.



Critical Thinking and QA

- Ability to compare completed work against requirements.

- Strong habit of checking your own work carefully (self-QA).

- Ability to notice missing requirements and cases where the AI's output is wrong or incomplete.



General



- Experience using Git with a team.

- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.

- Good English communication skills, both written and spoken.

- Open to using AI tools as part of your normal development process (sometimes called "vibe coding").



Why Join Us



Contract-to-hire. A clear path to a long-term, full-time position.

Steady, ongoing work. No uncertainty about whether there is enough work.

You will own real features that are used by real customers.

Learn and grow your skills in design, web development, and AI-assisted execution.

Modern workflow using AI tools and current best practices.

Small, supportive team where your work makes a direct difference.

title: Virtual Commercial Cleaning Bid & Contracts Manager (Remote)
description:

We are a growing commercial and post-construction cleaning company specializing in high-quality

final cleaning services for commercial construction projects. We are seeking an experienced, highly

organized, and self-motivated professional to manage our public and private bidding process from

start to finish.



Position Summary

The Virtual Bid & Contracts Manager will oversee every phase of the commercial bidding

process—from identifying and procuring bid opportunities to preparing accurate, competitive

proposals and managing submissions through award. The successful candidate will analyze project

specifications, communicate with project managers, estimators, and general contractors, calculate

labor and material requirements, prepare detailed bid packages, and maximize contract award

opportunities while ensuring all submissions meet deadlines and client requirements.



Primary Responsibilities

• Monitor and identify commercial cleaning bid opportunities through RFPs, invitation-to-bid

platforms, public procurement sites, and contractor relationships.

• Research and procure new bid opportunities aligned with company goals.

• Review project plans, specifications, contracts, and bid documents.

• Coordinate with project managers, subcontractors, and clients to gather information for accurate

estimating.

• Analyze project scope to determine labor, equipment, and material requirements.

• Develop competitive pricing strategies while maintaining profitability.

• Prepare complete bid proposals and supporting documentation.

• Ensure bids are accurate, compliant, and submitted before deadlines.

• Track bids from solicitation through award.

• Respond to RFIs, addenda, and clarifications.

• Maintain bid calendars and proposal records.

• Negotiate contract terms when appropriate.

• Assist with project turnover after award.

• Build relationships with general contractors and procurement teams.



Qualifications

Required

• Experience interpreting project specifications and contract documents.

• Strong understanding of labor estimating, production rates, and material costing.

• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with professional, fluent English proficiency.



Must communicate confidently with clients, project managers, subcontractors, and vendors.



• Outstanding proposal writing skills and attention to detail.

• Excellent organizational, analytical, and project management abilities.

• Ability to manage multiple bids simultaneously and meet deadlines.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and online bid platforms.

• Self-starter able to work independently from start to finish.



Preferred

• Knowledge of prevailing wage projects and public procurement.

• Experience with estimating software and construction bid platforms.

Ideal Candidate

professionally.

Performance Expectations

Number of qualified bids submitted; bid accuracy; on-time submissions; contract win rate; gross

bonuses, flexible remote work environment, and opportunity for advancement

title: Virtual Parts & Procurement Coordinator
description:
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 7:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Eastern Time

**Location:** Remote



About the Role



We are looking for a highly organized, responsive **Virtual Parts & Procurement Coordinator** to support our Parts and Supply Chain operations. This role serves as a key point of contact for parts customers while helping keep estimates, payments, Parts Research requests, purchase orders, and order updates moving forward.



You’ll be responsible for the day-to-day follow-through that creates a great customer experience and gives our internal Supply Chain team more time to focus on purchasing, sourcing, technical research, inventory, and complex procurement needs.



## What You’ll Do



* Answer inbound parts calls,
s, and assigned leads.

* Gather customer and equipment information, including make/model, serial numbers, data tags, photos, quantities, and requested parts.

* Create and maintain accurate customer and lead records.

* Coordinate requests requiring technical identification with our internal Parts Research team.

* Create and send parts estimates using approved information.

* Follow up consistently on open estimates through sale or closure.

* Communicate pricing, availability, and lead times to customers.

* Send payment links or instructions and follow up on routine outstanding payments.

* Create clear handoffs to Supply Chain when parts are ready to be ordered or shipped.

* Follow up on open purchase orders and vendor acknowledgments.

* Maintain accurate expected ship dates, lead times, backorder/delay information, and tracking details.

* Keep customers and internal teams informed throughout the process.

* Proactively flag delays, exceptions, or issues requiring additional support.



## What Success Looks Like



You are responsive, organized, and consistent. Customers receive timely communication, estimates don’t fall through the cracks, open orders have clear status updates, and internal teams can quickly determine where an order stands.



Key performance expectations include:



* **95%+** compliance with inbound customer response standards

* **98%+** compliance with required parts estimate follow-up

* **95%+** compliance with open purchase order visibility requirements



## What This Role Does Not Own

This role supports procurement and order coordination but does **not** independently make purchasing, sourcing, pricing, or technical parts-identification decisions. Complex vendor issues, inventory management, physical receiving/shipping, and other procurement exceptions remain with the internal Supply Chain team.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is:



* Highly organized and detail-oriented

* Comfortable communicating with customers by phone and

* Consistent with follow-up and task management

* Able to manage multiple open requests without losing track of details

* Proactive about communicating delays and next steps

* Comfortable working across multiple systems and maintaining accurate records

* Team-oriented and able to coordinate effectively with Sales, Service, and Supply Chain

* Able to work consistently during **7:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Eastern Time**



This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys customer service, coordination, organization, and keeping processes moving from initial request through completion.

title: Customer Support Team Lead - DTC / eCommerce
description:
We’re looking for a Customer Support Team Lead / Senior Customer Service Agent to take ownership of our support team and make sure the department runs properly without requiring constant oversight from leadership.



This is primarily a team leadership and management role, but you will also act as the senior escalation point for difficult customer situations that junior agents cannot resolve themselves.



You will not be expected to spend your entire shift answering normal support tickets.



Our junior customer service agents will handle the majority of the regular ticket volume.



Your responsibility will be to manage their performance, coach them, maintain quality, and personally step in when they escalate more complicated or sensitive tickets to you.



Your Role



The role has two main responsibilities:



1. Lead the Customer Support Team



Your primary responsibility is making sure the team performs properly.



You will:



Manage the day-to-day performance of the customer support agents



Monitor productivity, response times, ticket volume, quality, and backlog



Review individual agent performance regularly



Hold weekly 1-on-1 calls with each agent



Give clear feedback and coaching



Identify why an agent is struggling and help fix the problem



Follow up after giving feedback to make sure performance actually improves



Make sure agents follow our SOPs and policies correctly



Review customer conversations for quality



Identify recurring mistakes and training opportunities



Make sure shifts are properly covered



Monitor aging tickets and make sure nothing important is being ignored



Keep training and important feedback documented



Help improve our SOPs and internal support processes



Report important issues and trends to leadership



Help onboard and train new support agents as the team grows



If something is going wrong inside the support team, we expect you to notice it before leadership has to point it out.



2. Handle Difficult & Escalated Tickets



You will also act as our senior customer service agent.



Junior agents will escalate situations to you when something falls outside their authority, experience, or SOP.



These may include:



Difficult or highly upset customers



Complicated refund situations



Chargeback or dispute-risk customers



Subscription-related escalations



Unusual order issues



Customers requesting exceptions



Sensitive complaints



Cases where the junior agent is unsure how to proceed



Situations requiring stronger judgment or communication



Your job is to resolve these cases quickly and professionally while protecting both the customer relationship and the business.



You should also use escalations as training opportunities.



If a junior agent escalates something they should eventually be capable of handling themselves, you should explain the correct approach so that the same situation does not repeatedly come back to you.



The goal is not to become the person everyone forwards everything to.



The goal is to develop the team so that they continuously become more capable, while you remain available for genuinely difficult situations.



What We Expect



We want someone who takes full ownership of the support department.



You should not need someone constantly reminding you to:



Check agent performance



Follow up with an underperforming agent



Schedule coaching calls



Review ticket quality



Check whether tickets are falling behind



Make sure shifts are covered



Give feedback



Handle escalations



Follow up to see whether previous feedback was actually implemented



If you give an agent feedback today, we expect you to continue monitoring them afterward.



Sending one message and forgetting about the problem is not management.



Different agents will have different strengths and weaknesses.



Some may need help with speed.



Some may need help with communication.



Some may understand things immediately, while others may need repeated coaching.



Your job is to understand each person and figure out how to get the best performance from them.



Performance & KPIs



You will be responsible for monitoring and improving areas such as:



First response time



Resolution time



Ticket backlog



Tickets handled per agent



Individual agent productivity



Response quality



Customer satisfaction



Refund rate



Chargeback/dispute prevention



Subscription cancellation handling



Escalation volume



Attendance and schedule adherence



We care about both speed and quality.



Fast responses are useless if they create more problems.



Perfect responses are also useless if customers have to wait hours to receive them.



You need to balance both.



Leadership Style



We want someone who can be direct, fair, and accountable.



You should be comfortable:



Having difficult conversations



Correcting poor performance



Giving specific feedback



Holding people accountable



Recognizing good performance



Making expectations extremely clear



Following up until problems are actually resolved



We don’t want a manager who avoids uncomfortable conversations.



We also don’t want someone who simply forwards every problem to leadership.



You are being hired to solve problems before they reach leadership whenever possible.



What We’re Looking For



You would be a strong fit if you:



Have previous experience leading a customer support team



Are also personally strong at handling difficult customers



Have experience with DTC, eCommerce, subscriptions, or high-volume online customer service



Have managed remote support agents before



Have strong written English



Can communicate calmly in difficult situations



Are highly organized



Can review performance data and identify problems quickly



Are proactive rather than reactive



Have strong attention to detail



Can coach different personalities effectively



Take responsibility when something under your control goes wrong



Can make good judgment calls without constantly asking for approval



Are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment



Can operate independently without constant supervision



Experience with Shopify, Richpanel, Gorgias, Loop, Recharge, Stripe, or similar eCommerce/support tools is a plus.



How We Work



We run a lean team.



We don’t want unnecessary layers of management.



The Support Lead should still understand exactly what is happening inside the ticket queue and be capable of stepping in when needed.



At the same time, we do not want you spending most of your day doing work that the junior agents should be handling.



Your time should primarily go toward:



Managing the team.

Improving performance.

Training agents.

Monitoring quality.

Solving difficult escalations.

Preventing problems before they grow.



Leadership should be able to look at the support department and know that:



The tickets are handled.

The agents are performing.

Escalations are being resolved.

Problems are being caught.

Training is happening.

Customers are being taken care of.



Without constantly having to check behind you.



Growth Opportunity



This can become a much larger role for the right person.



As the business and support volume grow, you can potentially take ownership of:



A larger support team



Hiring



Training systems



Quality assurance



Customer experience



Retention initiatives



Escalation systems



Broader support operations



We promote based on performance and responsibility.



If you consistently make the department better, there will be room to grow with it.



How to Apply



Please answer the following:



How many customer support agents have you managed before?



What type of businesses or industries have you managed support for?



Were you still personally handling escalations while managing the team? If yes, what types of situations were normally escalated to you?



What were the main KPIs you were responsible for?



How frequently did you review individual agent performance?



Tell us about an agent who was underperforming. How did you identify the problem, what did you do, and what happened afterward?



If one agent is significantly slower than everyone else but their response quality is good, how would you handle it?



If you notice the ticket backlog increasing for three days in a row, what would you do?



How do you make sure feedback you give an agent actually gets implemented long-term?



How do you conduct weekly 1-on-1s with your team?



Tell us about a difficult customer situation you personally handled that a junior agent could not resolve.



How do you d
 whether an agent should handle a situation themselves or escalate it to you?



How do you balance customer satisfaction with preventing unnecessary refunds and chargebacks?



What customer support platforms and eCommerce tools have you used?



What hours and days are you available to work?



Please start your application with SUPPORT LEAD so we know you read the entire job description.



We’re looking for someone who can lead the team while still being the strongest customer support person on it when a difficult situation needs to be handled.

title: Director of Culinary Operations & Food Systems
description:
Job Description:

This is more than a traditional Executive Chef role.

We're looking for a seasoned culinary leader who can oversee and strengthen an entire culinary operation — from products and recipes to food quality, food safety, training, systems, and profitability.

You'll diagnose urgent product and quality problems, build the systems and standards needed to fix them, and create a culinary operation that can maintain consistent quality even as the business grows, locations change, and people come and go.



This is a fully remote leadership role. Dedicated on-site Head Chefs handle day-to-day kitchen execution. Your focus is on the culinary standards, systems, processes, and leadership that keep multiple locations and concepts consistent and profitable.





What You'll Own:



Lead and strengthen culinary operations across multiple locations, concepts, and teams

Assess products, menus, recipes, suppliers, and production processes using data, reports, and remote evidence

Diagnose and direct fixes for taste, consistency, quality, and food-safety issues

Work through on-site Head Chefs and culinary leaders to ensure standards are executed consistently

Build controlled recipes, specifications, production standards, and processes with clear tolerances and version control

Standardize culinary systems across restaurants, commissary/central kitchen, bakery, catering, and other food operations as needed

Lead menu engineering — improve, reposition, standardize, or remove underperforming products

Establish food-safety, quality, and traceability systems, including root-cause analysis

Build training, development, and succession systems for culinary teams

Own the culinary drivers of food cost, yield, waste, consistency, and margin

Use technology, data, and AI to improve culinary decision-making, communication, and operational control

Create systems that preserve culinary knowledge and maintain continuity despite team turnover







What We're Looking For:



10+ years of progressive culinary/F&B leadership experience, ideally at Executive Chef, Culinary Director, Corporate Chef, or equivalent level

title: Remote Clinic Data & Statistics Assistant
description:
Remote Clinic Data & Statistics Assistant



We are a busy chiropractic and rehabilitation clinic in Liverpool, UK, looking for a highly organised and detail-focused remote assistant to manage our clinic statistics and patient outcome data.



This is not a general virtual assistant role.



The main purpose of the position is to accurately review patient records, record key performance information and keep our clinic management dashboard up to date.



The role would suit someone who enjoys working with numbers, spreadsheets, systems and data and who is very accurate and consistent.



Main Responsibilities



Each week you will review the previous week's clinic activity and update our statistics.



This includes:



- Recording practitioner patient visit numbers

- Recording new patient numbers

- Reviewing new patient outcomes

- Checking whether patients returned for their Report of Findings

- Recording whether patients converted onto a care plan

- Recording which care plan they selected

- Recording full-pay or split-pay options

- Checking
 patient first-adjustment payments

- Recording membership review outcomes

- Recording membership conversions

- Monitoring patient drop-outs and patients with no future appointments

- Updating our web-based clinic performance dashboard

- Checking that previous pending outcomes have now been resolved



You will primarily use our clinic management software, **Zoneee**, alongside our internal web-based dashboard.



Monthly Responsibilities



At the beginning of each month you will also help prepare the previous month's practitioner statistics, including:



- Average patient visits per week

- Average new patients per week

- New patient conversion performance

- Membership conversion performance

- Active membership numbers

- Membership growth or decline

- Patient retention / drop-out information

- Updating the information required for longer-term practitioner performance reporting



The dashboard will calculate most percentages and KPIs automatically.



Your responsibility is to make sure the underlying data is accurate.



Initial Project



When you first join, there will also be a historical data project.



We need to work back through our clinic records from **January 2026 onwards** and enter historical new patient, practitioner and membership statistics into the system.



This will provide additional hours during the first few weeks of the role.



Once this project is complete, the ongoing workload will be much smaller.



Expected Hours



After the initial historical project is complete, we expect approximately:



**5–8 hours per week**



Most of the weekly work will ideally be completed on a **Monday morning**.



Because the Philippines is ahead of the UK, our aim is for the previous week's statistics to be completed before the clinic owner starts work in the UK.



There may occasionally be additional work at the beginning of each month.



What We Are Looking For



You must be:



- Extremely accurate

- Comfortable working with numbers

- Very organised

- Confident using spreadsheets and web-based software

- Able to follow a defined process consistently

- Comfortable checking information across different parts of a patient record

- Able to identify when information does not match rather than guessing

- Reliable with recurring weekly tasks

- Comfortable working independently

- Able to communicate clearly in written English



Previous experience working with:



- Healthcare administration

- Medical or clinic software

- Data entry

- Statistics

- Excel / Google Sheets

- CRM systems



would be helpful but is not essential.



Confidentiality



This role involves access to confidential patient information.



You will be required to follow strict data protection and confidentiality procedures.



Patient information must never be downloaded, copied, photographed, screenshotted or stored outside authorised clinic systems.



Only the information required to complete the assigned task should be accessed.



The successful candidate must treat patient confidentiality extremely seriously.



What Success Looks Like



The most important thing in this role is **accuracy**.



We would rather the data take slightly longer and be correct than have statistics entered quickly but incorrectly.



You should be someone who notices when something does not look right and asks rather than making assumptions.



Over time, you will become responsible for making sure that the clinic owner has accurate weekly and monthly performance information available before management and practitioner meetings.



Application



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Any experience you have with data entry, reporting, healthcare administration or statistics.

3. Your experience with Excel, Google Sheets or similar software.

4. Your usual working hours in Philippines time.

5. Whether you are available on Monday mornings.

6. Your expected hourly rate.

7. Please include the words **“Clinic Stats”** at the beginning of your application so we know you have read the full job description.



We are looking for someone who could potentially work with us long term if the role is a good fit.

title: Video Editor for Clothing Brand
description:
We are looking for a video editor to join CurveLift, a growing women’s clothing brand focused on problem-solving products.



The role will start part-time at 10–20 hours per week. Once we’ve established a good working relationship and you’ve learned what performs well in our ads, we plan to increase the role to 30–40 hours per week. Additional hours may be available based on performance.



Position Overview



You will edit short-form Meta ads using UGC footage. We’ll provide the footage, examples of ads we like, and creative direction. Your main focus will be creating strong hooks and making the first few seconds grab attention. The rest of each video should maintain a fast pace with clean cuts while clearly showing the product and communicating the offer.



Your work will include:



- Editing UGC-style video ads

- Creating different hooks and variations from the same footage

- Adding on-screen text for the hook

- Making revisions based on feedback

- Delivering finished videos and organized project files



What We’re Looking For



You should have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands and understand how to make the first few seconds engaging. You should be comfortable working with UGC footage, have strong written English, and communicate reliably.



Desire to Learn



We want someone who enjoys testing new ideas, learning what performs well, and improving their work through feedback. If you also have your own ideas for hooks or edits we could test, that’s a plus.



How to Apply



Please send 3–5 video ads you personally edited, tell us which software you use, and include your availability and expected hourly rate. We’ll invite a few candidates to complete a paid test project before choosing someone for the longer-term role.



Include CURVE5 in the subject of your application.

title: Trial Reels Assistant (Instagram Edits App), Simple Daily Task, Part-Time
description:
Type of Work: Part-time, daily

Pay: $180/month

Hours: Around 2 hours per day at the start, going down to about 1 hour per day once you know the flow



About Us

We run two Instagram accounts, 
 and we use Instagram's Trial Reels feature to maximize the reach of our content and get it in front of new audiences. We're looking for a detail-oriented, reliable person to create and post our trial reels every day, following our step-by-step SOP.



What You'll Do

This is a very simple job. There's no hard or creative editing. You'll only make small variants of our existing videos and post them as trial reels.



Each day, you'll create and post up to 10 trial reels per account:



-variants of the video we posted that day

-variants of our past high-performing reels, rotating through them



For each variant, you'll use the Instagram Edits app to make 2–3 small changes, such as:



Adjusting zoom and framing

Changing caption font, size, color, or position

Mirroring footage (without flipping any text)

Small speed adjustments

Swapping or reordering the first and last clips

Adding new background music at the right volume



You'll then add and proofread captions against our script, preview each video, export in 4K, and post it as a trial reel directly from our account.



Full training and our SOP are provided.



Who You Are



-Experience with Instagram Trial Reels

-Comfortable with the Instagram Edits app (or CapCut and able to learn Edits quickly)

-Very detail-oriented: you double-check captions, text, and settings before posting

-Reliable and consistent, able to complete the task every day without reminders

-Good English for proofreading captions

-Trustworthy and professional, since you'll have access to our Instagram accounts



How to Apply

Please send:



1. Your experience with Instagram Trial Reels (which accounts, and how long)

2. Your experience with the Instagram Edits app or CapCut

3. Any examples of Reels you've edited or posted (links)

4. Your daily availability and time zone

5. Confirmation that you can work every day, including weekends

6. Start your application with the words "Trial Reels" so we know you read the full post

title: Scheduler / Staffing Coordinator
description:
Work Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM EST (that's 8:00 PM – 4:30 AM Philippine Time). This is a genuine night-shift commitment — please confirm you can sustain this schedule long-term before applying.



About You



You enjoy solving puzzles — a last-minute call-off is a challenge, not a crisis, and you stay level-headed while you fix it.



You have world-class written and spoken English. You'll be on the phone constantly with U.S. clients, families, and case managers — confident, clear, professional phone communication is non-negotiable, not a nice-to-have.



You have a sharp eye for detail and like things organized, accurate, and compliant — the kind of person who catches the error before it becomes a problem.



You're a natural completer who finishes what you start and doesn't let things slip.



You're a little competitive and like hitting targets — especially ones that contribute to team success.



You're willing and able to learn U.S. geography — specifically Delaware — well enough to make smart scheduling and routing decisions. We'll teach you; you bring the discipline to actually learn it.



About Us

We are a home care agency dedicated to compassionate, respectful, and professional service. We believe life is about living, not just existing — and that everyone deserves the dignity of care in the comfort of their own home. We deliver on that belief by providing the best care to clients in the communities we serve.







The Role

The Scheduling/Staffing Coordinator maximizes the efficiency and hours our caregivers deliver to our clients. You'll own the daily schedule: booking home visits for field staff, filling call-offs quickly, and keeping clients, caregivers, case managers, and office staff informed and coordinated. When schedules run smoothly, clients get consistent care and caregivers get reliable hours — you make that happen.



This is a high-caliber, well-compensated role. We're not looking for a generic VA — we're looking for someone who's genuinely excellent at this and will be paid accordingly.



Requirements



Minimum 5 years of scheduling/staffing coordination experience specifically within a home care agency (required) — this means coordinating field staff visiting clients in private homes, not assisted living facility scheduling and not generic staffing agency placement work



Hands-on experience with home care scheduling software (AlayaCare, WellSky, or similar) and managing multiple schedules simultaneously



Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)



Excellent spoken and written English — near-native fluency required; phone screening will specifically assess verbal communication



Willingness and ability to quickly learn U.S. geography, specifically the Delaware service area, as it's central to daily scheduling decisions



High attention to detail and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced, compliance-sensitive environment



Proactive, problem-solving mindset



Healthcare certification (RN, CNA, or similar) is a plus



Responsibilities



Ensure accurate and appropriate scheduling for clients and staff.



Manage calls from patients and field staff regarding scheduling issues.



Enter and maintain accurate information in the Home Care operating software (AlayaCare).



Communicate professionally with clients, family members, and staff.



Document and maintain schedule notations timely to ensure compliance.



Provide staffing coverage for call-offs and monitor clock-in/out accuracy of field staff.



Answer incoming calls promptly and pleasantly.



Relay information from referral sources, clients, family members, and case managers to appropriate personnel.



Document and report client or staff concerns.



Maintain accurate documentation in client and personnel files.



Adhere to company-wide and specific performance standards.



Collaborate with team members to identify opportunities to improve service delivery.



Identify and proactively address scheduling challenges and process improvements.







How to Apply (Read Carefully)



We use structured systems and automation heavily, so attention to detail matters — starting with your application.



Step 1: Apply through OnlineJobs.ph



Step 2: In your application message, mention this EXACT role: Scheduler



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be considered.

Qualifications

title: GoHighLevel Builder, Part-Time or Full-Time, $10/hour, Path to Senior Builder
description:
GoHighLevel Builder, Part-Time or Full-Time, $10/hour, Path to Senior Builder



RATE: $10/hour USD, paid weekly via Wise



HOURS: Part-time (20 to 25 hours a week) or full-time (40 hours a week). Tell me which you want.



REQUIRED ONLINE: 3pm to 7pm Manila time every weekday (9am to 1pm Spain time)



START: Paid trial first, then ongoing



ABOUT THE ROLE



I run The Product Ladder, a small consultancy that builds websites, funnels and CRM systems for coaches, consultants and retreat operators. I do the sales, design, copy and front-end code. I need a GoHighLevel builder for everything behind it.



This role is designed to grow. The right person becomes our senior full-time builder, owning builds from brief to launch, with a rate review at 90 days.



WHAT YOU WILL BUILD



Forms with conditional logic, custom fields and consent checkboxes.



Workflows with triggers, if/else branches, wait steps and clear stop conditions.



Pipelines with automated stage movement.



Stripe products, deposits, payment plans and balance reminders.



 and SMS follow-up that stops when the contact books or pays.



Integrations through webhooks, Zapier or Make.



Applying the CSS classes I provide to native GoHighLevel sections.



Domain setup,
 authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and A2P where needed.



COMMUNICATION IS PART OF THE JOB



This matters more to me than any skill listed above.



During the 3pm to 7pm Manila window, you reply to messages within 30 minutes.



If something is blocked or unclear, you tell me the same day. You do not wait.



Before each task, you post an estimate in Slack. If a task reaches one and a half times your estimate, you stop and message me.



Every day you work, you send an end-of-day report: what you finished, hours per task, what is blocked, what is next.



When a task is done, you send a 2-minute Loom showing what you built and how you tested it.



If you cannot work a day, you tell me before it starts.



HOW I WORK



Time is tracked in Clockify against each task. No screenshots required.



AI tools are fine. You are responsible for everything they produce.



Nothing goes on a page that is not in the brief. No added text, logos, testimonials or sections.



You never show one client's account or work to anyone else.



You work alone, not through an agency or team.



YOU ARE A FIT IF



GoHighLevel has been your main platform for 3 years or more.



You can show at least 3 client builds you made yourself, and explain the back end of each, step by step.



You can be online 3pm to 7pm Manila every weekday.



You are confident in written and spoken English.



THE PROCESS



Step 1: Apply using the instructions below.



Step 2: A 15-minute call, camera on, with a live task in your own GoHighLevel account. You will also walk me through one of your automations from the trigger to the end.



Step 3: A paid trial of 20 hours at $10/hour ($200), paid via Wise at the end of the trial whether or not we continue.



Step 4: If it works, we continue part-time or full-time, with a rate review at 90 days.



Before the trial starts, you confirm your fixed daily hours and the terms in writing. The rate is not negotiated after the offer.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word BACKEND. Applications without it are not read.



Include all of the following:



A 2-minute unlisted Loom, camera on, recorded for this application. Start by saying "Hi Danny" and the title of this role. Then answer this question: "A contact fills in a deposit form for a retreat. Walk me through what should happen next in GoHighLevel, and how you stop the follow-up
s once they pay the balance."



Three GoHighLevel builds you made yourself, as live links or screenshots. For each one, list the forms, workflows and pipeline stages that exist in it today. Describe only what the build actually does.



Part-time or full-time, and your normal working hours in Manila time.



Every client or employer you currently work for, with hours per week.



Confirmation that you are happy with $10/hour.



Your earliest start date.



Every link is checked. If any build is not yours, not on GoHighLevel, or does less than you describe, the application is rejected. Videos recorded for other employers are not reviewed.

title: Appointment Setter / Inside Sales Specialist – U.S. Bathroom Renovations
description:
Appointment Setter / Inside Sales Specialist – U.S. Bathroom Renovations



Gold Standard Bathrooms is a growing U.S.-based bathroom remodeling company looking for an experienced, motivated, and dependable Appointment Setter / Inside Sales Specialist to join our team remotely.



This is NOT a general Virtual Assistant or administrative position. This is a sales and appointment-setting position.



Your primary responsibility will be to contact new and existing homeowner leads, qualify their bathroom remodeling needs, handle initial objections, and book qualified in-home consultation appointments for our sales team.



We generate leads through
, Instagram, our website, advertising campaigns, referrals, and other marketing sources. Many of the people you will contact have already expressed interest in remodeling their bathroom.



Your job is to turn that interest into a qualified appointment that actually takes place.



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING



Your daily responsibilities will include:



* Contacting new inbound leads quickly by phone and text

* Calling homeowners who submit
 and Instagram lead forms

* Calling website inquiries

* Following up with leads who do not initially respond

* Qualifying homeowners before scheduling appointments

* Learning what the homeowner wants to accomplish with their bathroom

* Determining whether they are interested in a shower replacement, bathtub replacement, tub-to-shower conversion, or larger bathroom renovation

* Confirming the homeowner is within our service area

* Determining the homeowner’s approximate project timeframe

* Asking appropriate qualification questions while keeping the conversation friendly and natural

* Explaining our free in-home consultation and what homeowners can expect

* Building value and excitement around the consultation

* Handling common objections professionally

* Asking for the appointment and confidently moving the homeowner toward scheduling

* Scheduling appointments directly into our calendar/CRM

* Confirming all homeowners/decision-makers involved with the project can be present for the consultation

* Sending appointment confirmations

* Calling and texting customers before appointments to reduce cancellations and no-shows

* Rescheduling canceled appointments

* Following up consistently with leads until a clear disposition is reached

* Re-engaging older leads that never scheduled

* Maintaining accurate notes, statuses, and follow-up tasks in our CRM

* Keeping our sales representatives’ calendars filled with qualified appointments



THIS IS A SALES POSITION



We want to be very clear about what we’re looking for.



We do not want someone who simply answers the phone and schedules whichever time a customer requests.



We want an inside-sales professional who knows how to convert leads into appointments.



You must be comfortable:



* Speaking with U.S. homeowners every day

* Making a high volume of outbound calls

* Responding quickly to new inbound leads

* Asking qualification questions

* Building rapport quickly

* Controlling a phone conversation professionally

* Handling objections

* Following a proven script/process

* Sounding natural instead of reading word-for-word from a script

* Asking confidently for the appointment

* Following up multiple times

* Hearing “no” without becoming discouraged

* Turning “maybe later” into an appointment when appropriate

* Being held accountable for measurable results



You should be friendly, professional, persistent, competitive, and results-driven.



COMMON OBJECTIONS YOU WILL NEED TO HANDLE



You should be comfortable responding naturally to homeowners who say things such as:



* “I’m just looking for a price.”

* “How much does it cost?”

* “I’m getting several estimates.”

* “I need to talk to my spouse.”

* “Just send me some information.”

* “I’m not ready yet.”

* “I’ll call you back.”

* “I’m just researching.”

* “I don’t know when I want to do it.”



Your goal is not to pressure homeowners. Your goal is to understand their needs, explain the value of the consultation, answer basic questions, and confidently ask for the appointment.



EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Previous experience with U.S. customers is strongly preferred.



Ideal candidates will have experience in one or more of the following:



* Appointment setting

* Inside sales

* Phone sales

* Outbound calling

* Inbound lead conversion

* Lead qualification

* Telemarketing

* Home improvement

* Bathroom remodeling

* Roofing

* Windows and doors

* HVAC

* Solar

* Kitchen remodeling

* Flooring

* Construction

* Other high-ticket U.S. home services



Previous U.S. home-improvement or home-services appointment-setting experience is a major plus.



We especially value candidates who have experience converting
, Instagram, website, or other inbound internet leads into appointments.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



You should have:



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Clear, confident, easy-to-understand phone communication

* Professional phone presence

* Strong listening skills

* Confidence speaking with U.S. homeowners

* Previous appointment-setting, telemarketing, inside-sales, or phone-sales experience

* Strong objection-handling skills

* Ability to follow scripts, systems, and processes

* Ability to sound conversational rather than robotic

* Strong organizational skills

* Accurate CRM/data-entry habits

* Excellent follow-up skills

* Reliable attendance

* Strong work ethic

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to accept coaching and feedback

* Stable high-speed internet

* Reliable computer

* Quality headset

* Quiet and professional work environment

* Backup internet and/or power solution strongly preferred



WORKING HOURS



This is a full-time position — minimum of 40 hours per week.



You MUST be available to work during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) because you will be communicating directly with homeowners in the United States.



Typical Schedule:



Monday–Friday during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



Some Saturday and Sunday availability WILL be REQUIRED depending on lead volume and appointment demand.



Reliability is extremely important.



We invest heavily in generating new homeowner leads, and speed-to-lead matters. When someone submits an inquiry, we want them contacted as quickly as possible.



This is intended to be a long-term, dedicated position. We are looking for someone who wants to become part of our team and grow with the company.



CRM & SOFTWARE



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* GoHighLevel / HighLevel

* LeadConnector

* CRM systems

* Online scheduling systems

* Phone dialers

* SMS/texting platforms

*
 lead management



If you have strong appointment-setting experience but haven’t used our exact software, we can train you on our systems.



COMPENSATION



Starting Base Pay: $6–$8 USD per hour depending on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability.



In addition to your hourly pay, you will have the opportunity to earn performance-based bonuses.



PERFORMANCE INCENTIVES



* $10 bonus for each properly qualified appointment that successfully sits/completes

* Additional $25 bonus when your appointment results in a completed sale

* Additional performance bonuses may be available for consistently exceeding company goals



For example:



A properly qualified appointment that takes place:



+$10 bonus



If that same appointment results in a sale:



+$25 additional bonus



That means an appointment that sits and sells can earn you $35 in bonuses, in addition to your regular hourly pay.



We intentionally reward quality appointments, not simply the number of appointments placed on the calendar.



HOW PERFORMANCE WILL BE MEASURED



This is a performance-driven position.



We will track metrics including:



* Speed-to-lead

* Number of outbound calls

* Number of leads contacted

* Contact rate

* Appointments booked

* Qualification rate

* Appointment booking rate

* Appointment confirmation rate

* Appointment show/sit rate

* Cancellation and no-show rate

* Sales resulting from your appointments

* Follow-up activity

* CRM accuracy



Quality matters just as much as quantity.



Putting an unqualified homeowner on the calendar simply to increase your appointment count does not help you or the company.



We want homeowners who understand why we are coming to their home, have a legitimate bathroom remodeling project, have been properly qualified, and are expecting our consultation.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



A successful person in this position does not call a new lead once and give up.



If a new lead doesn’t answer, you follow our contact process.



You call again.



You send a text.



You follow up.



You try different appropriate times.



You keep detailed notes.



You work older leads when new leads are caught up.



You confirm upcoming appointments.



You work canceled appointments.



You re-engage homeowners who previously said they weren’t ready.



You consistently look for opportunities throughout our lead database.



Your goal is simple:



Keep our sales representatives in front of qualified homeowners who are genuinely interested in remodeling their bathrooms.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity, not a temporary freelance project.



Strong performance, reliability, and consistently producing quality appointments can lead to:



* Increased hourly compensation

* Additional performance bonuses

* Increased responsibility

* Leadership opportunities as our inside-sales team grows



We want to build a strong appointment-setting operation and would like the right person to grow with us.



HOW TO APPLY



Please read this carefully.



At the very beginning of your application, write:



GOLD STANDARD



If those words are not at the beginning of your application, we will assume you did not read the entire posting.



Please answer ALL of the following:



1. Describe your previous appointment-setting and inside-sales experience.



2. Have you previously called U.S. customers? If yes, for what type of company?



3. Have you worked for a U.S. home-improvement or home-services company? If yes, tell us the industry and what your responsibilities were.



4. How many outbound calls are you comfortable making during a typical workday?



5. What CRM systems have you previously used?



6. Have you used GoHighLevel or LeadConnector before?



7. Tell us how you would respond to this homeowner:



“I’m interested in remodeling my shower, but I’m really just looking for a price right now.”



8. A new
 lead comes in and you call them immediately, but they don’t answer. What would you do next?



9. Are you available to work approximately 40 hours per week during U.S. Eastern Time hours?



10. Are you comfortable with performance metrics and being held accountable for appointment quality and results?



VOICE RECORDING REQUIRED



Please provide a short voice recording introducing yourself.



In your recording, tell us:



* Your name

* Your previous appointment-setting/sales experience

* Your experience speaking with U.S. customers

* Why you believe you would be successful in this position



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



We are specifically evaluating your English fluency, communication skills, confidence, professionalism, and ability to communicate naturally with U.S. homeowners.



FINAL NOTE



We are looking for someone who is:



Confident. Persistent. Dependable. Organized. Coachable. Competitive. Results-driven.



If you’re looking for a basic administrative VA position, this probably isn’t the right opportunity.



If you enjoy speaking with customers, know how to handle objections, aren’t afraid to pick up the phone, understand that follow-up creates opportunities, and want your performance to directly increase your earnings, we want to hear from you.



We are looking for the right person to become a long-term part of the Gold Standard Bathrooms team.

* Good spacing and page composition

* Integrating illustrations naturally with the text

* Creating a consistent visual style throughout an entire book



The final product should feel like a **professionally published illustrated book**, rather than a basic Word document with images pasted into it.



You will receive the written content and overall creative direction. Your job will be to turn that content into a visually strong, polished e-book.



### What We're Looking For



You should have strong skills in:



* Graphic design

* Editorial / book layout

* Illustration

* Typography

* Page composition

* Adobe InDesign, Affinity Publisher, Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar software

* Working with large documents

* Maintaining a consistent design style across hundreds of pages



Experience creating **e-books, magazines, books, reports, guides, or other long-form publications** is a major advantage.



Experience using **AI image-generation tools** as part of your design workflow is also a plus.



### Important



These books can contain **500–800 pages**, so you need to be:



* Organized

* Detail-oriented

* Consistent

* Able to follow an established visual style

* Comfortable working on large projects

* Able to notice problems without needing every small detail explained

* Reliable with deadlines and communication



We are looking for someone who can work with us **long-term**, not just for one project.



Our business produces content regularly, so there is potential for consistent ongoing work for the right person.



### To Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your graphic design experience

3. Examples of **books, e-books, magazines, PDFs, reports, or editorial layouts** you have designed

4. Examples of your illustration work

5. The software you normally use

6. Your expected hourly or monthly salary

7. Your availability per week



**Important:** Please include the word **“ILLUSTRATED”** at the beginning of your application so we know you have read the full job description.



We are especially interested in seeing examples where you have combined **text, illustrations, typography, and page design into one cohesive layout.**

title: Blog & Google Business Profile Operator
description:
To be considered for the role, fill out the application form: 





We're not looking for task-takers. We're looking for careful, reliable people who take pride in getting the small details right, and who want more hours and more responsibility as we grow.



Elefante is an SEO agency that helps HVAC and plumbing companies get more calls from Google. Every month we publish blogs and Google Business Profile posts for our clients, and we need someone to run that process from start to finish.



This is not a blog writing job. Our AI tools write the first drafts. Your job is to run the process, check the work, catch mistakes, and get each blog and post published the right way. You do not need SEO, blogging, or Google Business Profile experience. We train you step by step with a written guide and video walkthroughs.



Duties

Researching blog topics for each client using our research tools

Building the blog plan and running it through our AI tools

Qualifications

Strong written English. You can spot a typo, a clumsy sentence, or a fact that seems off

Comfortable learning new tools on a computer

About You

You are careful and you do not rush past mistakes

You would rather ask a question than guess
