title: FULL-TIME GENERAL VA – SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT MANAGEMENT
description:
We’re looking for a full-time General Virtual Assistant to help manage and create social media content for an artist brand inspired by 1990s hip-hop culture.



This is an entry-level, apprenticeship-style position, so you do not need an extensive résumé, years of social media experience, or advanced Canva skills to apply.



What matters most to us is that you are willing to learn, can follow instructions carefully, apply feedback, and have a genuine understanding or appreciation of the culture, energy, and aesthetic of 1990s American hip-hop.



If you’re creative, organized, reliable, and excited to grow your skills while working closely with an established visual system, we’d love to hear from you.





POSITION DETAILS

- Full-time

- $2 USD/hour

- Entry-level

- One-year contract

- Possibility of continuing beyond the first year based on performance

- Apprenticeship-style role with opportunities to learn and grow

- Remote



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Your primary responsibility will be helping create, manage, and organize social media content for a 90s hip-hop-inspired artist brand.



Your work will include:

- Creating single-image social media posts

- Designing multi-image carousels

- Editing short-form “Yap” videos and other social-first video content

- Writing and formatting simple social media copy

- Generating content ideas, hooks, and social media strategies

- Organizing social media assets, content, and workflows

- Scheduling and managing content using platforms like Metricool

- Monitoring social media performance metrics and identifying what content is performing well

- Using AI platforms like ChatGPT and Claude to support research, ideation, copywriting, and content development

- Working with automation tools like Make or Zapier to support social media workflows

- Working within Canva to create and adapt social media content

- Applying feedback and making revisions

- Helping develop and maintain a consistent look, voice, and feel across social media content



You do not need to already be an expert in all of these tools. This is an apprenticeship-style role, and we’re looking for someone who is comfortable learning new platforms, following instructions, applying feedback, and developing their skills over time.





WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

You may be a good fit if you:

- Have a strong willingness to learn

- Follow written and visual instructions carefully

- Are receptive to feedback and comfortable making revisions

- Pay attention to details

- Can stay organized and meet deadlines

- Have basic familiarity with Canva or are willing to learn it

- Have basic short-form video editing skills or are willing to develop them

- Understand, enjoy, or are genuinely interested in 1990s hip-hop and rap culture

- Can recognize the visual difference between authentic 90s hip-hop-inspired content and generic modern social media design

- Are dependable and communicate clearly when you have questions

- Good conversational English (required)



We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. We are looking for someone who is teachable, dependable, curious, and willing to improve.





HOW TO APPLY

Please send us:

- A short introduction about yourself.

- Tell us about your experience with Canva, social media, or video editing. Beginner experience is completely okay.

- Tell us about your familiarity with 1990s hip-hop culture. Who are some artists, albums, songs, visuals, fashion, or moments from the era that you know or enjoy?

- Share links or samples of any creative work you have done, if available. This can include Canva designs, social media posts, videos, school projects, personal projects, or other relevant work. A professional portfolio is not required.

- Tell us why this apprenticeship-style position interests you.



IMPORTANT: 

Put the word BOOMBOX in the subject line of your application so we know you read the entire job post.

Applications without the secret word in the subject line may not be considered.





HIRING PROCESS

- Applications will remain open for approximately one week.

- Candidates who move forward will be invited to complete a paid sample task involving three pieces of social media content. - You will be paid for up to four hours of work on the sample via Wise.

- After reviewing the paid samples, we will invite a smaller group of candidates to interview.

- Interviews are expected to take place during the week of October 5, with a target start date of October 12. 





If you’re early in your career and looking for an opportunity where you can learn, practice your creative skills, receive feedback, and grow through hands-on work, we encourage you to apply.

title: Virtual Assistant/Amazon Wholesale Sourcing Specialist (US-experienced) – Athenawholesale.co
description:
Pay: $10-15 USD per hour, based on experience. Paid monthly in USD. 13th month. Paid time off and Philippine public holidays.



Hours: Full-time, 40 hours a week, US business hours.



Location: Remote (Philippines).



Reports to: Danny, Managing Director.



Who we are



- Athena Wholesale (athenawholesale.co) is a wholesale distributor for Amazon sellers.

- We buy stock from brands and distributors in the UK and US and sell it to approved trade accounts. Toys and games including Games Workshop. Consumer goods like Gillette, Colgate and Ariel. Books from Walker Books. Fragrance and cosmetics like David Beckham and Montblanc.

- Every product in our portal shows the live Amazon numbers next to our trade price. Buy Box, fees, sales rank, monthly sales estimate and ROI. Our customers are serious Amazon sellers and their orders run from $3,000 to six figures.

- We are a small team and everyone in it is genuinely good at their job. This role joins that team and works directly with me.



The role



- You have spent years finding profitable wholesale products for a US Amazon seller. Reading Keepa charts, checking sellers on a listing, working out real ROI after fees, chasing distributors and brands for accounts.

- This role puts you on the other side of the table.

- Instead of hunting for products to buy, you make sure the products we already have are presented so a seller can see the profit in ten seconds. You tell us what we need to get from a brand for a line to sell. And you help d
 what we add next.

- No cold calling and no outreach. This is a catalogue and supply-side role. Our customers are people exactly like your old boss, so you already know what they need to see.



 What you will do



- Make every product look right. Check titles, images and the Amazon match on each line. Flag the wrong ASIN, the dead listing, the ROI that does not add up. When a seller opens our portal the numbers have to be true.

- Set the target prices. Some brands land in our system at prices that give a seller no ROI. You spot them, work out what cost we would need for the numbers to work, and tell us exactly what to go back to the brand for. You are not parsing files or loading data. Our systems do that. You are the one who knows what price a seller will actually buy at.

- D
 what leads. Every category has a handful of lines that should be at the top. You pick them and you show the numbers behind the pick.

- Build deal sheets. We send named customers exclusive offers on specific brands. You build the sheet, price by price, from our cost data and the live Amazon data.

- Answer the profit question. When a customer or our sales team asks why a line is worth buying, you have the answer ready.

- Grow into the admin. As you learn our systems you take on order confirmations, invoices and supplier follow-ups so the team runs without me in the middle of it.

- You will use Keepa, Helium 10 and our own portal every day. You will use Claude AI as a daily tool. Our CRM and order systems update themselves, so your time goes on the catalogue and not on data entry.



What we are looking for



- Two or more years doing wholesale sourcing for a US-based Amazon seller. This is the core requirement.

- You can look at a listing and tell me in a minute whether it is worth stocking. Buy cost, Buy Box, fees, sales velocity, number of sellers, price history.

- You know how brand-direct and distributor accounts get opened and what a wholesale price has to be for a seller to say yes.

- You are comfortable in a spreadsheet and you catch the line that is wrong.

- Clear written English. You will write product notes and short emails to suppliers.

- You work well without being watched and you tell me early when something looks off.



Nice to have



- Experience with SellerAmp, SmartScout or similar.

- Experience with the UK Amazon marketplace as well as the US.

- You have opened wholesale accounts with brands yourself, not only researched them.



Why this role



- Top of the market pay for the Philippines, and it rises as you take on more.

- You are on the core team of a growing wholesale business, not one VA among fifty.

- Everything you learned about sourcing now has a second use, and it is more valuable on this side.

- If you ever want to speak to customers as well, that door is open. We would rather grow you than hire around you.



How to apply



- Email 
 or apply through OLJ with the words "Buy Box" in the subject line so I know you read this far.

- Include your CV.

- Include one product or brand you personally sourced for an Amazon seller. Give me the buy cost, the Buy Box price, the fees, the ROI and why you picked it. Real numbers from real work, nothing made up.

- Tell me when you can start and the rate you are targeting within the range above.

- I read every application myself.

title: Social Media Content Creator
description:
Full-Time Social Media Content Creator



Remote | Music, Nightlife & Educational Events



We are looking for a **full-time Social Media Content Creator** to manage daily content for three New York City brands: Sour Mouse, Sugar Mouse, and PhDs & Pints.



Our NYC team will provide a continuous library of raw photos, videos, concert footage, event flyers, interviews and lecture recordings. **You do not need to film content.** Your job is to transform our raw material into engaging social-media content.



Posting Expectations



You will create and publish approximately **2 posts per day for each brand**, or about **6 posts per day / 180 posts per month**.



Content will include Instagram Reels, TikToks, short lecture clips, concert clips, photo posts, carousels, artist/professor spotlights, upcoming-event promotions and event recaps.



The goal is **not simply to post six times a day**. We want someone who learns what performs, identifies the strongest moments in our footage, and continually improves our content.



### Your Responsibilities



* Review photos and videos uploaded by our NYC team

* Turn raw footage into engaging Reels and TikToks

* Identify strong hooks and interesting moments

* Edit videos with captions, music and text overlays

* Create simple graphics and carousels

* Write engaging captions

* Maintain a content calendar

* Schedule and publish content consistently

* Maintain a distinct identity for each of our three brands

* Repurpose strong footage across platforms when appropriate

* Track which content performs best

* Develop new content ideas based on trends and performance

* Communicate with our NYC marketing team



### The Three Brands



**Sour Mouse** — An NYC live-music and nightlife venue featuring jazz, blues, bands, DJs and community events. Content should feel authentic, energetic and music-driven.



**Sugar Mouse** — A large NYC entertainment venue featuring live music, nightlife, games, dancing and events. Content should communicate **“this looks like a fun place to go with friends.”**



**PhDs & Pints** — Professors and experts giving fascinating talks in a bar setting. Content should turn longer lectures into compelling short clips that make viewers think:



> **“I didn't know that—I want to hear more.”**



### Ideal Candidate



You should have strong experience with **Instagram Reels, TikTok and short-form video editing** and be comfortable with tools such as CapCut, Canva, Premiere Pro or similar software.



We're looking for someone who understands **hooks, storytelling, pacing and social-media trends**, has strong written English, works independently and can eventually understand our brands well enough that we don't need to tell you what to create every day.



Experience with **music, nightlife, hospitality, events or educational content** is a major plus.



### Full-Time Position



This is intended to be an **ongoing, long-term position**, not a short freelance project.



Applicants should provide their **desired monthly salary in USD**, availability and normal working hours.



### How to Apply



Please send us your resume or brief introduction, links to social-media accounts you've managed, 3–5 examples of Reels/TikToks you've personally created, the editing software you use, your desired monthly salary, and your availability.



**Begin your application with “SOUR MOUSE” so we know you read the entire posting.**



### Paid Finalist Test



Selected finalists will receive the **same folder of raw content** and will be paid to create three pieces:



**1 Sour Mouse post • 1 Sugar Mouse post • 1 PhDs & Pints post**



We'll evaluate **the hook, editing, storytelling, caption, brand fit and overall creativity**.

title: Experienced Fashion Ecommerce Customer Service Representative (Female)
description:
Female | Remote | Philippines | 6–8 Hours/Day | Long-Term 



We are looking for an experienced female Customer Service Representative to become the first dedicated CS team member for our growing ecommerce business.  



We currently operate 3 women's fashion ecommerce stores focused on the US market and our current refund rate for each store is below 3%. Your job is to keep it at that level.



This is not a general VA or beginner position. We are specifically looking for someone with strong ecommerce customer service experience, preferably within fashion dropshipping.

What We Offer



You won't be starting from scratch. We already have:

• A large library of ready-to-use response templates

• Detailed video training and SOPs explaining how we handle CS

• Clear policies and workflows

• AI tools that help draft customer responses

• Established communication with our suppliers



Your job is to understand each customer's situation, use the right template when applicable, and adjust or fine-tune responses using your own judgment. You should never blindly copy a template or AI-generated response.



Your Responsibilities

You'll handle customer support through ReAmaze across our 3 stores, including:

• Shipping delays & tracking issues

• De-escalating dispute / chargeback threats (we believe as a woman you'll more easily be able to get into the minds our customers; who are all women and will be able to talk slow, empathetic and fact based - in order to get customers out of their emotional state and come back to reason)

• Returns, refunds & exchanges

• Damaged, incorrect or missing items

• Sizing & quality complaints

• Order changes & cancellations

• "Not received" / "not as described" complaints

• Difficult or unhappy customers

• Refund prevention & customer retention

• Communicating order issues with our supplier



We use Shopify, ReAmaze and Slack.



Requirements

You must have:

• Proven ecommerce customer service experience

• Preferably fashion dropshipping experience

• Strong Shopify experience

• Experience supporting US customers

• Fluent written English

• Strong common sense and independent decision-making

• Ability to follow SOPs while knowing when a situation requires adjustment

• Ability to fine-tune AI-generated responses so they sound natural and appropriate

• Confidence handling difficult customers

• Excellent attention to detail



Experience with ReAmaze is preferred, although Gorgias/Zendesk experience is also relevant.



Because our three stores exclusively focus on women's fashion for the US market, we are specifically looking for a female Customer Service Representative.



Working Hours

This is a 6–8 hour/day position, split into two shifts:

Morning: 2–4 hours

Afternoon / early evening: 2–4 hours



This allows us to keep the inbox covered throughout the day rather than answering customers only once every 24 hours.



We're looking for someone interested in a stable, long-term position.



Growth Opportunity

You'll be the first dedicated CS representative joining our team.

We're looking for someone who is genuinely great at customer service first. However, as we grow and hire additional representatives, there will be an opportunity for the right person to progress into a Customer Service Manager position.



How to Apply

Start your application with the words:

FASHION CS



Then answer:

1. How many years of ecommerce CS experience do you have?

2. Which fashion/dropshipping stores have you worked for?

3. How many tickets did you typically handle per hour?

title: Amazon PPC Specialist
description:
ABOUT US



Tilz Collection is an established UK food gifting brand. Our range includes spice collections, hot sauces, coffee, tea, hot chocolate and advent calendars.



We sell on Amazon UK, Germany, France, US, Canada and Australia, with stock held in the UK and in overseas fulfilment locations. We are a team of twelve with our own warehouse in northern England.



This is a full time, long term remote role working directly with our business. There is no agency in the middle.



THE ROLE



We are looking for an experienced Amazon PPC specialist to take full ownership of our advertising from day one: strategy, campaign management, optimisation, budgets, reporting and performance.



You will work across six marketplaces and two Seller Central accounts, within agreed budgets and commercial targets.



We expect you to assess the accounts, establish priorities and drive improvements independently. You should be confident making informed decisions, explaining your reasoning and taking responsibility for performance.



Your focus is profitable advertising. Listing copywriting, uploads and catalogue administration are handled separately. You will identify when listing quality, pricing, reviews or stock availability are affecting advertising performance, and work with the relevant team member to address them.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Audit existing campaigns and develop a clear advertising plan for each marketplace.

Create, manage and optimise Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display campaigns where appropriate.

Own campaign structure, keyword and product targeting, bids, placements, budgets and negative keywords.

Analyse search terms to identify opportunities, reduce wasted spend and support profitable growth.

Allocate spend according to product margins, performance, stock availability and business priorities.

Check marketplace specific stock availability and replenishment plans before increasing spend.

Plan and execute advertising for new launches, seasonal products and peak trading.

Monitor performance each working day and respond promptly to significant changes during agreed working hours.

Provide weekly reporting covering spend, advertising sales, total sales, ACoS, TACoS and progress against agreed targets.

Explain what changed, why, what you have done and what you recommend next.

Keep a clear record of significant campaign changes and assess their impact.



WORKING WITH OUR TEAM



You will share useful search terms, keyword opportunities and conversion issues with the person responsible for listing content. Your recommendations should explain what needs attention and why.



An existing colleague manages catalogue and account health, including suppressed listings, stranded inventory and Seller Support cases. You will coordinate with her when technical issues affect advertising eligibility or performance.



You will have access to other experienced freelancers for collaboration and second opinions, while retaining ownership of the advertising plan and its execution.



OUR AMAZON BUSINESS



Six marketplaces: UK, Germany, France, US, Canada and Australia.

Two Seller Central accounts.

Over 75 parent listings.

Peak trading from mid November to mid December, with monthly advertising spend exceeding US$30,000 during that period.



You will receive approved user access to the accounts. Keep your access secure, never share credentials, and always confirm the correct account and marketplace before making changes.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Proven experience independently owning Amazon PPC strategy and campaign management.

Evidence of results, with a clear explanation of your personal contribution.

Strong understanding of profitability, ACoS, TACoS and budget allocation.

Practical experience with Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display.

Strong keyword research, search term analysis and spreadsheet skills.

Experience managing advertising through at least one Q4 peak.

Confidence using Amazon Ads, Seller Central and relevant research or advertising tools.

Clear written English and the ability to explain recommendations simply.

Sound judgement about when to act immediately and when to wait for more data.

Ability to prioritise and work independently without daily instructions.

Reliable internet and a backup arrangement.



Experience across multiple marketplaces, particularly UK, US and EU, is an advantage. Food, gifting and seasonal product experience is also valuable.



SALARY AND WORKING HOURS



PHP 80,000 to 105,000 per month for 40 hours per week, depending on experience and demonstrated expertise.



Working days are Monday to Friday, with flexible hours. You can organise your schedule independently, with some availability during UK business hours for agreed meetings and team coordination.



We expect consistent monitoring, timely communication and delivery against agreed priorities.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application message with CARDAMOM.



Please include:



Your CV or profile and a brief summary of your Amazon PPC experience, including the marketplaces you have managed and the largest monthly advertising budget you personally controlled.

One PPC case study covering the starting position, monthly spend, your actions, results and timeframe. Explain your personal contribution and remove confidential client information.

In under 200 words, explain what you would review in your first week across our six marketplaces and two accounts, what you would leave unchanged until you had more data, and why.

Tell us whether you also write listing content yourself, titles, bullet points and backend search terms. It is not required for this role, but it is useful for us to know.

A 90 second introduction video and an internet speed test screenshot.

Your current work commitments, earliest start date, preferred working schedule, availability for meetings during UK business hours and your expected monthly salary within the advertised range.



Please address every point so we can assess your application properly.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a 90 minute practical assessment covering PPC analysis, prioritisation and campaign decisions. We pay PHP 1,600 for completing it, whether or not you progress.



Candidates who progress will then attend a 45 minute video interview to discuss their experience, assessment and approach.

- You get uncomfortable when results plateau, and you don't wait to be told to fix it.

- You make decisions based on data, not gut feeling.

- You actively experiment with SEO, AI, automations, and new workflows because building efficient systems is something you actually enjoy.

- AI is part of your daily workflow, and you take full advantage of it.

- You hold yourself to a high standard in everything you do, not just the parts people are watching.

- You're genuinely invested in the success of your clients and your colleagues, not just your own output.

- You know how to keep the team updated and ask the right questions without being policed.

- You're comfortable talking to clients, shooting video reports, and keeping them in the loop because their results matter to you.

- You see your work as more than just a paycheck.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

- Running Ahrefs audits, technical cleanups, and site maintenance (zombie pages, crawl issues, the works) without being asked twice

- Identifying constraints, bottlenecks, and growth opportunities across your accounts and acting on them

- Keeping clients informed through video reports and direct communication — because you're invested in their success



What Makes You Stand Out

We don't want someone who checks tasks off a list and calls it a day. We want someone who digs deeper because this is genuinely something they care about.

- You own outcomes, not tasks. You understand SEO and local SEO as a whole system, and you take full responsibility for what happens on your accounts. Agency experience is a must.

- You see what others miss. You analyze data to find constraints and improvements and you act on them without being asked.

title: Client Success Coach (Health & Fitness) - Registered dietitian / Fitness Coach
description:
Client Experience Coach (Health & Fitness)



Company: REAL Training Type: Part-time, 20 hours/week (4 hours/day, 5 days/week) Pay: $300 to $600 per month, with room to grow into more hours over time Reports to: Jenny & Ben (Co-Founders)



About Us



We run a health and fitness transformation program that helps clients change their bodies, their mindset, and their lives. Our clients trust us to guide them through a full journey, and the experience we give them is everything. We are looking for someone who lives and breathes health and fitness to become the heartbeat of our client experience.



What You'll Actually Do



This is not a vague "coaching support" role. Here is the real work, week in and week out.



Manage a roster of clients. You will own the day to day relationship with your clients. That means responding to their messages inside our platform within 24 hours on weekdays, checking in when they go quiet, celebrating their wins, and catching the warning signs of someone about to fall off before they actually do. You are the person they think of when they think of REAL Training.



Build individualized programs. You will create and adjust training programs and nutrition frameworks based on each client's intake data, goals, injury history, schedule, equipment access, and food preferences. You will revise these programs as clients progress or stall. A program you wrote in week one should not still be running unchanged in week eight.



Prepare weekly check in reports. Every client submits a weekly check in. You will review their numbers, photos, training logs, food logs, sleep, energy, and notes, then write back a personalized response that tells them what is working, what is not, exactly what changes to make this week, and why. These reports are the single most visible thing we deliver. They need to be thoughtful, specific, and on time every single week.



Run challenges. We run recurring challenges to drive engagement and results. You will help plan them, write the daily prompts and content, track participation on a leaderboard, answer questions in the group, keep energy high, and announce and reward winners.



Keep fulfillment trackers current. You will update our client trackers daily so the founders always know where every client stands: onboarding status, check in completion, program phase, progress metrics, engagement level, and renewal risk. If it is not in the tracker, it did not happen.



Onboard new clients successfully. You will run the onboarding sequence for every new client: welcome message, intake review, kickoff call or kickoff message, app and platform setup, baseline measurements, expectation setting, and first program delivery. Every new client should be fully set up and training inside their first week.



And more. This is a small team and an early stage program. You will also help improve our templates, content library, SOPs, and the program itself as we learn what works. If you see something broken, we want you to fix it, not report it and wait.



Requirements

Fluent, natural spoken and written English. You will be talking to clients directly, on video and in writing, every day.

Strong communicator. You can explain a complicated nutrition or training concept to someone with zero background and have them actually understand it and act on it.

You live an active, fit life yourself. You train consistently, you eat in a way you would be comfortable teaching, and you can speak from experience and not just theory. Our clients can tell the difference.

Reliable and organized. Weekly check ins do not slide. Trackers do not go stale.

Comfortable working independently across time zones with async communication.

Certifications



You do not need to be a Registered Dietitian. What we care about far more is that you can coach real people to real results.



That said, high level nutrition and fitness certifications are strongly preferred. Examples of what stands out: NASM, ACE, ISSA, NSCA CSCS, Precision Nutrition L1 or L2, ISSN, FDN-P, functional or holistic nutrition credentials, or equivalent. Tell us what you hold and what you actually use from it.



Nice to Have

Experience coaching clients online at scale, not just one on one in a gym

Comfort inside coaching platforms, Google Sheets, and messaging tools

Experience running group challenges or community engagement

Content creation ability for challenge prompts and educational material

How to Apply



Send us a Loom video, 3 to 5 minutes, that covers:



Who you are and what your own health and fitness life looks like right now

Your certifications and coaching experience, including how many clients you have managed at once

Walk us through how you would write a weekly check in report for a client who lost zero pounds this week but hit every workout

Why you want this role specifically



Attach your resume and any certifications alongside the Loom.



Applications without a Loom will not be reviewed.

title: E-Commerce Customer Service Manager (AI-Led Support)
description:
E-Commerce Customer Service Manager (AI-Led Support)



Please read "How to apply" before applying. Applications that don't follow it will be deleted without being read.



Remote · UK-based company with team members in the UK and the Philippines · Competitive salary, based on experience · Full-time



MySweetSmile is an established UK oral care brand selling internationally across multiple sales channels. We're rebuilding customer service around an AI agent, and we're hiring a Customer Service Manager to own it: the agent, the team and the processes behind both.



This is not a standard customer service job. Our AI agent handles the routine conversations. Everything that reaches you is the work it can't do:

• Escalations

• Complaints

• Negative reviews

• Chargebacks

• Marketplace disputes



Every one of these is written by hand, and every one carries real consequences for the business. There's no template to hide behind.



What you'll be doing

• Write the responses that matter. Handle escalations, negative reviews, chargeback evidence, marketplace cases, reimbursement claims and disputes personally. You write each one yourself, to a standard that wins them.



• Own our AI support agent across every customer channel. That covers its prompts, knowledge base and skills. Review its conversations every day, work out why a response went wrong, and fix the instruction behind it.



• Build internal AI tools with Claude. Create and maintain Claude Projects and custom Skills that help the team draft, check and resolve cases faster.



• Write and maintain our SOPs in Notion, so the team, the AI agent and our internal tools all work from the same playbook.

• Lead our customer service team, reporting to our Head of Operations, and run it day-to-day in Slack.



• Report in detail:

    ◦ Daily: a short written update in Slack on what happened, what's stuck, and what the AI got wrong and how you fixed it.



    ◦ Weekly: ticket volumes by type, channel and country; response and resolution times; how much the AI resolved on its own; refunds and replacements issued; and dispute and case outcomes.



    ◦ Weekly, and most important: the three things breaking most often in the process, and what you're changing to fix them.

  We expect numbers, not impressions.



Who we're looking for

• Flawless written English. Not good. Perfect. Every chargeback response, marketplace dispute and public review reply goes out under our name, and a single error costs credibility with customers, banks and marketplaces. You'll write clearly, persuasively and precisely, in a tone that treats customers with respect.



• Excellent communication and organisation. You keep a team, an AI agent and several sales channels across multiple countries running without anything falling through the gaps. You communicate clearly and concisely in writing, and you never leave people guessing where things stand.



• Hands-on experience with Claude, including building Projects and writing custom Skills. You've built something your team actually uses.



• Hands-on experience improving an AI agent or chatbot. You've written or edited its instructions, you can explain why it gave a bad answer, and you've fixed it.



• 3+ years in eCommerce customer service, including at least 1 year managing people.



• Dispute experience: chargebacks, marketplace cases or payment disputes, where the quality of your writing d
 the outcome.



• Shopify, Amazon Seller Central and TikTok Shop experience. Confident in Slack and Notion. Experience with an AI helpdesk platform is a strong bonus.



• Systems-minded: you fix broken processes rather than working around them.



• Fast and proactive: you flag problems as they happen rather than sitting on them.



How to apply

We receive a high volume of applications. Anything that doesn't follow these instructions exactly, including the subject line, will be deleted without being read.



Apply through OnlineJobs only. Applications sent by
 will be ignored. Use the subject line "MSS Customer Service Manager — Application", and include:



1. A short note on your experience managing a support team and working with AI tools, including anything you've built with Claude.



2. Write this reply. Write the
 you'd send, exactly as the customer would receive it, in no more than 200 words.

   A customer's order was marked as delivered, with a courier photo of a door that isn't hers. We sent a replacement. That has now also been marked as delivered, and she hasn't received it. She says she's been fobbed off twice, wants the owner's
 address, and is about to leave a one-star review.



3. Fix this situation. In no more than 300 words, tell us what you'd do in your first two weeks.

   Tickets are arriving faster than the team can answer them, and the backlog is growing daily. Customers who don't hear back are chasing on several channels at once, so the same issue is arriving three times. Some are going straight to public reviews or their bank.



4. One process you improved: what was broken, what you changed, and what happened.



Your application is your first writing sample, and we'll read it that way. Write your answers in your own words.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a Stage 1 interview, where you'll talk your answers through with our CEO. If successful, you'll complete a paid trial task, followed by a Stage 2 final interview, attended by our Head of Operations and CEO.

title: Senior AI Video Editor
description:
Most editors get handed a brief, told what to make, and spend the next three days waiting on a creative strategist to approve their ideas.



That’s not how this role works.



At DealFuel, you’ll own the entire creative canvas. 



Spotting a winning angle… 



Writing the script… 



Generating the visuals… 



Editing the final ad… 



…And seeing how it performs in the market.



→ You won’t need to wait for someone else to come up with the concept

→ There’s no five layers of approval between you and a great idea

→ You won’t be boxed into one format, style, or offer 



You’ll have the autonomy to experiment with emerging AI tools, jump on viral formats, and turn ideas into finished creatives while everyone else is still talking about them.



And you won’t be making disposable ads for another generic dropshipping store. You’ll work across established products and services in B2B recruitment, SaaS, AI, infoproducts, and high-ticket markets — including DealFuel itself.



We’re looking for someone who wants to be more than an editor. Someone who wants to own the creative, influence the results, and become exceptional at the entire craft.



If that sounds like you, here’s what the role looks like.



Overview: 



Your job will be to create world class, high-converting creatives (video ads, launch videos, statics) – across multiple different formats – end-to-end. Meaning, you’ll research, ideate, script, co-ordinate with creators (if relevant), edit, and handle post-production – all by yourself. 



(At the start, scripts can be provided – but the goal is to become an 360 ‘creative producer’) 



Specific formats include, but are not limited to: 



→ B2B Motion Graphics ads

→ UGC ads (with real creators)

→ Ai UGC ads (with AI avatars)

→ Ai Yapper ads (with AI avatars)

→ Ai Podcast ads (with AI avatars)

→ Claymation ads (with animated characters)

→ AI song ads (with custom Suno songs + animations) 

→ Ai UGC Video sales letters (5-15 minutes long) 



Who we’re looking for: 



→ You’re a senior editor or creative strategist with dozens of winning ads under your belt.

→ You ‘live’ online - and you know exactly which formats are viral at any time. 

→ You study winning ads & content across multiple niches every single day. 

→ You’re obsessed with becoming the best creative producer in the world.

→ You’ve gone through multiple paid courses or coaching programs. 

→ You’re ‘in-the-know’ of the latest and best AI tools & workflows.

→ You’re highly competent with AI video gen & editing tools. 



KPIs: 



We know there’s a big difference between editing a 45-second UGC ad and a 5-minute motion graphics video – so there’s no exact KPI for the number of net new creatives per week or per month. 



But the north-star metric is to reach roughly 40 minutes of UNIQUE edited material per month. 



Compensation: 



First, we will do a small test of 3 creatives to see if the style and quality are on-par. 



Next, we will start with a trial month, which will be at $1,500-$3,500+ depending on seniority and skill. 



Should we both wish to proceed, we will negotiate a long term compensation package. This will depend on level of experience, output, and availability. But the target compensation long term is: 



→ $5,000-$6,000 per month base salary 

→ $250-$500+ bonus per winning ad 



*Both base & bonuses are negotiable. If you make us a lot of money, we want you to make a lot, too. 



Think you could take our creatives to a level we haven’t even imagined yet?



We’d love to see what you can do.



Apply below with your portfolio, 3–5 ads you’re most proud of, and a short note explaining what made them successful and which parts of the creative process you owned.



Show us your best work. Let’s see what we can build together.

title: Software Engineer (Full-Stack, AI & Integrations) - Remote
description:
THE ROLE 



You'll build and run the production tools our operations teams depend on: dashboards, integrations, AI assistants, and automations that connect the platforms we use. Most of the work involves integrations. You'll pull data from several third-party systems, reconcile it, and get it to the right person at the right time.

- Build full-stack internal apps. Modern front ends, reliable back ends, and cloud deployment.

- Own integrations. Build and maintain API integrations, webhooks, and sync jobs. Handle rate limits, retries, pagination, and data that doesn't match across systems.

- Make prototypes production-ready. Add authentication, error handling, logging, tests, and access control, and get them through architecture review.

- Build AI features. Build LLM-powered assistants, classification and flagging, and search over operational data. Include evaluation and cost controls.

- Run what you ship. Own monitoring, alerting, i
 response, and performance fixes.

- Replace fragile automations. Move critical no-code workflows into maintainable code once they outgrow their tools.

- Document as you go. Write READMEs, runbooks, and data flow notes so any teammate can pick up a tool.

- Help build our AI agents. Set up agents for development and testing, and design the guardrails that keep a person in the loop.



WHAT YOU BRING

- 3+ years of professional software engineering, including production full-stack work

- Strong JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern front-end framework, plus back-end experience

- Real experience with third-party REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and background jobs

- SQL and data modeling

- Hands-on work with LLM APIs: prompting, structured output, tool use, and the ways they fail

- Security fundamentals: authentication, secrets management, input validation, and least-privilege data access

NICE TO HAVE

Experience deploying on cloud platforms

Experience with no-code and low-code automation

Exposure to hospitality, property management, or construction software

Experience using AI coding tools with a disciplined workflow that includes code review and tests



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

3 months - Every tool they own has monitoring, documentation, and a runbook. Alerts catch integration issues before users report them.

LONG-TERM • FULL-TIME • DIRECT HIRE • $7–$10/HOUR



Do you know medical billing inside and out, and enjoy getting a denied claim paid? Help a growing podiatry practice keep its billing clean, its patients informed and its phones covered.



ABOUT US

Balance Foot & Ankle is a doctor-owned podiatry (foot and ankle) practice in Michigan, USA, with 3 doctors and 2 offices in Howell and Bloomfield Hills, and we're growing. Our founder, Dr. Tom Biernacki, is a double board-certified foot and ankle surgeon who also teaches foot health on YouTube. We're building a small, reliable virtual team and adding a Podiatry Billing Manager for the long term.



YOUR ROLE

You'll own our day-to-day billing in athenaOne, from clean claims to paid claims, and be the go-to person for patients' billing questions. You'll also back up our Medical Front Desk VA on patient calls, so our phones are always covered.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Review charges and clear claim holds so clean claims go out quickly

• Work rejections and denials: find the root cause, then correct, resubmit or appeal before the deadline

• Follow up on unpaid claims (A/R) by payer and age, using Availity, payer portals and phone

• Verify eligibility and help with referrals and prior authorizations when needed

• Answer patient billing questions about statements and balances, set up payment plans within our policy, and help patients pay online

• Back up the front desk on patient calls and texts in Quo during busy times, breaks and days off

• Spot patterns (a code, a modifier or a payer that keeps denying) and suggest fixes so they stop happening

• Send Dr. Tom a short weekly billing update by
: what got paid, what's stuck and what needs his decision



WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

• Claims go out clean and quickly, and nothing sits on hold

• Every denial is worked, corrected or appealed before its deadline

• Old unpaid claims shrink month over month

• Patients get clear, kind answers about their bills

• The phones are covered whenever the front desk is busy or away



TOOLS (we set up your accounts and train you)

• athenaOne (athenahealth): claims, worklists, denials, A/R and patient balances

• Availity and payer portals

• Quo: patient calls and texts

• Google Workspace: practice
, Drive, Docs and Sheets

title: Klaviyo EDM Lifecycle & Retention Strategist — Agency Experience,
description:
Please send your application to 
 the role

We’re looking for an experienced
 retention strategist to help guide lifecycle marketing across multiple ecommerce sites.

You’ll review strategies, identify opportunities and risks, and shape recommendations grounded in customer behavior and account performance. You’ll also work with our AI development and product teams, sharing practical experience and turning your judgment into guidelines, examples, and feedback that help improve our tools and workflows.



What you’ll own

- Strategy review: Evaluate audience definitions, automated
 flows, and campaign calendars. Explain what needs to change and why.

- Audience and frequency decisions: Define who receives each message, who is excluded, how often they receive it, and what conditions should change those decisions.

- Performance diagnosis: Identify whether weak results come from limited reach, targeting, frequency, content, deliverability, or misleading measurement.

- Account transitions: Guide strategy when accounts migrate platforms, restart after inactivity, or have incomplete engagement history.

- Direction for AI agents: Write clear briefs, decision rules, and feedback that agents can follow. Check that their revisions address the original problem.

- Ongoing account management: Prioritize work across accounts and explain the reasoning behind your recommendations.

Experience we’re looking for

You should have personally owned lifecycle or retention strategy for ecommerce brands, preferably at a Klaviyo-focused agency or while managing multiple client accounts.

Your experience should include several of the following:

- Platform migration, account reactivation, sending warm-up, or deliverability recovery.

- Segmentation using purchase history, engagement, consent, exclusions, and time windows.

- Frequency management and decisions about when a subscriber has received enough
 to judge their response.

- Account audits that led to specific changes and measurable results.

- Understanding the difference between Klaviyo-attributed revenue and incremental revenue, including the use of control or holdout groups.

- Writing briefs or SOPs, reviewing others’ work, or guiding junior marketers and AI tools.

Agency names, certifications, and cumulative revenue claims are useful context. We will assess the decisions you personally made and the evidence behind them.



How to apply

Please include:

1. Your relevant experience

Name the agencies you worked with, your role and dates, and how many accounts you managed at the same time. Explain which strategic decisions you owned.

2. One account case study

Describe:

- The problem you identified.

- The evidence you used.

- What you changed and why.

- The outcome, including the measurement period and either the starting baseline, list size, or attribution window.

Anonymized examples are welcome. Please distinguish your own work from the team’s work.

3. A short diagnostic response

An account restarts after 13 months without sending. An AI agent recommends sending only to subscribers who engaged within the last 90 days, leaving an audience of 6,000.

What would you check before approving this audience? What additional data would you request, and how would it affect your recommendation?

A few clear paragraphs are enough. We are assessing your reasoning; no account access or unpaid implementation is required.

4. Your availability and rate

State your hourly rate, available hours per week, time zone, earliest start date, and whether existing commitments allow you to provide at least four hours per working day.

We value clear judgment, specific evidence, and the ability to challenge an incorrect recommendation—even when it comes from our own tools.

title: Online Phonics and English Teacher for Kids
description:
CurioKids teaches children aged 4 to 12 in Singapore and Malaysia to read and speak English through live, 1-to-1 online lessons. Every child starts with our Phonics Starter, learning to read sound by sound using the UK Letters and Sounds method, then moves on to our CEFR-aligned English course.



We launch on 2 November 2026 and are building our founding team of teachers. You will be trained directly by our Head of Curriculum, a qualified phonics teacher.



THE ROLE

- Teach live 25-minute 1-to-1 phonics and English lessons to children aged 4 to 12, using our ready-made lesson materials

- Run free trial lessons: a friendly lesson, a quick check of which sounds the child knows, and a short summary for parents

- Write brief notes after every lesson and help prepare progress updates for parents

- Record a short "Meet the Teacher" video for our website, as parents choose their own teacher

- Cover lessons for colleagues when needed

- Follow our safeguarding rules in every lesson

- Join weekly team meetings, training and lesson reviews



SCHEDULE (Philippine time, same as Singapore and Malaysia, so no night shifts)

40 hours a week over 5 days:

- 4 weekdays, 12pm to 9pm, with one weekday off each week (agreed with you so the team is covered every day)

- 1 weekend day of your choice, Saturday or Sunday, 9am to 6pm

Your hours include time for lesson notes, preparation and team meetings, not just teaching.



PAY AND BENEFITS

- Up to USD 600 a month, fixed salary, paid on the 10th of each month for the previous month

- 13th-month payment in December

- Paid training on the CurioKids method before your first lesson

- Ready-made lesson materials, so no unpaid planning time

- Regular pay reviews and a path to Senior Teacher

- Independent contractor agreement



REQUIREMENTS

- TEFL or TESOL certificate (minimum 120 hours)

- At least 1 year teaching children aged 4 to 12, online or in a classroom

- Clear, confident spoken English and a warm, patient manner with young children

- Valid NBI clearance (issued within the last 6 months)

- Laptop or desktop, headset with noise-cancelling microphone and HD webcam

- Stable internet of at least 25 Mbps, plus a backup connection

- Quiet, well-lit space with a plain background



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience teaching phonics (Letters and Sounds, Jolly Phonics or similar)

- Education degree or LET licence

- Experience teaching children from Singapore or Malaysia



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. Your CV

2. Your TEFL or TESOL certificate

3. A 1-minute video introducing yourself as if you were meeting a 5-year-old student



Start your application with the words "Phonics Teacher" so we know you have read this post.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a video interview. Before your interview, you will complete a short challenge:



Write a lesson plan showing how you would teach a 25-minute phonics lesson to a 5-year-old. Please include:

- The sound you are teaching and what the child should be able to do by the end

- A warm-up or review of sounds they already know

- How you will introduce the new sound (show us you use pure sounds, for example "sss" not "suh")

- A blending activity with simple words

- A short game to keep the child engaged

- A quick check to see what the child has learned

- How long each part will take



Be ready to talk us through your plan in the interview.



Successful applicants will have to pass a NBI clearance check, sign a contractor agreement and join our paid training before we launch.

title: Amazon PPC & Listing Optimization Expert
description:
ABOUT US



Tilz Collection is an established UK food gifting brand. Our range includes spice collections, hot sauces, coffee, tea, hot chocolate and advent calendars.



We sell on Amazon UK, Germany, France, US, Canada and Australia, with stock held in the UK and in overseas fulfilment locations. We are a team of twelve with our own warehouse in northern England.



This is a full time, long term remote role working directly with our business. There is no agency in the middle.



THE ROLE



We are looking for an experienced specialist who excels at BOTH Amazon PPC and listing creation. Proven expertise in both is essential, and we will assess both during recruitment.



You will take full ownership of our Amazon advertising from day one: strategy, campaign management, optimisation, budgets, reporting and performance, working within agreed budgets and commercial targets.



You will also own listing content: keyword research, persuasive copy, recommendations for images and A+ Content, proofreading and final quality checks.



We expect you to assess the accounts, establish priorities and drive improvements independently. Make informed decisions, explain your reasoning and take responsibility for your work.



Our founder currently reviews every listing. Your role is to deliver work to an agreed standard so she can step back from routine reviews. We will review your work closely during onboarding and expect increasing independence as you demonstrate that standard.



AMAZON PPC RESPONSIBILITIES



- Audit existing campaigns and develop a clear advertising strategy for each marketplace.

- Create, manage and optimise Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display campaigns where appropriate.

- Own campaign structure, keyword and product targeting, bids, placements, budgets and negative keywords.

- Analyse search terms to identify opportunities, reduce wasted spend and support profitable growth.

- Allocate spend according to product margins, performance, stock availability and business priorities.

- Check marketplace specific stock availability and replenishment plans before increasing spend.

- Plan and execute advertising for launches, seasonal products and peak trading.

- Monitor performance daily and respond promptly to significant changes during agreed working hours.

- Provide weekly reporting covering spend, advertising sales, total sales, ACoS, TACoS and progress against agreed targets.

- Explain what changed, why, what you have done and what you recommend next.



LISTING CREATION AND OPTIMISATION



- Research keywords using advertising data, keyword tools, competitor analysis and available Amazon search data.

- Create compelling new listings and improve existing ones.

- Identify missing keywords, content gaps and barriers to conversion.

- Write clear, persuasive titles, bullet points and descriptions, with relevant backend search terms.

- Explain product contents, benefits, quantities, presentation and gifting occasions accurately.

- Incorporate keywords naturally while preserving readability and our tone of voice.

- Recommend improvements to product images and A+ Content.

- Deliver accurate, publication ready copy, including careful proofreading and checks against supplied product information.

- Give our supporting team member clear implementation instructions and check the final live listing.

- Assess changes in keyword visibility and conversion, allowing for seasonality, pricing and stock availability.



HOW YOU WILL WORK WITH OUR TEAM



An existing colleague manages catalogue and account health, including suppressed listings, stranded inventory and Seller Support cases. She also supports listing implementation.



You will own advertising and listing content, coordinating with her when technical issues affect visibility, conversion or advertising eligibility.



OUR AMAZON BUSINESS



- Six marketplaces.

- Two Seller Central accounts.

- Over 75 parent listings.

- Peak trading from mid November to mid December, with monthly advertising spend exceeding US$30,000 during that period.



You will receive approved user access to the Seller Central accounts. Keep your access secure, never share credentials, and always confirm the correct account and marketplace before making changes.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Proven experience independently owning Amazon PPC strategy and campaign management.

- Evidence of results, with a clear explanation of your personal contribution.

- Strong understanding of profitability, advertising metrics and budget allocation.

- Demonstrable expertise creating and optimising Amazon listings, with examples you personally wrote.

- Experience managing advertising through at least one Q4 peak.

- Excellent written English, proofreading and attention to detail.

- Confidence using Seller Central, Amazon Ads, spreadsheets and relevant research tools.

- Ability to prioritise, communicate clearly and work independently.

- Reliable internet and a backup arrangement.



Experience across multiple marketplaces, particularly UK, US and EU, is an advantage. Food, gifting and seasonal product experience is also valuable.



SALARY AND WORKING HOURS

2. What experience do you have selling B2B services into the U.S. and/or Canada?

3. Tell us about a sales team or sales process you personally helped build. What

existed before, what did you change, and what measurable results did you produce?



Please be specific. We are most interested in what you have personally built, managed, and

title: Business Development Specialist (Business Financing)
description:
Business Development Specialist (Business Financing)

Remote | 20 Hours per Week | Eastern Time Overlap Required



About the Role



We are looking for a confident and persistent Business Development Specialist to generate qualified appointments for a Canadian commercial equipment finance company.



Your primary focus will be building relationships with equipment dealerships, equipment suppliers, and established businesses across Canada. You will speak with owners, presidents, finance leaders, fleet managers, and other decision-makers to understand their current financing process and identify where the company can provide additional options.



This is a high-volume outbound sales role. It is not a customer service or administrative position. The right candidate is comfortable making cold calls, handling objections, asking discovery questions, and following up consistently.



What You Will Do

-Cold call equipment dealerships, suppliers, and established businesses across Canada

-Connect with owners, presidents, CFOs, controllers, finance managers, fleet managers, and other decision-makers

-Learn how prospects currently handle equipment financing and identify gaps in their existing process

-Position the company as an additional financing resource that complements captive lenders, banks, and existing broker relationships

-Identify opportunities involving customers who do not qualify through a dealership’s primary lender

-Qualify prospects based on business history, credit standing, equipment requirements, timing, and financial readiness

-Book qualified appointments for the VP of Commercial Finance

-Follow up through phone,
, and LinkedIn

-Research companies, identify decision-makers, and build targeted prospect lists when required

-Maintain accurate notes, follow-up dates, and activity records in Excel or the company’s tracking system

-Coordinate with the client before contacting accounts to avoid overlap with businesses already being managed

-Work with the VP of Commercial Finance to refine target industries, messaging, and outreach strategies



Target Markets

The initial focus will be dealerships, suppliers, and established businesses that purchase or sell:

-Construction and heavy equipment

-Commercial vehicles and fleets

-Transportation and trucking equipment

-Manufacturing machinery

-Agriculture and forestry equipment

-Warehousing and material-handling equipment

-Other business-critical equipment



Who We Are Looking For

-At least 3 years of B2B cold-calling, appointment-setting, business development, or outbound sales experience

-Proven ability to reach business owners and senior decision-makers by phone

-Excellent spoken and written English

-Strong discovery, qualification, objection-handling, and appointment-setting skills

-Confident and professional telephone presence

-Persistence and resilience in a high-volume calling environment

-Strong follow-up habits across phone,
, and LinkedIn

-Good business judgment and the ability to understand a prospect’s current financing process

-Ability to research companies and independently build targeted lead lists

-Strong organization and accurate activity tracking

-Comfortable using Excel or similar tools when a CRM is unavailable

-Availability during Canadian business hours, with regular Eastern Time overlap

-Flexibility to contact businesses across Canadian time zones



Preferred Experience

-Experience in any of the following is strongly preferred:

-Commercial equipment financing or leasing

-Banking, lending, or financial services

-Heavy equipment, construction, trucking, transportation, agriculture, manufacturing, or fleet services

-Selling to equipment dealerships, suppliers, or established businesses

-LinkedIn prospecting and independent lead generation



Performance Expectations

Once fully trained and ramped up, the target is approximately 3 to 4 qualified appointments per working day. Quality is more important than simply filling the calendar.



A qualified appointment should involve a relevant decision-maker at an equipment dealer, supplier, or established business with a credible equipment financing need or partnership opportunity.



Consistent outbound activity is also expected. Depending on campaign requirements and list quality, this may involve approximately 50 to 80 calls per day, supported by follow-up through
 and LinkedIn.



Schedule

-20 hours per week

-You must be available during North American business hours with regular overlap with the Eastern Time Zone (ET).



How to Apply

Please send:

1. Your resume

2. A short voice recording introducing yourself

3. In 2–3 sentences, describe your B2B cold-calling or appointment-setting experience
